own_text: The definitions in this subsection apply in the Act and in these Regulations. common-law partner means, in relation to a person, an individual who is cohabiting with the person in a conjugal relationship, having so cohabited for a period of at least one year. ( conjoint de fait ) excessive demand means (a) a demand on health services or social services for which the anticipated costs exceed triple the average Canadian per capita health services and social services costs over a period of five consecutive years following the most recent medical examination required under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act; or (b) a demand on health services or social services that would add to existing waiting lists and would increase morbidity or the mortality rate in Canada as a result of an inability to provide timely services to Canadian citizens or permanent residents. ( fardeau excessif ) health services means any health services – including the provision of devices related to the services, laboratory services and the supply of pharmaceuticals – for which more than half of the funds are contributed by governments, either directly or through publicly funded agencies. ( services de santé ) social services means residential or institutional care, including the provision of devices related to the care, that is recommended by a health professional and for which more than half of the funds are contributed by governments, either directly or through publicly funded agencies. ( services sociaux ) student [Repealed, SOR/2014-14, s. 1] studies [Repealed, SOR/2014-14, s. 1] study permit [Repealed, SOR/2014-14, s. 1]

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: For the purposes of the Act and these Regulations, an individual who has been in a conjugal relationship with a person for at least one year but is unable to cohabit with the person, due to persecution or any form of penal control, shall be considered a common-law partner of the person.

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: For the purposes of the Act, other than section 12 and paragraph 38(2)(d), and for the purposes of these Regulations, other than paragraph 7.1(3)(a) and sections 159.1 and 159.5, family member in respect of a person means

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: the spouse or common-law partner of the person;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: a dependent child of the person or of the person’s spouse or common-law partner; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: a dependent child of a dependent child referred to in paragraph (b).

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: The definitions in this section apply in these Regulations. Act means the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act . ( Loi ) administration fee means a portion of the average cost incurred by Her Majesty in right of Canada in respect of foreign nationals referred to in subsection 279(1), and includes the costs relating to (a) examinations; (b) detention; (c) investigations and admissibility hearings in respect of inadmissible foreign nationals; (d) fingerprinting, photographing and the verification of documents with other governments and national or international police agencies; (e) translation and interpretation; and (f) proceedings before the Immigration Division. ( frais administratifs ) agent [Repealed, SOR/2016-37, s. 2] authorized representative [Repealed, SOR/2011-129, s. 1] Canadian citizen means a citizen referred to in subsection 3(1) of the Citizenship Act . ( citoyen canadien ) Canadian Language Benchmarks means, for the English language, the Canadian Language Benchmarks: English as a Second Language for Adults developed by the Centre for Canadian Language Benchmarks, as amended from time to time. ( Canadian Language Benchmarks ) commercial transporter means a transporter who operates a commercial vehicle. ( transporteur commercial ) commercial vehicle means a vehicle that is used for commercial purposes. ( véhicule commercial ) conjugal partner means, in relation to a sponsor, a foreign national residing outside Canada who is in a conjugal relationship with the sponsor and has been in that relationship for a period of at least one year. ( partenaire conjugal ) COVID-19 means coronovirus disease 2019. ( COVID-19 ) Department means the Department of Citizenship and Immigration. ( ministère ) dependent child , in respect of a parent, means a child who (a) has one of the following relationships with the parent, namely, (i) is the biological child of the parent, if the child has not been adopted by a person other than the spouse or common-law partner of the parent, or (ii) is the adopted child of the parent; and (b) is in one of the following situations of dependency, namely, (i) is less than 22 years of age and is not a spouse or common-law partner, or (ii) is 22 years of age or older and has depended substantially on the financial support of the parent since before attaining the age of 22 years and is unable to be financially self-supporting due to a physical or mental condition. ( enfant à charge ) designated holding area has the same meaning as in section 1 of the Presentation of Persons (2003) Regulations . ( zone d’attente désignée ) guardianship [Repealed, SOR/2005-61, s. 1] Hague Convention on Adoption means the Convention on the Protection of Children and Co-operation in respect of Inter-Country Adoption that was concluded on May 29, 1993 and came into force on May 1, 1995. ( Convention sur l’adoption ) Indian means any person registered as an Indian under the Indian Act . ( Indien ) in-flight security officer means a person who is on board a commercial passenger aircraft and whose duty it is to protect the passengers and the members of the crew as well as the aircraft itself. ( agent de sécurité aérien ) in-transit passenger means a person who arrives by aircraft at a Canadian airport from another country for the sole purpose of reboarding their flight or boarding a connecting flight departing from that airport to a country other than Canada. ( passager en transit ) in-transit preclearance passenger means an in-transit passenger who is subject to a preclearance procedure in accordance with the Preclearance Act, 2016 . ( passager en transit bénéficiant d’un précontrôle ) live-in caregiver [Repealed, SOR/2017-78, s. 1] marriage , in respect of a marriage that took place outside Canada, means a marriage that is valid both under the laws of the jurisdiction where it took place and under Canadian law. ( mariage ) minimum necessary income means the amount identified, in the most recent edition of the publication concerning low income cut-offs that is published annually by Statistics Canada under the Statistics Act , for urban areas of residence of 500,000 persons or more as the minimum amount of before-tax annual income necessary to support a group of persons equal in number to the total number of the following persons: (a) a sponsor and their family members, (b) the sponsored foreign national, and their family members, whether they are accompanying the foreign national or not, and (c) every other person, and their family members, (i) in respect of whom the sponsor has given or co-signed an undertaking that is still in effect, and (ii) in respect of whom the sponsor’s spouse or common-law partner has given or co-signed an undertaking that is still in effect, if the sponsor’s spouse or common-law partner has co-signed with the sponsor the undertaking in respect of the foreign national referred to in paragraph (b). ( revenu vital minimum ) Minister means the Minister referred to in section 4 of the Act. ( ministre ) National Occupational Classification means the National Occupational Classification implemented by the Department of Employment and Social Development, as amended from time to time. ( Classification nationale des professions ) Niveaux de compétence linguistique canadiens means, for the French language, the Niveaux de compétence linguistique canadiens : français langue seconde pour adultes developed by the Centre for Canadian Language Benchmarks, as amended from time to time. ( Niveaux de compétence linguistique canadiens ) officer means a person designated as an officer by the Minister under subsection 6(1) of the Act. ( agent ) port of entry means (a) [Repealed, SOR/2020-55, s. 1] (b) a place designated by the Minister under section 26 as a port of entry, on the dates and during the hours of operation designated for that place by the Minister. ( point d’entrée ) relative means a person who is related to another person by blood or adoption. ( membre de la parenté ) social assistance means any benefit in the form of money, goods or services provided to or on behalf of a person by a province under a program of social assistance, including a program of social assistance designated by a province to provide for basic requirements including food, shelter, clothing, fuel, utilities, household supplies, personal requirements and health care not provided by public health care, including dental care and eye care. ( assistance sociale ) sterile transit area means an area in an airport where in-transit passengers, in-transit preclearance passengers or goods that are in transit or precontrolled are physically separated from other passengers and goods. ( espace de transit isolé ) study permit means a written authorization to engage in academic, professional, vocational or other education or training in Canada that is issued by an officer to a foreign national. ( permis d’études ) TEER Category means a category representing the level of training, formal education and experience required to gain entry into an occupation, and the responsibilities related to the occupation, as set out in the National Occupational Classification . ( catégorie FÉER ) time of departure means (a) in the case of a commercial vehicle that carries persons or goods by air, the time of take-off from the last point of embarkation of persons before the vehicle arrives in Canada; and (b) in the case of a commercial vehicle that carries persons or goods by water or land, the time of departure from the last point of embarkation of persons before the vehicle arrives in Canada. ( moment du départ ) transporter means (a) a person who owns, operates, charters or manages a vehicle or fleet of vehicles; (b) a person who owns or operates an international tunnel or bridge; (c) a designated airport authority as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Airport Transfer (Miscellaneous Matters) Act ; or (d) an agent for a person or authority referred to in paragraphs (a) to (c). ( transporteur ) vehicle means a means of transportation that may be used for transportation by water, land or air. ( véhicule ) vessel means a vessel within the meaning of section 2 of the Canada Shipping Act . ( bâtiment ) work means an activity for which wages are paid or commission is earned, or that is in direct competition with the activities of Canadian citizens or permanent residents in the Canadian labour market. ( travail ) work permit means a written authorization to work in Canada issued by an officer to a foreign national. ( permis de travail )

own_text: For the purposes of these Regulations,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: member of a crew means a person who is employed on a means of transportation to perform duties during a voyage or trip, or while in port, related to the operation of the means of transportation or the provision of services to passengers or to other members of the crew, but does not include

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: any person whose fare is waived in exchange for work to be performed during the voyage or trip,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: any person who performs maintenance or repairs under a service contract with a transporter during the voyage or trip or while the means of transportation is in Canada,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: any other person who is on board the means of transportation for a purpose other than to perform duties that relate to the operation of the means of transportation or to provide services to passengers or members of the crew, or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: any in-flight security officer; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: a person ceases to be a member of a crew if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: they have deserted;

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: an officer believes on reasonable grounds that they have deserted;

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: they have been hospitalized and have failed to return to the means of transportation or leave Canada after leaving the hospital, or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: they have been discharged or are otherwise unable or unwilling to perform their duties as a member of a crew and failed to leave Canada after the discharge or after they first became unable or unwilling to perform those duties.

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: For the purposes of these Regulations, adoption , for greater certainty, means an adoption that creates a legal parent-child relationship and severs the pre-existing legal parent-child relationship.

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: For the purposes of these Regulations, a foreign national shall not be considered a spouse, a common-law partner or a conjugal partner of a person if the marriage, common-law partnership or conjugal partnership

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: was entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring any status or privilege under the Act; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: is not genuine.

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: A foreign national shall not be considered an adopted child of a person if the adoption

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: was entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring any status or privilege under the Act; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: did not create a genuine parent-child relationship.

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: Subsection (2) does not apply to adoptions referred to in paragraph 117(1)(g) and subsections 117(2) and (4).

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: For the purposes of these Regulations, a foreign national shall not be considered a spouse, a common-law partner or a conjugal partner of a person if the foreign national has begun a new conjugal relationship with that person after a previous marriage, common-law partnership or conjugal partnership with that person was dissolved primarily so that the foreign national, another foreign national or the sponsor could acquire any status or privilege under the Act.

heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: For the purposes of these Regulations, a foreign national shall not be considered

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: the spouse or common-law partner of a person if the foreign national is under the age of 18 years;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: the spouse of a person if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: the foreign national or the person was, at the time of their marriage, the spouse of another person, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: the person has lived separate and apart from the foreign national for at least one year and is the common-law partner of another person; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 1 Interpretation and Application > DIVISION 2 Family Relationships
own_text: the spouse of a person if at the time the marriage ceremony was conducted either one or both of the spouses were not physically present unless the person was not physically present at the ceremony as a result of their service as a member of the Canadian Forces and the marriage is valid both under the laws of the jurisdiction where it took place and under Canadian law.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: A foreign national may not enter Canada to remain on a permanent basis without first obtaining a permanent resident visa.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: A foreign national may not enter Canada to remain on a temporary basis without first obtaining a temporary resident visa.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a foreign national who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: is exempted under Division 5 of Part 9 from the requirement to have a temporary resident visa;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: holds a temporary resident permit issued under subsection 24(1) of the Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: is authorized under the Act or these Regulations to re-enter Canada to remain in Canada; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2023-106, s. 1]

marginal_note: When certificat d’acceptation du Québec required
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: In addition to any visa required under this section, a foreign national who is seeking to enter and remain in Canada on a temporary basis to receive medical treatment in the Province of Quebec must hold a certificat d’acceptation du Québec if the laws of that Province require the foreign national to hold that document.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: Despite subsection 7(1), a foreign national who is a citizen of a country listed in the table to this subsection and who is seeking to enter Canada by air may not enter Canada to remain on a temporary basis without first obtaining a temporary resident visa or an electronic travel authorization. marginal_note: Application for electronic travel authorization — conditions

own_text: A foreign national referred to in subsection (1) may only make an application for an electronic travel authorization if they

label: (a)
marginal_note: Application for electronic travel authorization — conditions

own_text: have held a temporary resident visa at any time during the 10-year period immediately preceding the day on which they make their application; or

marginal_note: Application for electronic travel authorization — conditions

own_text: hold a valid United States nonimmigrant visa on the day on which they make their application.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: A foreign national referred to in paragraph 7(2)(a) who is exempt from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa and who is either seeking to enter Canada by air to remain on a temporary basis or seeking to enter Canada by vessel directly from St. Pierre and Miquelon to remain on a temporary basis is required to obtain an electronic travel authorization before entering Canada, unless they are exempt from that requirement under subsection (3).

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a foreign national who holds a temporary resident visa.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: The following persons are exempt from the requirement to obtain an electronic travel authorization:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: Her Majesty in right of Canada and any member of the Royal Family;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: a national of the United States or a person who has been lawfully admitted to the United States for permanent residence;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: a foreign national referred to in paragraph 190(2)(a);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: a foreign national seeking to enter and remain in Canada solely

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: as a member of a crew of a means of transportation that may be used for transportation by air or to become a member of such a crew, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: to transit through Canada after working, or to work, as a member of a crew of a means of transportation that may be used for transportation by air, if they possess a ticket for departure from Canada within 24 hours after their arrival in Canada;

label: (e)

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: a foreign national who is seeking to enter Canada on a vessel that has overnight accommodations for at least 100 persons, exclusive of accommodations for any members of the crew.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: A foreign national may not enter Canada to work without first obtaining a work permit.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a foreign national who is authorized under section 186 to work in Canada without a work permit.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: A foreign national may not enter Canada to study without first obtaining a study permit.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1 Documents Required Before Entry
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a foreign national who is authorized under section 188 or 189 to study in Canada without a study permit.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Despite section 10, when an application, request or claim is made, a document or information is submitted electronically, or a signature by electronic means is provided, it must be made, submitted or provided using the electronic means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: When an application, request or claim is made by electronic means, any required information, documents or evidence of payment required under these Regulations must be submitted by the same means.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: The following applications must be made by the electronic means made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: an application for an extension of an authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: an application that is made in Canada for a work or study permit or for renewal of such a permit;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: an application for the restoration of temporary resident status;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: an application that is made pursuant to a youth mobility arrangement entered into by Canada.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Any application, request, claim, document or information sent by a foreign national, an individual or an entity using electronic means is deemed to have been received by the Minister at the time and on the date indicated by the electronic means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Any notice, request, decision, determination, document or information sent by the Minister using electronic means is deemed to have been received by the intended recipient at the time and on the date it was sent by the Minister as indicated by the electronic means that is used or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Despite other provisions of these Regulations, the Minister may require a foreign national, an individual or an entity to make an application, request or claim, submit any document or information or provide a signature by any other means made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose if the Minister determines that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: the infrastructure in a country is inadequate or incompatible with the electronic means made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: a natural disaster, political turmoil or other situation prevents or impedes the use of electronic means or makes using them unreliable.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: A foreign national or an individual who, because of a disability is unable to meet a requirement to make an application, request or claim, submit any document or provide a signature or information using electronic means, may do so by any other means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Any fees to be paid or evidence of payment of fees referred to in these Regulations must be paid or provided by the electronic means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose except in the following circumstances:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: if services for the collection of payment are provided by an entity under an agreement or arrangement with Canada for that purpose; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: if fees may be paid at a port of entry by other means.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Despite subsection (1), the required fees may be paid or evidence of payment provided by any other means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose if the Minister determines that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: the infrastructure in a country is inadequate or incompatible with the electronic means made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: a natural disaster, political turmoil or other situation prevents or impedes the use of electronic means or makes using them unreliable.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: Any fee paid by electronic means is deemed to be paid on the date and at the time recorded by the electronic means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 1.1 Use of Electronic Means
own_text: A foreign national or an individual who, because of a disability is unable to pay the required fees referred to in subsection (1) by electronic means, may do so by other means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: Subject to paragraphs 28(b) to (d) and 139(1)(b), an application under these Regulations shall

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: be made in writing using the form, if any, provided by the Department or, in the case of an application for a declaration of relief under subsection 42.1(1) of the Act, by the Canada Border Services Agency;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: be signed by the applicant;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: include all information and documents required by these Regulations, as well as any other evidence required by the Act;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: be accompanied by evidence of payment of the applicable fee, if any, set out in these Regulations; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if there is an accompanying spouse or common-law partner, identify who is the principal applicant and who is the accompanying spouse or common-law partner.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: The application shall, unless otherwise provided by these Regulations,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: contain the name, birth date, address, nationality and immigration status of the applicant and of all family members of the applicant, whether accompanying or not, and a statement whether the applicant or any of the family members is the spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner of another person;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: indicate whether they are applying for a visa, permit or authorization;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: indicate the class prescribed by these Regulations for which the application is made;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if the applicant is represented in connection with the application, include the name, postal address and telephone number, and fax number and electronic mail address, if any, of any person or entity — or a person acting on its behalf — representing the applicant;

label: (c.2)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if the applicant is represented, for consideration in connection with the application, by a person referred to in any of paragraphs 91(2)(a) to (c) of the Act, include the name of the body of which the person is a member and their membership identification number;

label: (c.3)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if the applicant has been advised, for consideration in connection with the application, by a person referred to in any of paragraphs 91(2)(a) to (c) of the Act, include the information referred to in paragraphs (c.1) and (c.2) with respect to that person;

label: (c.4)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if the applicant has been advised, for consideration in connection with the application, by an entity — or a person acting on its behalf — referred to in subsection 91(4) of the Act, include the information referred to in paragraph (c.1) with respect to that entity or person; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: include a declaration that the information provided is complete and accurate.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An application to sponsor and the accompanying application for permanent residence for a person described in paragraph 117(1)(b) involving an international adoption or another person referred to in paragraph 117(1)(g) can be submitted without the information referred to in paragraph 10(2)(a) concerning that person but that information must be provided before the application is approved.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: For greater certainty, neither the information referred to in subparagraphs 12.3(b)(i) and (ii) nor the fee referred to in section 315.1 form part of the application.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: The application is considered to be an application made for the principal applicant and their accompanying family members.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An application made by a foreign national as a member of the family class must be accompanied by a sponsorship application referred to in paragraph 130(1)(c).

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: No sponsorship application may be filed by a sponsor in respect of a person if the sponsor has filed another sponsorship application in respect of that same person and a final decision has not been made in respect of that other application.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: A sponsorship application that is not made in accordance with subsection (1) is considered not to be an application filed in the prescribed manner for the purposes of subsection 63(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: If an application is not made by electronic means it must be submitted to the address specified by the Minister, including the address specified on the Department’s website for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: Subject to section 140.4, if the requirements of sections 10 and 11 are not met, the application and all documents submitted in support of it, except the information referred to in subparagraphs 12.3(b)(i) and (ii), shall be returned to the applicant.

marginal_note: Request or application at port of entry
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: Subject to sections 198 and 214, a person — who under section 10.01 of the Act is required to provide their biometric information — may only make a request for a temporary resident permit under subsection 24(1) of the Act or an application for a work or study permit at a port of entry if that port of entry provides collection services for biometric information.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An application for permanent residence that is made in response to an invitation issued by the Minister under Division 0.1 of the Act must be made by the electronic means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: The application must contain the following information:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the applicant’s name;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the applicant’s date and place of birth;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the applicant’s gender;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the applicant’s address;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the applicant’s nationality;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the number of the applicant’s passport or other travel document, together with its date of issue and its expiry date and the country or the authority that issued it;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if the applicant is an applicant referred to in any of paragraphs 10(2)(c.1) to (c.4), the information required under that paragraph;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: if the applicant is making the application by the electronic system referred to in subsection (1), the applicant’s e-mail address;

label: (h.1)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in paragraph 7.01 (2)(b), the valid United States nonimmigrant visa number; and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: a declaration that the information provided in the application is complete and accurate.

marginal_note: Combined applications — foreign nationals referred to in subsection 7.01(1)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An application for a renewal of a work permit or study permit that is made by a foreign national referred to in subsection 7.01 (1) is considered to constitute an application for an electronic travel authorization.

marginal_note: Combined applications — foreign nationals referred to in subsection 7.1(1)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An application for a work permit or study permit or for renewal of a work permit or study permit that is made by a foreign national who is required under subsection 7.1 (1) to obtain an electronic travel authorization is considered to constitute an application for an electronic travel authorization.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An electronic travel authorization is valid for a period of five years from the day on which it is issued to the applicant or until the earliest of the following days, if they occur before the end of that period:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the day on which the applicant’s passport or other travel document, in respect of which the electronic travel authorization was issued, expires,

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the day on which the electronic travel authorization is cancelled,

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the day on which a new electronic travel authorization, in respect of the same passport or the same travel document, is issued to the applicant,

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the day on which the country or authority referred to in paragraph 190(1)(a) that issued the passport or other travel document in respect of which the electronic travel authorization was issued is no longer referred to in that paragraph, and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the day on which the country referred to in subsection 7.01(1) that issued the passport or other travel document in respect of which the electronic travel authorization was issued is no longer referred to in that subsection, unless that country is listed in Schedule 1.1.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: Any electronic travel authorization that is issued to a citizen of a country other than those listed in Schedule 1.1 on the basis of their lawful admission to the United States for permanent residence ceases to be valid at 08:00:00 Eastern daylight time on April 26, 2022.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: Paragraph (1)(d) does not apply to an electronic travel authorization issued to a foreign national who is a citizen of Mexico if, on the same day referred to in that paragraph, the foreign national holds a work permit or study permit.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: Paragraph (1)(d) does not apply to an electronic travel authorization that is issued in respect of a machine-readable passport that contains a contactless integrated circuit chip and that is issued by Romania.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: A foreign national who holds an electronic travel authorization becomes ineligible to hold such an authorization if, following its issuance,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they are the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1 (1) of the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they were issued a temporary resident permit under subsection 24 (1) of the Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they are the subject of a report prepared under subsection 44 (1) of the Act;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they are the subject of a removal order made under subsection 44 (2) or paragraph 45(d) of the Act;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they withdrew their application to enter Canada under subsection 42 (1);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they were refused a temporary resident visa because they did not meet the requirement set out in paragraph 179 (b);

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they were refused a work permit because they did not meet the requirement set out in paragraph 200 (1)(b);

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they were refused a study permit because they did not meet the requirement set out in paragraph 216 (1)(b);

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in subsection 7.01 (1), it is established that, on the day on which they made their application for an electronic travel authorization, they did not meet either of the conditions set out in paragraphs 7.01 (2)(a) and (b);

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: an officer has reasonable grounds to believe that the foreign national will not leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay under Division 2 of Part 9; or

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: they were refused a work permit or study permit in the course of an application for or renewal of a work permit or study permit referred to in subsection 12.04(6).

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An officer may cancel an electronic travel authorization that was issued to a foreign national if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the foreign national is inadmissible;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the foreign national becomes ineligible to hold such an authorization under section 12.06; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the officer is satisfied that the electronic travel authorization was issued based on an administrative error.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: An electronic travel authorization that was issued to a foreign national is cancelled if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the foreign national becomes a permanent resident;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the passport or other travel document in respect of which the electronic travel authorization was issued is lost, stolen or destroyed;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the passport or other travel document in respect of which the electronic travel authorization was issued is abandoned by the foreign national; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2 Applications
own_text: the foreign national is deceased.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: Section 10.01 of the Act does not apply to claims, applications and requests under the Act, other than the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for a permanent resident visa;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for permanent resident status made by a person who, when they made their claim for refugee protection outside Canada, was exempted, under section 12.8, from providing their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for a temporary resident visa;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for an extension of authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a request for a temporary resident permit;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for restoration of temporary resident status;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for a work permit or renewal of a work permit;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for a study permit or renewal of a study permit;

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, made in Canada by a protected person, within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act;

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a claim for refugee protection, made in Canada;

label: (l)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a claim for refugee protection, made outside Canada; and

label: (m)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: an application for a new permanent resident card made for the first time by a person, 14 years of age or older, who, when they made an application referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c), was exempted under paragraph 12.2(1)(a) from providing their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: Section 10.01 of the Act does not apply to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who is under the age of 14;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who is over the age of 79, unless that person makes a claim in Canada for refugee protection;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who makes an application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(e) to (i) if they are

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: Her Majesty in right of Canada and any member of the Royal Family, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a national of the United States;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who makes an application referred to in paragraph 12.1(h) or (i) if they are

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: in Canada and have made a claim for refugee protection that has not yet been determined by the Refugee Protection Division,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: in Canada and have had refugee protection conferred on them, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a member of the Convention refugees abroad class or a member of a humanitarian-protected persons abroad class;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who is a head of state or head of government who makes an application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(d) to (i);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who seeks to enter Canada in the course of official duties as a properly accredited diplomat, consular officer, representative or official of a country other than Canada, of the United Nations or any of its agencies or of any intergovernmental organization of which Canada is a member;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who is a family member of a person referred to in paragraph (f);

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who holds a valid United States entry visa, is destined to or returning from that country and seeks to enter Canada for a period of less than 48 hours and who

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: is travelling by transporter’s vehicle to a destination other than Canada, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: is transiting through or stopping over in Canada for refuelling or for the continuation of their journey in another vehicle of a transporter;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a foreign national referred to in paragraph 7(2)(a) who makes an application for temporary resident status as a member of the visitor class; or

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a foreign national referred to in subsection 7.01(1) who is the holder of an electronic travel authorization and makes an application for temporary resident status as a member of the visitor class.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: For the purpose of subsection (1), the age of a person shall be determined as of the date on which the application, claim or request is made.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2018-128, s. 3]

marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: For the purposes of section 10.01 of the Act, the procedure for the collection of biometric information is the following:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: the person who makes a claim, application or request shall present themself at:

label: (i)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a location where services for the collection of biometric information are provided by an entity under an agreement or arrangement with the Minister for that purpose, or

label: (ii)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: at an immigration office, a port of entry or another location, if authorized or directed by an officer to do so, for

label: (A)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: reasons relating to the national interest,

label: (B)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: reasons relating to operational requirements, or

label: (C)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: any other reason that may be necessary in the circumstances; and

label: (b)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: they shall have their photograph taken — showing the person’s face unobscured by sunglasses or any other object — and fingerprints captured, at any location referred to in subparagraph (a)(i) or (ii), for the collection of the following information:

label: (i)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: photograph, and

label: (ii)
marginal_note: Procedure for collection of biometric information
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: fingerprints.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: For the purposes of section 10.01 of the Act, a biometric template may be created, and the information collected under paragraph 12.3(b) may be converted into a digital biometric format by using the template.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: For the purposes of section 10.01 of the Act, the procedure for the verification of biometric information to be followed by a person who has made a claim, application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(a) to (m) is that, on seeking to enter Canada and when directed by an officer or by alternative means of examination referred to in paragraph 38(b), the person shall provide the information listed in subparagraphs 12.3(b)(i) and (ii) by means of an electronic device made available for that purpose, in order to verify the biometric information that they provided under paragraph 12.3(b).

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: A person who makes more than one application or request before providing their biometric information referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(d) to (i) is not required to provide their biometric information more than once with respect to those applications or requests.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: Subject to section 12.9, a person who makes an application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(d) to (i) is not required to provide their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: they had already provided it — under subsection 12.1(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations as they read immediately before the coming into force of this paragraph — in support of an application referred to in that subsection, within the 10-year period before the day on which they make the current application;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: they had already provided it — under section 10.01 of the Act — in support of an application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(d) to (i), within the 10-year period before the day on which they make the current application or request; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: subject to subsection (2), they had already provided it under section 10.01 of the Act when they made a claim or application referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(a) to (c) or (j) to (l) and that claim or application is still pending on the day on which they make an application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(d) to (i).

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: Paragraph (1)(c) ceases to apply on the latest of the expiry dates of any work permit or study permit — including any renewal of them — any temporary resident visa or any temporary resident permit having an expiry date that was issued to the person if that person made the application for the permit or visa during the processing of their claim or application, referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(a) to (c) or (j) to (l), and the claim or application referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(a) to (c) or (j) to (l) is refused.

marginal_note: Exemption — collection of biometric information impossible or not feasible
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: A person who makes a claim, application or request referred to in any of paragraphs 12.1(a) to (m) is not required to provide, with respect to the claim, application or request in question, the information referred to in subparagraph 12.3(b)(i) or (ii), as the case may be, if the collection is impossible or not feasible.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: Paragraph 12.7(1)(b) does not apply to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person referred to in paragraph 12.7(1)(b) who was exempted under section 12.8 from providing certain biometric information for a reason relating to a temporary situation if the situation no longer exists; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: a person referred to in paragraph 12.7(1)(c).

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 2.1 Collection and Verification of Biometric Information
own_text: For greater certainty, despite sections 12.7 to 12.9, a person may choose to provide their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act in support of their claim, application or request.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 3 Documents and Certified Copies
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 3 Documents and Certified Copies
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), a requirement of the Act or these Regulations to produce a document is met

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 3 Documents and Certified Copies
own_text: by producing the original document;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 3 Documents and Certified Copies
own_text: by producing a certified copy of the original document; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 3 Documents and Certified Copies
own_text: in the case of an application, if there is an application form on the Department’s website, by completing and producing the form printed from the website or by completing and submitting the form on-line, if the website indicates that the form can be submitted on-line.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 3 Documents and Certified Copies
own_text: Unless these Regulations provide otherwise, a passport, a permanent resident visa, a permanent resident card, a temporary resident visa, a temporary resident permit, a work permit or a study permit may be produced only by producing the original document.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4 Disclosure of Information
own_text: If a member of the Board or an officer determines that the conduct of a person referred to in any of paragraphs 91(2)(a) to (c) of the Act in connection with a proceeding — other than a proceeding before a superior court — or application under the Act is likely to constitute a breach of the person’s professional or ethical obligations, the Department, the Canada Border Services Agency or the Board, as the case may be, may disclose the following information to a body that is responsible for governing or investigating that conduct or to a person who is responsible for investigating that conduct:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4 Disclosure of Information
own_text: any information referred to in paragraphs 10(2)(c.1) to (c.3); and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4 Disclosure of Information
own_text: any information relating to that conduct, but — in the case of any information that could identify any other person — only to the extent necessary for the complete disclosure of that conduct.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: Any biometric information and related personal information set out in subsection (2) that is collected under the Act and provided to the Royal Canadian Mounted Police may be used or disclosed by it to a law enforcement agency in Canada for the following purposes, if there is a potential match between fingerprints collected under the Act and fingerprints collected by it or submitted to it by a law enforcement agency in Canada:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: to establish or verify the identity of a person in order to prevent, investigate or prosecute an offence under any law of Canada or a province; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: to establish or verify the identity of a person whose identity cannot reasonably be otherwise established or verified because of a physical or mental condition or because of their death.

marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: The following information in respect of a foreign national or a permanent resident may be used or disclosed by the Royal Canadian Mounted Police under subsection (1):

label: (a)
marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: their fingerprints and the date on which they were taken;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: their surname and first name;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: their other names and aliases, if any;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: their date of birth;

label: (e)
marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: their gender; and

label: (f)
marginal_note: Information that may be used or disclosed
heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 4.1 Use and Disclosure of Biometric Information and Related Personal Information
own_text: any file number associated with the biometric information or related personal information.

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 5 [Repealed, SOR/2026-68, s. 53]
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2026-68, s. 53]

heading_path: PART 2 General Requirements > DIVISION 6 Cancellation of Visas or Other Documents
own_text: For greater certainty, nothing in these Regulations affects any other lawful authority to cancel a visa or any other document, including an electronic travel authorization, temporary resident visa, work permit and study permit.

marginal_note: Application of par. 34(1)(c) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purpose of determining whether a foreign national or permanent resident is inadmissible under paragraph 34(1)(c) of the Act, if either the following determination or decision has been rendered, the findings of fact set out in that determination or decision shall be considered as conclusive findings of fact:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Application of par. 34(1)(c) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a determination by the Board, based on findings that the foreign national or permanent resident has engaged in terrorism, that the foreign national or permanent resident is a person referred to in section F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention; or

label: (b)
marginal_note: Application of par. 34(1)(c) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a decision by a Canadian court under the Criminal Code concerning the foreign national or permanent resident and the commission of a terrorism offence.

marginal_note: Application of par. 35(1)(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purpose of determining whether a foreign national or permanent resident is inadmissible under paragraph 35(1)(a) of the Act, if any of the following decisions or the following determination has been rendered, the findings of fact set out in that decision or determination shall be considered as conclusive findings of fact:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Application of par. 35(1)(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a decision concerning the foreign national or permanent resident that is made by any international criminal tribunal that is established by resolution of the Security Council of the United Nations, or the International Criminal Court as defined in the Crimes Against Humanity and War Crimes Act ;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Application of par. 35(1)(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a determination by the Board, based on findings that the foreign national or permanent resident has committed a war crime or a crime against humanity, that the foreign national or permanent resident is a person referred to in section F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention; or

label: (c)
marginal_note: Application of par. 35(1)(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a decision by a Canadian court under the Criminal Code or the Crimes Against Humanity and War Crimes Act concerning the foreign national or permanent resident and a war crime or crime against humanity committed outside Canada.

marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act, a prescribed senior official is a person who, by virtue of the position they hold or held, is or was able to exert significant influence on the exercise of government power or is or was able to benefit from their position, and includes

label: (a)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: heads of state or government;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: members of the cabinet or governing council;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: senior advisors to persons described in paragraph (a) or (b);

label: (d)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: senior members of the public service;

label: (e)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: senior members of the military and of the intelligence and internal security services;

label: (f)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: ambassadors and senior diplomatic officials; and

label: (g)
marginal_note: Application of paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: members of the judiciary.

marginal_note: Application of paragraphs 37(1)(a) and (b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purpose of determining whether a foreign national or permanent resident is inadmissible under paragraph 37(1)(a) or (b) of the Act, if either of the following decisions has been rendered, the findings of fact set out in that decision shall be considered as conclusive findings of fact:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Application of paragraphs 37(1)(a) and (b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a decision by a Canadian court under section 467.11, 467.111, 467.12 or 467.13 of the Criminal Code concerning the foreign national or permanent resident; or

label: (b)
marginal_note: Application of paragraphs 37(1)(a) and (b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a sentencing decision by a Canadian court concerning the foreign national or permanent resident, made in accordance with the principle set out under subparagraph 718.2(a)(iv) of the Criminal Code .

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 36(3)(c) of the Act, the prescribed period is five years

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: after the completion of an imposed sentence, in the case of matters referred to in paragraphs 36(1)(b) and (2)(b) of the Act, if the person has not been convicted of a subsequent offence other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Young Offenders Act ; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: after committing an offence, in the case of matters referred to in paragraphs 36(1)(c) and (2)(c) of the Act, if the person has not been convicted of a subsequent offence other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Young Offenders Act .

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 36(3)(c) of the Act, the class of persons deemed to have been rehabilitated is a prescribed class.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: The following persons are members of the class of persons deemed to have been rehabilitated:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: persons who have been convicted outside Canada of no more than one offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament, if all of the following conditions apply, namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the offence is punishable in Canada by a maximum term of imprisonment of less than 10 years,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: at least 10 years have elapsed since the day after the completion of the imposed sentence,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted in Canada of an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted in Canada of any summary conviction offence within the last 10 years under an Act of Parliament or of more than one summary conviction offence before the last 10 years, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not within the last 10 years been convicted outside Canada of an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not before the last 10 years been convicted outside Canada of more than one offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute a summary conviction offence under an Act of Parliament, and

label: (vii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not committed an act described in paragraph 36(2)(c) of the Act, other than the one for which they have been convicted;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: persons convicted outside Canada of two or more offences that, if committed in Canada, would constitute summary conviction offences under any Act of Parliament, if all of the following conditions apply, namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: at least five years have elapsed since the day after the completion of the imposed sentences,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted in Canada of an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament,

label: (iii)
