heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not within the last five years been convicted in Canada of an offence under an Act of Parliament, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not within the last five years been convicted outside Canada of an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not before the last five years been convicted in Canada of more than one summary conviction offence under an Act of Parliament, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted of an offence referred to in paragraph 36(2)(b) of the Act that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an indictable offence, and

label: (vii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not committed an act described in paragraph 36(2)(c) of the Act; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: persons who have committed no more than one act outside Canada that is an offence in the place where it was committed and that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament, if all of the following conditions apply, namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the offence is punishable in Canada by a maximum term of imprisonment of less than 10 years,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: at least 10 years have elapsed since the day after the commission of the offence,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted in Canada of an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted in Canada of any summary conviction offence within the last 10 years under an Act of Parliament or of more than one summary conviction offence before the last 10 years, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not within the last 10 years been convicted outside of Canada of an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, other than an offence designated as a contravention under the Contraventions Act or an offence under the Youth Criminal Justice Act ,

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not before the last 10 years been convicted outside Canada of more than one offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute a summary conviction offence under an Act of Parliament, and

label: (vii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the person has not been convicted outside of Canada of an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an indictable offence under an Act of Parliament.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: The class of foreign nationals who are inadmissible solely on the basis of having been convicted in Canada of two or more offences that may only be prosecuted summarily, under any Act of Parliament, is a prescribed class for the application of paragraph 36(2)(a) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: A member of the class prescribed in subsection (1) is exempt from the application of paragraph 36(2)(a) of the Act if it has been at least five years since the day after the completion of the imposed sentences.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 36(2.1) of the Act, the prescribed offences are

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any indictable offence under the Criminal Code ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any indictable offence under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act ;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any offence under section 106, 107 or 110 of the Firearms Act ;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any offence under subsection 159(1) of the Customs Act with respect to the following goods:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: child pornography , as defined in subsection 163.1(1) of the Criminal Code ,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: an automatic firearm , imitation firearm , non-restricted firearm , prohibited ammunition , prohibited device , prohibited firearm , prohibited weapon , replica firearm , restricted firearm or restricted weapon , as those terms are defined in subsection 84(1) of the Criminal Code ,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a substance listed in any of Schedules I to VI of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act or a device listed in Schedule IX of that Act, or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: cannabis , as defined in subsection 2(1) of the Cannabis Act ;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any offence under subsection 160(1) of the Customs Act that is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a contravention of section 12 of that Act with respect to the following goods:

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: child pornography , as defined in subsection 163.1(1) of the Criminal Code ,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: an automatic firearm , imitation firearm , non-restricted firearm , prohibited ammunition , prohibited device , prohibited firearm , prohibited weapon , replica firearm , restricted firearm or restricted weapon , as those terms are defined in subsection 84(1) of the Criminal Code , or

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a substance listed in any of Schedules I to VI of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act , or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a contravention of section 156 of the Customs Act ;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any offence under section 4, 5, 6 or 7.1 of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act or any offence under section 46 of that Act that is a contravention of subsection 46.3(1) of that Act; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any offence under Division 1 of Part 1 of the Cannabis Act , except an offence under section 12 of that Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purposes of paragraphs (1)(a) and (b), an offence that may be prosecuted either summarily or by way of indictment is deemed to be an offence punishable by way of indictment, even if it has been prosecuted summarily.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: An officer shall determine that a foreign national is inadmissible on health grounds if the officer determines that the foreign national’s health condition is likely to be a danger to public health or public safety or, except for a foreign national referred to in subsection 38(2) of the Act, might reasonably be expected to cause excessive demand.

marginal_note: Danger to public health or public safety
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: Before determining that the foreign national’s health condition is likely to be a danger to public health or public safety, the officer shall consider any opinions of an officer who is assessing the foreign national’s health condition.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: Before determining that the foreign national’s health condition might reasonably be expected to cause excessive demand, the officer shall consider

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any opinions of an officer who is assessing the foreign national’s health condition; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: any relevant non-medical factors, including

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the foreign national’s intent and financial ability to mitigate any excessive demand, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the feasibility of a mitigation plan, if any, submitted by the foreign national.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: Protected persons within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act are exempted from the application of section 39 of the Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: Persons who have claimed refugee protection, if disposition of the claim is pending, and protected persons within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act are exempted from the application of paragraph 40(1)(a) of the Act.

marginal_note: Application of paragraph 41(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purpose of determining whether a foreign national is inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for having failed to comply with the condition set out in paragraph 43(1)(e) or 183(1)(d) of these Regulations, if the foreign national has been convicted for having contravened an order or regulation made under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act , the facts on which the conviction is based shall be considered to be conclusively established.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 42(1)(a) of the Act, the prescribed circumstances in which the foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of an inadmissible non-accompanying family member are that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the foreign national is a temporary resident or has made an application for temporary resident status, an application for a permanent resident visa or an application to remain in Canada as a temporary or permanent resident; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the non-accompanying family member is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the spouse of the foreign national, except where the relationship between the spouse and foreign national has broken down in law or in fact,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the common-law partner of the foreign national,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a dependent child of the foreign national and either the foreign national or an accompanying family member of the foreign national has custody of that child or is empowered to act on behalf of that child by virtue of a court order or written agreement or by operation of law, or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a dependent child of a dependent child of the foreign national and the foreign national, a dependent child of the foreign national or any other accompanying family member of the foreign national has custody of that child or is empowered to act on behalf of that child by virtue of a court order or written agreement or by operation of law.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: The exception set out in paragraph 38(2)(a) of the Act does not apply to a child who is not a dependent child of the sponsor.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: The following family members of a foreign national referred to in paragraph 38(2)(a) of the Act are prescribed for the purpose of paragraph 38(2)(d) of the Act:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the dependent child of the sponsor’s spouse or common-law partner;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the dependent child of the dependent child referred to in paragraph (a); and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the dependent child of the sponsor’s dependent child.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: Paragraph 38(1)(c) of the Act does not apply to a foreign national who has been determined to be a member of the family class and is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the conjugal partner of a sponsor;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the dependent child of the conjugal partner referred to in paragraph (a);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: the dependent child of the dependent child referred to in paragraph (b); or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 1 Determination of Inadmissibility
own_text: a person referred to in paragraph 117(1)(g).

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: A foreign national may apply for a declaration of relief under subsection 42.1(1) of the Act if a decision has been made to refuse their application for permanent or temporary resident status, or a removal order has been issued against them, on the basis of a determination of inadmissibility under section 34, paragraph 35(1)(b) or subsection 37(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: However, if the foreign national has filed an application for leave to commence an application for judicial review under subsection 72(1) of the Act with respect to a decision or removal order referred to in subsection (1), the foreign national may only make an application under subsection (1) after the earliest of the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the Federal Court refuses the application for leave,

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: if the application for leave is granted, the Federal Court refuses the application for judicial review and no question is certified for the Federal Court of Appeal,

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: if a question is certified for the Federal Court of Appeal,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: an appeal to the Federal Court of Appeal is not filed within the time limit, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the Federal Court of Appeal dismisses the appeal and an application to the Supreme Court of Canada for leave to appeal from that decision is not filed within the time limit,

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: if an application is filed with the Supreme Court of Canada for leave to appeal,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the application is refused,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the application is granted and an appeal is not filed within the time limit, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the Supreme Court of Canada dismisses the appeal, and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the foreign national discontinues their application for leave to commence an application for judicial review, application for judicial review, appeal to the Federal Court of Appeal, application to the Supreme Court of Canada for leave to appeal or appeal to the Supreme Court of Canada, as the case may be.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: An application under subsection 42.1(1) of the Act must include the following information in respect of the applicant:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: their place of birth, gender and marital status and the names of any former spouses or common-law partners;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: their telephone number and email address, if any;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: their former countries of citizenship or former countries of nationality;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: their education, including the name and address of all elementary and secondary schools and post-secondary, technical and vocational institutions attended and the start and end dates for the periods during which they attended each school or institution;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: their work history, including volunteer work, from the age of 16 years, including start and end dates for each period of work, their job title and job description and the employer’s name and address;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: their international travel history from the age of 16 years, including a list of the countries visited, the purpose of the visits, the dates and duration of the visits and any immigration status sought from or granted by any country visited; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the provision of the Act under which they were determined to be inadmissible — section 34, paragraph 35(1)(b) or subsection 37(1) — as well as the date on which and the city and country in which the determination was made and whether the determination resulted in a decision or removal order referred to in subsection 24.1(1).

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: Paragraphs 10(2)(b) and (c) do not apply to an application under subsection 42.1(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: If the requirements of sections 24.1 and 24.2 are not met, the application is not accepted for processing and the application and all documents submitted in support of it are returned to the applicant.

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: The processing of the application is discontinued and the applicant’s file is closed if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: a notice has been sent to the applicant requiring that they confirm their intention to proceed with their application and the applicant fails to respond to the notice within 60 calendar days after the day on which it was sent;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the applicant has acquired permanent resident status;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the applicant withdraws their application in writing; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: the applicant has, since making their application, filed an application for leave to commence an application for judicial review under subsection 72(1) of the Act with respect to a decision or removal order referred to in subsection 24.1(1).

heading_path: PART 3 Inadmissibility > DIVISION 2 Application for Declaration of Relief Under Subsection 42.1(1) of the Act
own_text: The applicant must notify the Minister without delay of any change in their address, telephone number or email address and, if the applicant is represented, the address, telephone number, fax number or email address of their representative.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 0.1 Expiry Date
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 0.1 Expiry Date
own_text: The expiry date of any work permit, study permit — including any renewal of them — temporary resident permit having an expiry date, temporary resident visa, or document that indicates the temporary resident status of a person who is a member of the visitor class, issued to a person who is required to provide their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act, must not be later than 10 years after the latest day on which the person provided their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 0.1 Expiry Date
own_text: The latest day on which the person provided their biometric information is determined at the time of the issuance of the permit, visa or other document.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: A visa shall not be issued to a foreign national who is subject to an unenforced removal order.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is a member of any of the classes set out in these Regulations, other than in those cases referred to in subsections (2) to (9), and who makes an application under Division 5, 6 or 7 of Part 5 is the date on which the application is made.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is referred to in section 71, to whom a Certificat de sélection du Québec has been issued declaring that that person is in a particularly distressful situation and who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 is the date on which the application for selection was made to Quebec.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is referred to in section 86, 90, 97 or 101, to whom a Certificat de sélection du Québec has been issued and who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 is the date on which the application for selection was made to Quebec.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is a member of the provincial nominee class, who is nominated by the province and who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 is the date on which the application for nomination was made to the province.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is a member of the Atlantic immigration class and who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 is the date on which the application for endorsement was made to the province.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is referred to in section 87.4 and who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 is the date on which an application for a certificate of recommendation is made to an economic development organization with respect to the person.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who is referred to in paragraph 139(1)(h), who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 and in respect of whom an undertaking application is made by a sponsor who meets the requirements of sponsorship set out in section 158 is the date on which the undertaking application was made to Quebec.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who submits an application for a permanent resident visa under Division 1 of Part 8 along with one of the referrals set out in section 140.3 is the date on which the referral was made.

marginal_note: Family member who does not accompany applicant
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child who submits an application under paragraph 141(1)(b) is the dependent child of a person who has submitted an application under paragraph 139(1)(b), the lock-in date for the age of that child is the date on which that person submitted the application.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1 Visa Issuance
own_text: For the purposes of determining whether a child is a dependent child, the lock-in date for the age of a child of a person who has submitted a claim for refugee protection inside Canada under subsection 99(3) of the Act, who has acquired protected person status and who has made an application for permanent residence is the date on which the claim for refugee protection was made.

marginal_note: Electronic travel authorization not to be issued
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 1.1 Issuance of Electronic Travel Authorization
own_text: An electronic travel authorization shall not be issued to a foreign national who is subject to an unenforced removal order.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: The Minister may, on the basis of the following factors, designate a place as a port of entry as well as the port of entry’s dates and hours of operation:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the frequency or anticipated frequency of persons arriving from abroad in the area under consideration;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the need for the services of the Canada Border Services Agency in that area;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the operational requirements of commercial transporters;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: administrative arrangements with other departments or agencies of the Government of Canada;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the operational capacity of the Canada Border Services Agency; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: any order or regulation made by the Governor in Council under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act that prohibits the entry of certain persons into Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: The Minister may, on the basis of the factors set out in section 26, specify whether the services provided at a port of entry include the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the collection of biometric information under section 12.3;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of a permanent resident visa that a foreign national presents, under section 71.1, in order to become a permanent resident;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of an application for an extension of an authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident under section 181;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of an application for the restoration of temporary resident status under section 182;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of an application for a work permit under subsection 198(1);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of an application for the renewal of a work permit under section 201;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of an application for a study permit under section 214; and

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: the reception of an application for the renewal of a study permit under section 217.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: The Minister may also, on the basis of those factors, specify whether a service set out in subsection (1) is provided to a specified class of foreign nationals at a specified port of entry.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: Unless these Regulations provide otherwise, for the purpose of the examination required by subsection 18(1) of the Act, a person must appear without delay before an officer at a port of entry.

marginal_note: Seeking entry at a place other than a port of entry
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: Unless these Regulations provide otherwise, a person who seeks to enter Canada at a place other than a port of entry must appear without delay for examination at the port of entry that is nearest to that place.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 2 Authorization to Enter Canada
own_text: For the purposes of section 18 of the Act, every person who has been returned to Canada as a result of the refusal of another country to allow that person entry is a person seeking to enter Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 15(1) of the Act, a person makes an application in accordance with the Act by

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: submitting an application in writing;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: seeking to enter Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: seeking to transit through Canada as provided in section 35; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: making a claim for refugee protection.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act, a medical examination includes any or all of the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: physical examination;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: mental examination;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: review of past medical history;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: laboratory test;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: diagnostic test; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: medical assessment of records respecting the applicant.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act, the following foreign nationals are exempt from the requirement to submit to a medical examination:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals other than

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: subject to paragraph (g), foreign nationals who are applying for a permanent resident visa or applying to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, as well as their family members, whether accompanying or not,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals who are seeking to work in Canada in an occupation in which the protection of public health is essential,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals who

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: are seeking to enter Canada or applying for renewal of their work or study permit or authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident for a period in excess of six consecutive months, including an actual or proposed period of absence from Canada of less than 14 days, and

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: have resided or stayed for a period of six consecutive months, at any time during the one-year period immediately preceding the date that they sought entry or made their application, in an area that the Minister determines, after consultation with the Minister of Health, has a higher incidence of serious communicable disease than Canada,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals who an officer, or the Immigration Division, has reasonable grounds to believe are inadmissible under subsection 38(1) of the Act,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals who claim refugee protection in Canada, and

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals who are seeking to enter or remain in Canada and who may apply to the Minister for protection under subsection 112(1) of the Act, other than foreign nationals who have not left Canada since their claim for refugee protection or application for protection was rejected;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a person described in paragraph 186(b) who is entering or is in Canada to carry out official duties, unless they seek to engage or continue in secondary employment in Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a family member of a person described in paragraph 186(b), unless that family member seeks to engage or continue in employment in Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a member of the armed forces of a country that is a designated state as defined in the Visiting Forces Act , who is entering or is in Canada to carry out official duties, other than a person who has been designated as a civilian component of those armed forces, unless that member seeks to engage or continue in secondary employment in Canada;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a family member of a protected person, if the family member is not included in the protected person’s application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a non-accompanying family member of a foreign national who has applied for refugee protection outside Canada; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: foreign nationals who are applying to remain in Canada as a permanent resident and on whom refugee protection has been conferred under paragraph 95(1)(b) or (c) of the Act, as well as their accompanying family members in Canada, if both of the following conditions apply:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: they have previously undergone a medical examination that indicates their health condition is not likely to be a danger to public health or public safety or have complied with the medical surveillance conditions imposed under section 32, if any,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: they have not resided or stayed for a period of six consecutive months since their most recent medical examination in an area that the Minister determines, after consultation with the Minister of Health, has a higher incidence of serious communicable disease than Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Every foreign national who has undergone a medical examination as required under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act must submit to a new medical examination before entering Canada if, after being authorized to enter and remain in Canada, they have resided or stayed for a total period in excess of six months in an area that the Minister determines, after consultation with the Minister of Health, has a higher incidence of serious communicable disease than Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Every foreign national who must submit to a medical examination, as required under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act, and who seeks to enter Canada must hold a medical certificate — based on the most recent medical examination to which they were required to submit under that paragraph and which took place within the previous 12 months — that indicates that their health condition is not likely to be a danger to public health or public safety and, unless subsection 38(2) of the Act applies, is not reasonably expected to cause excessive demand.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Before opining whether a foreign national’s health condition is likely to be a danger to public health, an officer who is assessing the foreign national’s health condition shall consider

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: any report made by a health practitioner or medical laboratory with respect to the foreign national;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the communicability of any disease that the foreign national is affected by or carries; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the impact that the disease could have on other persons living in Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: In addition to the conditions that are imposed on a foreign national who makes an application as a member of a class, an officer may impose, vary or cancel the following conditions in respect of any foreign national who is required to submit to a medical examination under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: to report at the specified times and places for medical examination, surveillance or treatment; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: to provide proof, at the specified times and places, of compliance with the conditions imposed.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Before opining whether a foreign national’s health condition is likely to be a danger to public safety, an officer who is assessing the foreign national’s health condition shall consider

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: any reports made by a health practitioner or medical laboratory with respect to the foreign national; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the risk of a sudden incapacity or of unpredictable or violent behaviour of the foreign national that would create a danger to the health or safety of persons living in Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: An officer who is assessing a foreign national’s health condition shall analyze all relevant medical factors that apply to a determination of whether the foreign national’s health condition might reasonably be expected to cause excessive demand and shall prepare an opinion based on their analysis.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Medical factors referred to in subsection (1) include

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: any reports made by a health practitioner or medical laboratory with respect to the foreign national;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: any condition identified by a medical examination required under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the availability of and anticipated costs for health services and social services arising from the foreign national’s health status; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a consideration of whether a mitigation plan, if any, submitted by the foreign national would provide for appropriate treatment for the health condition and would be permitted under the rules regulating the delivery of health care in Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: The officer shall not consider non-medical factors, including

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the foreign national’s intent and financial ability to mitigate any excessive demand; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the feasibility of a mitigation plan, if any, submitted by the foreign national.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), the following persons are not seeking to enter Canada but are making an application under subsection 15(1) of the Act to transit through Canada:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: in airports where there are United States’ in-transit preclearance facilities, in-transit preclearance passengers; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: in any airport, passengers who are arriving from any country and who are transiting to a country other than Canada and remain in a sterile transit area or designated holding area.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Any person seeking to leave a sterile transit area or designated holding area must appear immediately for examination.

marginal_note: Actions not constituting a complete examination
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: An inspection carried out aboard a means of transportation bringing persons to Canada or the questioning of persons embarking on or disembarking from a means of transportation, or the examination of any record or document respecting such persons before they appear for examination at a port of entry, is part of an examination but does not constitute a complete examination.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), the examination of a person who seeks to enter Canada, or who makes an application to transit through Canada, ends only when

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a determination is made that the person has a right to enter Canada, or is authorized to enter Canada as a temporary resident or permanent resident, the person is authorized to leave the port of entry at which the examination takes place and the person leaves the port of entry;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: if the person is an in-transit passenger, the person departs from Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: the person is authorized to withdraw their application to enter Canada and an officer verifies their departure from Canada; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a decision in respect of the person is made under subsection 44(2) of the Act and the person leaves the port of entry.

marginal_note: End of examination — claim for refugee protection
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: The examination of a person who makes a claim for refugee protection at a port of entry or inside Canada other than at a port of entry ends when the later of the following occurs:

label: (a)
marginal_note: End of examination — claim for refugee protection
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: an officer determines that their claim is ineligible under section 101 of the Act or the Refugee Protection Division accepts or rejects their claim under section 107 of the Act;

label: (b)
marginal_note: End of examination — claim for refugee protection
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > General
own_text: a decision in respect of the person is made under subsection 44(2) of the Act and, in the case of a claim made at a port of entry, the person leaves the port of entry.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 18(1) of the Act, the following persons may — unless otherwise directed by an officer — be examined by the means indicated as alternative to appearing for an examination by an officer at a port of entry:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: persons who have previously been examined and hold an authorization issued under section 11.1 of the Customs Act , in which case examination is effected by the presentation of the authorization by those persons at a port of entry;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: persons who are seeking to enter Canada at a port of entry where facilities are in place for automatic screening of persons seeking to enter Canada, in which case examination is performed by automatic screening;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: persons who leave Canada and proceed directly to a marine installation or structure to which the Oceans Act applies, and who return directly to Canada from the installation or structure without entering the territorial waters of a foreign state, in which case examination is conducted by an officer by telephone or other means of telecommunication;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: members of a crew of a ship that transports oil or liquid natural gas and that docks at a marine installation or structure to which the Oceans Act applies, for the purpose of loading oil or liquid natural gas, in which case examination is conducted by an officer by telephone or other means of telecommunication;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: members of a crew of a ship registered in a foreign country, other than members of a crew referred to in paragraph (d), in which case examination is conducted by an officer by telephone or other means of telecommunication;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: members of a crew of a ship registered in Canada, in which case examination is conducted by an officer by telephone or other means of telecommunication;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: citizens or permanent residents of Canada or the United States who are seeking to enter Canada at remote locations where no officer is assigned or where there are no means by which the persons may report for examination, in which case examination is conducted by an officer by telephone or other means of telecommunication; and

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: citizens or permanent residents of Canada or the United States who seek to enter Canada at places, other than a port of entry, where no officer is assigned, in which case examination is conducted by an officer by telephone or other means of telecommunication.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Permitted Entry
own_text: An officer shall allow the following persons to enter Canada following an examination:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Permitted Entry
own_text: persons who have been returned to Canada as a result of a refusal of another country to allow them entry after they were removed from or otherwise left Canada after a removal order was made against them;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Permitted Entry
own_text: persons returning to Canada under a transfer order made under the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act and who, immediately before being transferred to a foreign state under the transfer order, were subject to an unenforced removal order; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Permitted Entry
own_text: persons who are in possession of refugee travel papers issued to them by the Minister that are valid for return to Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: Except in the case of protected persons within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act and refugee protection claimants, an officer who is unable to examine a person who is seeking to enter Canada at a port of entry shall, in writing, direct the person to leave Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: A copy of the direction shall be served on the person as well as on the owner or person in control of the means of transportation, if any, that brought the person to Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: The direction ceases to have effect when the person appears again at a port of entry and an officer proceeds to examine the person.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: Unless an authorization has been given under section 23 of the Act, an officer who examines a foreign national who is seeking to enter Canada from the United States shall direct them to return temporarily to the United States if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: no officer is able to complete an examination;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: the Minister is not available to consider, under subsection 44(2) of the Act, a report prepared with respect to the person;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: an admissibility hearing cannot be held by the Immigration Division; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: the foreign national is prohibited from entering Canada by an order or regulation made by the Governor in Council under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), an officer who examines a foreign national who is seeking to enter Canada and who has indicated that they want to withdraw their application to enter Canada shall allow the foreign national to withdraw their application and leave Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: If a report is being prepared or has been prepared under subsection 44(1) of the Act in respect of a foreign national who indicates that they want to withdraw their application to enter Canada, the officer shall not allow the foreign national to withdraw their application or leave Canada unless the Minister decides either not to make a removal order or not to refer the report to the Immigration Division for an admissibility hearing.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Conduct of Examination Measures
own_text: A foreign national who is allowed to withdraw their application to enter Canada must appear without delay before an officer at a port of entry to confirm their departure from Canada.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: An officer must impose the following conditions on every person authorized to enter Canada under section 23 of the Act:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: to report in person at the time and place specified for the completion of the examination or the admissibility hearing;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: to not engage in any work in Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: to not attend any educational institution in Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: to report in person to an officer at a port of entry if the person withdraws their application to enter Canada; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: to comply with all requirements imposed on them by an order or regulation made under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Application of Section 23 of the Act
own_text: A foreign national who is authorized to enter Canada under section 23 of the Act does not, by reason only of that authorization, become a temporary resident or a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Obligation to Appear at an Admissibility Hearing
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Obligation to Appear at an Admissibility Hearing
own_text: The class of persons who are the subject of a report referred for an admissibility hearing under subsection 44(2) of the Act is prescribed as a class of persons.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Obligation to Appear at an Admissibility Hearing
own_text: The members of the class of persons who are the subject of a report referred for an admissibility hearing under subsection 44(2) of the Act are the persons who are the subject of such a report.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Obligation to Appear at an Admissibility Hearing
own_text: Every member of the class prescribed under subsection (1) must appear at their admissibility hearing before the Immigration Division if they are given notice of the hearing by the Division.

marginal_note: Deposit or guarantee required on entry
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees

marginal_note: Deposit or guarantee required on entry
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: An officer can require, in respect of a person or group of persons seeking to enter Canada, the payment of a deposit or the posting of a guarantee, or both, to the Minister for compliance with any conditions imposed.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: The amount of the deposit or guarantee is fixed by an officer on the basis of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: the financial resources of the person or group;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: the obligations that result from the conditions imposed;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: the costs that would likely be incurred to locate and arrest the person or group, to detain them, to hold an admissibility hearing and to remove them from Canada; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: in the case of a guarantee, the costs that would likely be incurred to enforce it.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: Sections 47 to 49 apply to deposits and guarantees required under subsections 44(3), 56(1), 58(3) and 58.1(3) of the Act and section 45 of these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: A person who pays a deposit or posts a guarantee

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: must not have signed or co-signed another guarantee that is in default; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: must have the capacity to contract in the province where the deposit is paid or the guarantee is posted.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: A person who posts a guarantee must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: be a Canadian citizen or a permanent resident, physically present and residing in Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: be able to ensure that the person or group of persons in respect of whom the guarantee is required will comply with the conditions imposed; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: present to an officer evidence of their ability to fulfil the obligation arising from the guarantee.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: If an officer has reasonable grounds to believe that a sum of money offered by a person as a deposit was not legally obtained, or that a sum of money that a person may be obliged to pay under a guarantee would not be legally obtained, the officer shall not allow that person to pay a deposit or post a guarantee.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: An officer, the Immigration Division or the Minister must consider the following factors in assessing whether the person who posts a guarantee has the ability to ensure that the person or group of persons in respect of whom the guarantee is required will comply with the conditions imposed:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: their relationship to the person or group of persons in respect of whom the guarantee is required;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: their financial situation;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: any previous history posting a guarantee;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: their criminal record; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: any other relevant factor in determining their ability to ensure that the person or group of persons in respect of whom the guarantee is required will comply with the conditions imposed.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: In addition to any other conditions that are imposed, the following conditions are imposed on a person or group of persons in respect of whom a guarantee is required:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: to provide the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency, depending on which one requires the information, with the address of the person posting the guarantee and to advise the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency, as the case may be, before any change in that address; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: to present themself or themselves at the time and place that an officer or the Immigration Division requires them to appear to comply with any obligation imposed on them under the Act.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: In addition to any other conditions that are imposed, the following conditions are imposed on a person or group of persons in respect of whom a deposit is required:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: to provide the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency, depending on which one requires the information, with their address and to advise the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency, as the case may be, before any change in that address; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: to present themself or themselves at the time and place that an officer or the Immigration Division requires them to appear to comply with any obligation imposed on them under the Act.

marginal_note: Acknowledgment of consequences of failure to comply with conditions
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees

marginal_note: Acknowledgment of consequences of failure to comply with conditions
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: A person who pays a deposit or posts a guarantee must acknowledge in writing

label: (a)
marginal_note: Acknowledgment of consequences of failure to comply with conditions
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: that they have been informed of the conditions imposed; and

label: (b)
marginal_note: Acknowledgment of consequences of failure to comply with conditions
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: that they have been informed that non-compliance with any conditions imposed will result in the forfeiture of the deposit or enforcement of the guarantee.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: An officer shall issue a receipt for the deposit or a copy of the guarantee, and a copy of the conditions imposed.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: If an officer determines that the person or group of persons in respect of whom the deposit was required has complied with the conditions imposed, the deposit shall be returned.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Deposits or Guarantees
own_text: A sum of money deposited is forfeited, or a guarantee posted becomes enforceable, on the failure of the person or any member of the group of persons in respect of whom the deposit or guarantee was required to comply with a condition imposed.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: In addition to the permanent resident visa required of a foreign national who is a member of a class referred to in subsection 70(2), a foreign national seeking to become a permanent resident must hold

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport, other than a diplomatic, official or similar passport, that was issued by the country of which the foreign national is a citizen or national;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a travel document that was issued by the country of which the foreign national is a citizen or national;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: an identity or travel document that was issued by a country to non-national residents, refugees or stateless persons who are unable to obtain a passport or other travel document from their country of citizenship or nationality or who have no country of citizenship or nationality;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a travel document that was issued by the International Committee of the Red Cross in Geneva, Switzerland, to enable and facilitate emigration;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport or travel document that was issued by the Palestinian Authority;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: an exit visa that was issued by the Government of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics to its citizens who were compelled to relinquish their Soviet nationality in order to emigrate from that country;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British National (Overseas), as a person born, naturalized or registered in Hong Kong;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China; or

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British Subject.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a person who is a protected person within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act and holds a permanent resident visa when it is not possible for the person to obtain a passport or an identity or travel document referred to in subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2010-54, s. 1]

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: The Minister may designate, individually or by class, passports or travel or identity documents that do not constitute reliable proof of identity or nationality.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: The Minister shall consider the following factors in determining whether to designate any passport or travel or identity document, or class of passport or travel or identity document, as not being reliable proof of identity or nationality:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: the adequacy of security features incorporated into the passport or document for the purpose of deterring its misuse or unauthorized alteration, reproduction or issuance; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: information respecting the security or integrity of the process leading to the issuance of the passport or document.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: A passport or travel or identity document that has been designated under subsection (1) is not a passport or travel or identity document for the purpose of subsection 50(1) or 52(1).

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: The Minister shall make available to the public a list of all passports or travel or identity documents designated under subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: A foreign national who holds a permanent resident visa and is seeking to become a permanent resident must, at the time of their examination,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: inform the officer if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: the foreign national has become a spouse or common-law partner or has ceased to be a spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner after the visa was issued, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: material facts relevant to the issuance of the visa have changed since the visa was issued or were not divulged when it was issued; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: establish that they and their family members, whether accompanying or not, meet the requirements of the Act and these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: In addition to the other requirements of these Regulations, a foreign national seeking to become a temporary resident must hold one of the following documents that is valid for the period authorized for their stay:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport that was issued by the country of which the foreign national is a citizen or national, that does not prohibit travel to Canada and that the foreign national may use to enter the country of issue;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a travel document that was issued by the country of which the foreign national is a citizen or national, that does not prohibit travel to Canada and that the foreign national may use to enter the country of issue;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: an identity or travel document that was issued by a country, that does not prohibit travel to Canada, that the foreign national may use to enter the country of issue and that is of the type issued by that country to non-national residents, refugees or stateless persons who are unable to obtain a passport or other travel document from their country of citizenship or nationality or who have no country of citizenship or nationality;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a laissez-passer that was issued by the United Nations;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport or travel document that was issued by the Palestinian Authority;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a document that was issued by the Organization of American States and is entitled “Official Travel Document”;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British Overseas Citizen;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British National (Overseas), as a person born, naturalized or registered in Hong Kong;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China;

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British Subject; or

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: a laissez-passer that was issued by the European Union.

heading_path: PART 4 Procedures > DIVISION 3 Conduct of Examination > Documents Required
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2003-260, s. 1]
