heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: 9 points for a skilled worker 38 years of age;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: 8 points for a skilled worker 39 years of age;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: 7 points for a skilled worker 40 years of age;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: 6 points for a skilled worker 41 years of age;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: 5 points for a skilled worker 42 years of age;

own_text: 1 point for a skilled worker 46 years of age; and

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: In this section, arranged employment means an offer of employment that is made by a single employer other than an embassy, high commission or consulate in Canada or an employer who is referred to in subparagraphs 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii), that is for continuous full-time work in Canada having a duration of at least one year after the date on which a permanent resident visa is issued and that is with respect to an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2 or 3 of the National Occupational Classification .

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: Ten points shall be awarded to a skilled worker for arranged employment if they are able to perform and are likely to accept and carry out the employment and

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the skilled worker is in Canada and holds a work permit that is valid on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and, on the date on which the visa is issued, holds a valid work permit or is authorized to work in Canada under section 186 and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the work permit was issued based on a positive determination made by an officer under subsection 203(1) with respect to the skilled worker’s employment with their current employer in an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2 or 3 of the National Occupational Classification and the assessment by the Department of Employment and Social Development on the basis of which the determination was made is not suspended or revoked,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the skilled worker is working for an employer specified on the work permit, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: that employer has offered arranged employment to the skilled worker;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the skilled worker is in Canada and holds a work permit that was issued under the circumstances described in paragraph 204(a) or (c) or in section 205 and is valid on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and, on the date on which the visa is issued, holds a valid work permit or is authorized to work in Canada under section 186 and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the skilled worker is working for an employer specified on the work permit,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: that employer has offered an arranged employment to the skilled worker, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the skilled worker has accumulated at least one year of full-time work experience, or the equivalent in part-time work, over a continuous period of work for that employer;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the skilled worker does not hold a valid work permit, is not authorized to work in Canada under section 186 on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: an employer has offered arranged employment to the skilled worker, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: an officer has approved the offer of employment based on a valid assessment — provided to the officer by the Department of Employment and Social Development, on the same basis as an assessment provided for the issuance of a work permit, at the request of the employer or an officer — that the requirements set out in subsection 203(1) with respect to the offer have been met; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and on the date on which the visa is issued, the skilled worker holds a valid work permit or is authorized to work in Canada under section 186 and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the circumstances referred to in subparagraph (a)(ii) or (iii) do not apply,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the circumstances referred to in paragraph (b) do not apply, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: the circumstances referred to in subparagraphs (c)(i) and (ii) apply.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: A maximum of 10 points for adaptability shall be awarded to a skilled worker on the basis of any combination of the following elements:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for the language proficiency of the skilled worker’s accompanying spouse or common-law partner, other than a permanent resident residing in Canada or a Canadian citizen, in either official language, evaluated at at least benchmark level 4 for each of the four language skill areas, as set out in the Canadian Language Benchmarks or the Niveaux de compétence linguistique canadiens , and demonstrated by the results of a language test that is approved under subsection 74(3) from an organization or institution designated under that subsection, which results must be less than two years old on the date on which the application for a permanent resident visa is made, 5 points;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for a period of full-time study in Canada by the skilled worker of at least two academic years in a program of at least two years in duration whether or not they obtained an educational credential for completing the program and during which period they remained in good academic standing as defined by the institution, 5 points;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for a period of full-time study in Canada by the skilled worker’s accompanying spouse or common-law partner, other than a permanent resident residing in Canada or a Canadian citizen, of at least two academic years in a program of at least two years in duration whether or not the accompanying spouse or common-law partner obtained an educational credential for completing the program, and during which period the accompanying spouse or common-law partner remained in good academic standing as defined by the institution, 5 points;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for any previous period of full-time work under a work permit or authorized under section 186 of at least one year in Canada by the skilled worker in an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2 or 3 of the National Occupational Classification , 10 points;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for any previous period of full-time work under a work permit or authorized under section 186 of at least one year in Canada by the skilled worker’s accompanying spouse or common-law partner, other than a permanent resident residing in Canada or a Canadian citizen, 5 points;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for being related to, or for having an accompanying spouse or accompanying common-law partner who is related to, a person living in Canada who is described in subsection (5), 5 points; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: for being awarded points for arranged employment in Canada under subsection 82(2), 5 points.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Workers > Selection Grid
own_text: For the purposes of paragraphs (1)(b) and (b.1), full-time study means at least 15 hours of instruction per week during the academic year, authorized under a study permit or under section 188, at a secondary or post-secondary institution in Canada that is recognized by the provincial authorities responsible for registering, accrediting, supervising and regulating such institutions, including any period of training in the workplace that forms part of the course of instruction.

PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Quebec Skilled Worker Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(2) of the Act, the Quebec skilled worker class is hereby prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of their ability to become economically established in Canada.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Quebec Skilled Worker Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the Quebec skilled worker class if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Quebec Skilled Worker Class
own_text: intend to reside in the Province of Quebec; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Quebec Skilled Worker Class
own_text: are named in a Certificat de sélection du Québec issued to them by that Province.

PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(2) of the Act, the provincial nominee class is hereby prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of their ability to become economically established in Canada.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: Subject to subsection (5), a foreign national is a member of the provincial nominee class if they are named in a nomination certificate that is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: issued by the government of a province under a provincial nomination agreement that is in force between that province and the Minister at the time of nomination;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: made in accordance with the provincial selection criteria that have been approved in writing by the Minister; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: made on the basis of the foreign national’s ability to become economically established in Canada and their intention to reside in the province that has nominated them.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: The government of a province that issues the nomination certificate has the sole responsibility to evaluate, according to the provincial selection criteria that have been approved in writing by the Minister, both the foreign national’s ability to become economically established in Canada and their intention to reside in that province.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: Subject to subsection (6), a foreign national who is named in a certificate referred to in subsection (2) shall not be considered a member of the provincial nominee class if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: the nomination was based on the provision of capital by the foreign national; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: the foreign national intends to participate in, or has participated in, an immigration-linked investment scheme.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: Subsection (5) does not apply if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: the capital is provided by the foreign national to a business in the province that nominated them, other than a business operated primarily for the purpose of deriving investment income such as interest, dividends or capital gains;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: the foreign national controls or will control

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: a percentage of equity in the business equal to or greater than 33 1/3 per cent, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: an equity investment in the business of at least $1,000,000;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: the foreign national provides or will provide active and ongoing management of the business from within the province that nominated them; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: the terms of the investment in the business do not include a redemption option.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Provincial Nominee Class
own_text: The following definitions apply in this section. immigration-linked investment scheme means a strategy or plan (a) where one of the objectives of the strategy or plan is to facilitate immigration to Canada and one of the objectives of the promoters of the strategy or plan is to raise capital; or (b) where the agreement or arrangement in respect of the strategy or plan was entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring a status or privilege under the Act. ( projet de placement lié à l’immigration ) percentage of equity means (a) in respect of a sole proprietorship, 100% of the equity of the sole proprietorship controlled by a foreign national or their spouse or common-law partner; (b) in respect of a corporation, the percentage of the issued and outstanding voting shares of the capital stock of the corporation controlled by a foreign national or their spouse or common-law partner; and (c) in respect of a partnership or joint venture, the percentage of the profit or loss of the partnership or joint venture to which a foreign national or their spouse or common-law partner is entitled. ( pourcentage des capitaux propres )

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(2) of the Act, the Canadian experience class is prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of their ability to become economically established in Canada, their experience in Canada, and their intention to reside in a province other than the Province of Quebec.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the Canadian experience class if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: they have acquired in Canada, within the three years before the date on which their application for permanent residence is made, at least one year of full-time work experience, or the equivalent in part-time work experience, in one or more occupations, other than a restricted occupation, that are listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2 or 3 of the National Occupational Classification ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: during that period of employment they performed the actions described in the lead statement for the occupation as set out in the occupational descriptions of the National Occupational Classification ;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: during that period of employment they performed a substantial number of the main duties of the occupation as set out in the occupational descriptions of the National Occupational Classification , including all of the essential duties;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: they have had their proficiency in the English or French language evaluated by an organization or institution that is designated under subsection 74(3) using a language test that is approved under that subsection, the results of which must indicate that the foreign national has met the applicable threshold that is fixed by the Minister under subsection 74(1) for each of the four language skill areas; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: in the case where they have acquired the work experience referred to in paragraph (a) in more than one occupation, they meet the threshold for proficiency in the English or French language, fixed by the Minister under subsection 74(1), for the occupation in which they have acquired the greater amount of work experience in the three years referred to in paragraph (a).

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection (2),

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: any period of employment during which the foreign national was engaged in full-time study shall not be included in calculating a period of work experience;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: any period of self-employment or unauthorized work shall not be included in calculating a period of work experience; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Canadian Experience Class
own_text: the foreign national must have had temporary resident status during their period of work experience.

label: (d)

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: In this section, skilled trade occupation means an occupation, other than a restricted occupation, in any of the following groups listed in the National Occupational Classification :

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Major Group 72, technical trades and transportation officers and controllers, excluding Sub-major Group 726, transportation officers and controllers;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Major Group 73, general trades;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Major Group 82, supervisors in natural resources, agriculture and related production;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Major Group 83, occupations in natural resources and related production;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Major Group 92, processing, manufacturing and utilities supervisors and utilities operators and controllers;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Major Group 93, central control and process operators and aircraft assembly assemblers and inspectors, excluding Sub-major Group 932, aircraft assemblers and aircraft assembly inspectors;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Minor Group 6320, cooks, butchers and bakers; and

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: Unit Group 62200, chefs.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(2) of the Act, the federal skilled trades class is prescribed as a class of persons who are skilled trades workers and who may become permanent residents on the basis of their ability to become economically established in Canada in a skilled trade occupation and their intention to reside in a province other than the Province of Quebec.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the federal skilled trades class if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have had their proficiency in the English or French language evaluated by an organization or institution that is designated under subsection 74(3) using a language test that is approved under that subsection, the results of which must indicate that the foreign national has met the applicable threshold that is fixed by the Minister under subsection 74(1) for each of the four language skill areas;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have, during the five years before the date on which their permanent resident visa application is made, acquired at least two years of full-time work experience, or the equivalent in part-time work, in the skilled trade occupation specified in the application after becoming qualified to independently practice the occupation, and during that period of employment has performed

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the actions described in the lead statement for the occupation as set out in the occupational descriptions of the National Occupational Classification , and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: a substantial number of the main duties listed in the description of the occupation set out in the National Occupational Classification , including all of the essential duties;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have met the relevant employment requirements of the skilled trade occupation specified in the application as set out in the National Occupational Classification , except for the requirement to obtain a certificate of qualification issued by a competent provincial authority; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they meet at least one of the following requirements:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they hold a certificate of qualification issued by a competent provincial or federal authority in the skilled trade occupation specified in the application for a permanent resident visa,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they are in Canada and hold a work permit that is valid on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and, on the date on which the visa is issued, hold a valid work permit or are authorized to work in Canada under section 186 and

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the work permit was issued based on a positive determination made by an officer under subsection 203(1) with respect to their employment with their current employer in a skilled trade occupation and the assessment by the Department of Employment and Social Development on the basis of which the determination was made is not suspended or revoked,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they are working for an employer specified on the work permit,

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have an offer of employment that is for continuous full-time work having a total duration of at least one year after the date on which a permanent resident visa is issued and that is in the skilled trade occupation that is specified in the application and is in the same minor group set out in the National Occupational Classification as the occupation specified on their work permit, and

label: (D)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the offer is made by up to two employers who are specified on the work permit, none of whom is an embassy, high commission or consulate in Canada or an employer who is referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii),

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they are in Canada and hold a work permit that was issued under the circumstances described in paragraph 204(a) or (c) or in section 205 and that is valid on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and, on the date on which the visa is issued, hold a valid work permit or are authorized to work in Canada under section 186 and

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they are working for an employer specified on the work permit,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have an offer of employment that is for continuous full-time work having a total duration of at least one year after the date on which a permanent resident visa is issued and that is in the skilled trade occupation that is specified in the application and is in the same minor group set out in the National Occupational Classification as the occupation specified on their work permit,

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the offer is made by up to two employers who are specified on the work permit, none of whom is an embassy, high commission or consulate in Canada or an employer who is referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii), and

label: (D)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have accumulated at least one year of full-time work experience, or the equivalent in part-time work, over a continuous period of work for the employers who made the offer,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they do not hold a valid work permit, are not authorized to work in Canada under section 186 on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: they have an offer of employment that is for continuous full-time work having a total duration of at least one year after the date on which a permanent resident visa is issued and that is in the skilled trade occupation specified in the application,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the offer is made by up to two employers, none of whom is an embassy, high commission or consulate in Canada or an employer who is referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii), and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: an officer has approved the offer of employment based on a valid assessment — provided to the officer by the Department of Employment and Social Development, on the same basis as an assessment provided for the issuance of a work permit, at the request of up to two employers or an officer — that the requirements set out in subsection 203(1) with respect to the offer have been met, and

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and on the date on which it is issued, they either hold a valid work permit or are authorized to work in Canada under section 186 and

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the circumstances referred to in clause (ii)(B) or (C) do not apply,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the circumstances referred to in subparagraph (iii) do not apply, and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: the circumstances referred to in clauses (iv)(A), (B) and (C) apply.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: If the requirements referred to in subsection (3), whether or not they are met, are not sufficient indicators of whether the foreign national will become economically established in Canada, an officer may substitute their evaluation for the requirements. This decision requires the concurrence of another officer.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Federal Skilled Trades Class
own_text: With the exception of the foreign nationals referred to in subparagraphs (3)(d)(ii), (iii) and (v), the foreign national must have, in the form of transferable and available funds, unencumbered by debts or other obligations, an amount equal to one half of the minimum necessary income applicable in respect of the group of persons consisting of the skilled trades worker and their family members.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(2) of the Act, the Atlantic immigration class is prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of their ability to become economically established in Canada.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the Atlantic immigration class if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: are named in an endorsement certificate issued by the government of an Atlantic province — on or after the day on which this section comes into force — under an Atlantic immigration agreement between that province and the Minister, which must be valid on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and must not subsequently have been revoked;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: intend to reside in the Atlantic province that issued the endorsement certificate;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: meet either the work experience requirements set out in subsections (3) and (4) or the recent graduate requirements set out in subsection (5);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: have an offer of employment that meets the requirements set out in subsections (6) and (7);

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: meet the educational requirements set out in subsection (9);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: have had their proficiency in the English or French language evaluated by an organization or institution that is designated under subsection 74(3) using a language test that is approved under that subsection, the results of which must be less than two years old on the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made and must indicate that the foreign national has met the applicable threshold that is fixed by the Minister under subsection 74(1) for each of the four language skill areas; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: have — unless they are authorized to work and already working in Canada — in the form of transferable and available funds, unencumbered by debts or other obligations, an amount equal to one eighth of the amount identified, in the most recent edition of the publication concerning low-income cut-offs published annually by Statistics Canada under the Statistics Act , for urban areas of residence of 500,000 persons or more, as the minimum amount of before-tax annual income that is necessary to support a group of persons equal in number to the total number of the applicant and their family members.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: A foreign national meets the work experience requirements if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: they have acquired, within the five years before the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made, at least one year of full-time work experience, or the equivalent in part-time work experience, in at least one of the occupations, other than a restricted occupation, that are listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 of the National Occupational Classification ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: during that period of employment they performed the actions described in the lead statement for the occupation as set out in the occupational descriptions of the National Occupational Classification ; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: during that period of employment they performed a substantial number of the main duties of the occupation as set out in the occupational descriptions of the National Occupational Classification , including all of the essential duties.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (3)(a),

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: any period of self-employment is not included in calculating a period of work experience; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: any period of work acquired in Canada is not included in calculating a period of work experience, unless the foreign national was authorized to work and had temporary resident status during that period.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: A foreign national meets the recent graduate requirements if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: obtained, as a full-time student, within the two years before the date on which their application for a permanent resident visa is made, a post-secondary educational credential issued by an institution in an Atlantic province that is set out in the document entitled Recognized Post-Secondary Institutions – Atlantic Immigration Program , published by the Minister, as amended from time to time, on the completion of a program of study that was

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: of at least two years in duration,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: not devoted primarily to the study of English or French as a second language, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: undertaken primarily as in-person learning;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: were physically present in the Atlantic province for at least 16 months during the two years preceding the day on which that credential was issued;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: had temporary resident status for the entire period of study working toward the credential and any work or study completed during that period was authorized; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: were not in receipt of a scholarship or fellowship that was conditional on their return to another country at the conclusion of their studies.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: The offer of employment must meet the following requirements:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: it must be for continuous full-time work having a duration that is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: indeterminate, in the case of an offer for employment in an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 4 of the National Occupational Classification , or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: of at least one year after the date on which a permanent resident visa is issued, in any other case;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: it must be for employment that the foreign national is able to perform and is likely to accept and carry out;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: it must be made by the employer named in the endorsement certificate, and that employer must not be referred to in any of subparagraphs 200(3)(h)(i) to (iii) or more than 50% owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by the foreign national or their spouse or common-law partner; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: it must be for employment in an occupation that

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: is listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 of the National Occupational Classification , in the case of a foreign national who meets the recent graduate requirements,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: corresponds to unit group 33102 or 44101 of the National Occupational Classification , in the case of a foreign national who meets the work experience requirements set out in paragraph (3)(a) based on experience in an occupation that corresponds to unit group 31301 or 32101 of the National Occupational Classification , or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: is listed in a TEER category in the National Occupational Classification that is at the same level or a higher level than the occupation in which most of the work experience relied on for the purpose of paragraph (3)(a) was acquired, in any other case.

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2022-220, s. 9]

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: For the purposes of subparagraph (6)(d)(iii),

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: TEER Category 0 in the National Occupational Classification is at a higher level than TEER Category 1;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: TEER Category 1 is at a higher level than TEER Categories 2 and 3;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: TEER Categories 2 and 3 are at the same level; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: TEER Categories 2 and 3 are at a higher level than TEER Category 4.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2022-220, s. 9]

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: A foreign national meets the educational requirements if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who has an offer of employment in an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 0 or 1 of the National Occupational Classification , they hold a post-secondary Canadian educational credential from a program of study of a duration of at least one year or a foreign diploma, certificate or credential supported by an equivalency assessment — which must be less than five years old on the date on which their application is made — establishing that the foreign diploma, certificate or credential is equivalent to such a Canadian educational credential; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Atlantic Immigration Class
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who has an offer of employment in an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 2, 3 or 4 of the National Occupational Classification , they hold a Canadian educational credential or a foreign diploma, certificate or credential supported by an equivalency assessment, which must be less than five years old on the date on which their application is made.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(2) of the Act, the rural community immigration class is prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of their ability to become economically established in Canada.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the rural community immigration class if they demonstrate that they meet all of the following requirements from the date on which they apply for permanent resident status until they obtain that status:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they intend to reside within the geographic boundaries of a Canadian community that is designated by the Minister under section 87.41;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they have a valid certificate of recommendation issued by an economic development organization in accordance with section 87.44;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they meet the work experience requirements set out in subsection 87.45(1) or are exempt from them under subsection 87.45(3);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they have an eligible offer of employment that meets the requirements set out in section 87.46;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they hold, as evidence of their education, either

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a Canadian educational credential, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a foreign diploma, certificate or credential that is at least equivalent to a Canadian secondary school diploma and an equivalency assessment that is less than five years old on the date on which they apply for permanent resident status;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they have had their proficiency in English or French evaluated by an organization or institution that is designated under subsection 74(3) using a language test that is approved under that subsection, the results of which must be less than two years old on the date on which they apply for permanent resident status and must indicate that the foreign national has met the applicable threshold that is fixed by the Minister under subsection 74(1) for each of the four language skill areas;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they have — unless they are authorized to work and already working in Canada on the date on which they apply for permanent resident status — in the form of transferable and available funds, unencumbered by debts or other obligations, an amount equal to one half of the amount identified, in the most recent edition of the publication concerning low-income cut-offs published annually by Statistics Canada under the Statistics Act , for rural areas outside census metropolitan areas or census agglomerations, as the minimum amount of before-tax annual income that is necessary to support a group of persons equal in number to the total number of the applicant and their family members, whether their family members are accompanying them or not;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: if they are in Canada, they have valid temporary resident status.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The Minister may designate a community outside of Quebec if it is rural, taking into consideration demographic, geographic and other factors.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The factors the Minister may consider when deciding whether to designate a rural community include

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the economic circumstances of the community;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the community’s capacity to welcome and settle new immigrants; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the community’s administrative capacity to participate in the rural community immigration program.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The Minister must make the names of communities that are designated available on the Department’s website.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The Minister may designate economic development organizations for the purpose of making recommendations with respect to foreign nationals who wish to apply for the rural community immigration class with respect to a designated community.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: For greater certainty, the designation does not make an organization an agent of His Majesty or a Crown corporation , as defined in section 2 of the Financial Administration Act , and does not make its officers and employees members of the federal public administration.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: An economic development organization ceases to be designated if it does not establish a list of priority sectors and occupations that, in its opinion, will best contribute to economic development in the designated community and review and submit that list to the Minister annually.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: To maintain its designation, an economic development organization must not charge fees for

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: designating an employer or revoking the designation of an employer under section 87.43; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: issuing, amending or revoking a certificate of recommendation.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: An economic development organization must designate an employer as eligible to participate in the rural community immigration program if the employer applies to be designated and meets all of the following criteria:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it carries on a genuine business

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: that has been in continuous active operation under the same ownership for at least two years within the designated community with respect to which the economic development organization is designated, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: that has been in continuous active operation in any location and that, in the opinion of the economic development organization, either will make a substantial contribution to the designated community’s economy by continuing operations in the community or relocating to it or has already made such a substantial contribution;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it carries on business in relation to at least one sector or occupation that is set out in the priority list established by the economic development organization;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a representative of the employer has successfully completed intercultural competency training;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a representative of the employer has successfully completed onboarding training;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it commits to supporting the settlement of each foreign national to whom it makes an eligible offer of employment and any accompanying family members, including by facilitating access to settlement support;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it is not in contravention of worker protection laws;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it is not

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a designated economic development organization,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a consulate,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: an employer referred to in paragraph 200(3)(g.1) or (h),

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a business that recruits individuals in order to establish a pool of candidates who are intended to be transferred or contracted to other businesses, or

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a business owned in whole or in part by a member of a law society of a province or the Chambre des notaires du Québec who provides services related to immigration or by a member of the College , as defined in section 2 of the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants Act .

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: An economic development organization may revoke the designation of an employer if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the economic development organization becomes aware that an order has been made against the designated employer or an administrative monetary penalty has been imposed on it because it is in violation of the employer compliance regime established under the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the economic development organization becomes aware of misrepresentation in the employer’s application for designation or application for a certificate of recommendation or in an eligible offer of employment;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the economic development organization becomes aware that a body responsible for the administration of worker protection laws has found the designated employer to be non-compliant with those laws;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the economic development organization becomes aware that the designated employer no longer meets the designation criteria set out in subsection (1);

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the designated employer or any person who recruits a foreign national for the designated employer has, directly or indirectly, charged or recovered fees from the foreign national; or

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the designated employer has voluntarily requested to withdraw from participating in the rural community immigration program.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: In this section, worker protection laws means any federal or provincial laws that protect human rights or regulate the employment or recruitment of employees in a province in which the employer carries on business.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: An economic development organization may issue a certificate of recommendation to a foreign national if a designated employer applies for a certificate with respect to the foreign national and the economic development organization is satisfied that the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: has an eligible offer of employment that meets the requirements set out in section 87.46 and the eligible offer

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: is for work in a sector or occupation that is set out in the priority list established by the economic development organization,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: sets out a wage that is at least as high as the highest of

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the applicable minimum wage,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the lowest wage in the range of wages set out in the Job Bank website of the Canada Employment Insurance Commission for the occupation referred to in the offer, and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: any higher wage that the economic development organization has established as an acceptable wage on the basis of the local labour market, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: is supported by documentation of recruitment efforts and any other supplementary documentation that is necessary to demonstrate that the offer of employment is an eligible offer of employment referred to in section 87.46;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: has the required work experience for the TEER Category of the occupation listed in the eligible offer of employment as set out in subsection 87.45(1) or is exempt from the required work experience under subsection 87.45(3);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: holds, as evidence of their education, either

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a Canadian educational credential, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: a foreign diploma, certificate or credential that is at least equivalent to a Canadian secondary school diploma and an equivalency assessment that is less than five years old on the date on which the economic development organization expects they will apply for permanent resident status;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: have had their proficiency in English or French evaluated by an organization or institution that is designated under subsection 74(3) using a language test that is approved under that subsection, the results of which must be less than two years old on the date on which the economic development organization expects they will apply for permanent resident status and must indicate that the foreign national has met the applicable threshold that is fixed by the Minister under subsection 74(1) for each of the four language skill areas; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: intends to reside in the community with respect to which the economic development organization is designated.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: When issuing a certificate of recommendation, an economic development organization may prioritize applications in order to maximize economic development in a community with respect to which it is designated and to meet the needs of the local labour market. This prioritization may be based on a foreign national’s occupation, wage, work experience, language proficiency in English or French, education and connection to that community.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The economic development organization must revoke a certificate of recommendation if it becomes aware that the foreign national did not meet the criteria set out in subsection (1) at the time the certificate was issued or no longer meets those criteria at any time before they obtain permanent resident status.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: If a foreign national obtains a new eligible offer of employment in accordance with subsection 87.46(3), the economic development organization may amend a certificate of recommendation to be based on the new eligible offer of employment.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The economic development organization must revoke a certificate of recommendation if it is based on an eligible offer of employment from an employer whose designation has been revoked.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: A certificate of recommendation is valid until the earlier of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the first anniversary of the day on which it is issued, and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the day on which the economic development organization revokes it.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: A foreign national meets the work experience requirement if they have work experience that satisfies the criteria set out in subsection (2) in one of the following occupations:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: for an eligible offer of employment in TEER Category 0 or 1, an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 0, 1, 2 or 3;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: for an eligible offer of employment in TEER Category 2, an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 1, 2, 3 or 4;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: for an eligible offer of employment in unit group 33102 or 44101 of the National Occupational Classification , an occupation that corresponds to unit group 31301 of the National Occupational Classification or that is listed in TEER Category 2, 3 or 4;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: for any other eligible offer of employment in TEER Category 3 or 4, an occupation that is listed in TEER Category 2, 3 or 4;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: for an eligible offer of employment in TEER Category 5, an occupation that is in the same National Occupational Classification unit group as the offer.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The work experience must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: total at least one year of full-time work, or the equivalent in part-time work, in an occupation listed in the National Occupational Classification ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: have been acquired in the three years before the day on which the foreign national applies for permanent resident status or, if the foreign national has not yet applied for that status, the day on which the economic development organization expects they will apply;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: include the performance of the actions described in the lead statement for the occupation as set out in the National Occupational Classification ;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: include the performance of a substantial number of the main duties of the occupation as set out in the National Occupational Classification ;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: include only work that was done in the employ of a third party, unless it was acquired as a medical practitioner entitled to practise medicine under the laws of the jurisdiction in which it was acquired; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: if it was acquired in Canada, have been acquired while the foreign national was authorized to work in Canada and had temporary resident status.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The work experience requirement does not apply to a foreign national who obtained an eligible credential from a post-secondary program and who meets all of the following requirements:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they were authorized to study in Canada and had temporary resident status during the entire period of training or study;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they were enrolled as a full-time student during the entire period of the program;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: they obtained the credential during the 18-month period that preceded the day on which they applied for permanent resident status or, if the foreign national has not yet applied for that status, the day on which the economic development organization expects they will apply;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who completed a master’s or doctoral degree program of less than two years in duration, the foreign national was physically present in the designated community where the offered employment is located during the entire period of the program;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who completed a post-secondary program other than one referred to in paragraph (d), the program was of at least two years in duration and, during the 24-month period that immediately preceded the day on which the eligible credential was obtained, the foreign national was physically present for at least 16 months in the designated community where the offered employment is located.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: In subsection (3), eligible credential means a degree, diploma, certificate, trade credential or apprenticeship credential from a Canadian public post-secondary institution in the designated community where the offered employment is located, but does not include a credential obtained in a study or training program

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: in which the study of English or French as a second language amounted to more than half of the credits required to complete the program;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: in which distance learning amounted to more than half of the credits required to complete the program; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: for which the foreign national received a scholarship or fellowship that stipulated that they must return to their home country to apply the knowledge and skills gained there.

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: An offer of employment is eligible if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it is made by an employer that

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: is a designated employer under subsection 87.43(1) at the time the offer is made,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: is actively engaged in the business in respect of which the offer is made, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: is not a business in which a majority of voting or ownership interests are held, either individually or collectively, by the foreign national or their spouse or common-law partner or that is controlled, directly or indirectly, by the foreign national or their spouse or common-law partner;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it is consistent with the reasonable employment needs of the designated employer;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it contains terms that the designated employer is reasonably able to fulfill;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it promises a wage above or within the range of wages set out in the Job Bank website of the Canada Employment Insurance Commission for the occupation referred to in the offer;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it does not require proficiency in a language other than English or French as a condition of employment; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: it offers employment

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: that is non-seasonal, full-time and for a continuous and indeterminate period,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: that requires at least 75% of work hours to be spent in the designated community, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: that the foreign national has the qualifications and ability to perform and is likely to accept and carry out, as indicated by their past work experience or education related to the lead statement and main duties of the occupation as set out in the National Occupational Classification .

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The Minister may conclude that an offer of employment is not eligible if the designated employer is found to have contravened worker protection laws , as defined in subsection 87.43(3).

heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: The eligible offer of employment that was first submitted with a foreign national’s application for permanent resident status must be used to evaluate the application, unless the foreign national receives a new eligible offer of employment from a different designated employer, in the following circumstances:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: after the application is made, the employer who made the existing offer of employment becomes an employer referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: the foreign national is working for the employer under a work permit and, after the application is made, a new work permit is issued to the applicant in the circumstances described in subsection 207.1(1); or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 6 Economic Classes > DIVISION 1 Skilled Workers > Rural Community Immigration Class
own_text: an economic development organization revokes the employer’s designation and the foreign national did not contribute to the actions of the employer that led to the revocation.
