heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(1) of the Act, the family class is hereby prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of the requirements of this Division.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the family class if, with respect to a sponsor, the foreign national is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a dependent child of the sponsor;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the sponsor’s mother or father;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the mother or father of the sponsor’s mother or father;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2005-61, s. 3]

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a person whose parents are deceased, who is under 18 years of age, who is not a spouse or common-law partner and who is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a child of the sponsor’s mother or father,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a child of a child of the sponsor’s mother or father, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a child of the sponsor’s child;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a person under 18 years of age whom the sponsor intends to adopt in Canada if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption is not being entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring any status or privilege under the Act,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: where the adoption is an international adoption, the country in which the person resides is a party to the Hague Convention on Adoption and the Convention applies to their province of intended destination, the competent authority of the country and of the province have approved the adoption in writing as conforming to that Convention, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: where the adoption is an international adoption and the country in which the person resides is not a party to the Hague Convention on Adoption or the Convention does not apply to the person’s province of intended destination

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the person has been placed for adoption in the country in which they reside or is otherwise legally available in that country for adoption and there is no evidence that the intended adoption is for the purpose of child trafficking or undue gain within the meaning of the Hague Convention on Adoption, and

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the competent authority of the person’s province of intended destination has stated in writing that it does not object to the adoption; or

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a relative of the sponsor, regardless of age, if the sponsor does not have a spouse, a common-law partner, a conjugal partner, a child, a mother or father, a relative who is a child of that mother or father, a relative who is a child of a child of that mother or father, a mother or father of that mother or father or a relative who is a child of the mother or father of that mother or father

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: who is a Canadian citizen, Indian or permanent resident, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: whose application to enter and remain in Canada as a permanent resident the sponsor may otherwise sponsor.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A foreign national who is the adopted child of a sponsor and whose adoption took place when the child was under the age of 18 shall not be considered a member of the family class by virtue of the adoption unless

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption was in the best interests of the child within the meaning of the Hague Convention on Adoption; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption was not entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring any status or privilege under the Act.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: The adoption referred to in subsection (2) is considered to be in the best interests of a child if it took place under the following circumstances:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a competent authority has conducted or approved a home study of the adoptive parents;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: before the adoption, the child’s parents gave their free and informed consent to the child’s adoption;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption created a genuine parent-child relationship;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption was in accordance with the laws of the place where the adoption took place;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption was in accordance with the laws of the sponsor’s place of residence and, if the sponsor resided in Canada at the time the adoption took place, the competent authority of the child’s province of intended destination has stated in writing that it does not object to the adoption;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: if the adoption is an international adoption, the country in which the adoption took place is a party to the Hague Convention on Adoption and the Convention applies to the child’s province of intended destination, the competent authority of the country and of the province have stated in writing that they approve the adoption as conforming to that Convention; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: if the adoption is an international adoption and the country in which the adoption took place is not a party to the Hague Convention on Adoption or the Convention does not apply to the child’s province of intended destination, there is no evidence that the adoption is for the purpose of child trafficking or undue gain within the meaning of that Convention.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A foreign national who is the adopted child of a sponsor and whose adoption took place when the child was 18 years of age or older shall not be considered a member of the family class by virtue of that adoption unless it took place under the following circumstances:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption was in accordance with the laws of the place where the adoption took place and, if the sponsor resided in Canada at the time of the adoption, the adoption was in accordance with the laws of the province where the sponsor then resided, if any, that applied in respect of the adoption of a child 18 years of age or older;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a genuine parent-child relationship existed at the time of the adoption and existed before the child reached the age of 18; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the adoption was not entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring any status or privilege under the Act.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2005-61, s. 3]

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2005-61, s. 3]

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: If a statement referred to in clause (1)(g)(iii)(B) or paragraph (3)(e) or (f) has been provided to an officer by the competent authority of the foreign national’s province of intended destination, that statement is, except in the case of an adoption that was entered into primarily for the purpose of acquiring any status or privilege under the Act, conclusive evidence that the foreign national meets the following applicable requirements:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2005-61, s. 3]

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: in the case of a person referred to in paragraph (1)(g), the requirements set out in clause (1)(g)(iii)(A); and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: in the case of a person referred to in paragraph (1)(b) who is an adopted child described in subsection (2), the requirements set out in paragraphs (3)(a) to (e) and (g).

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: If, after the statement is provided to the officer, the officer receives evidence that the foreign national does not meet the applicable requirements set out in paragraph (7)(b) or (c) for becoming a member of the family class, the processing of their application shall be suspended until the officer provides that evidence to the competent authority of the province and that authority confirms or revises its statement.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A foreign national shall not be considered a member of the family class by virtue of their relationship to a sponsor if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s conjugal partner and is under 18 years of age;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, the sponsor has an existing sponsorship undertaking in respect of a spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner and the period referred to in subsection 132(1) in respect of that undertaking has not ended;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the sponsor or the foreign national was, at the time of their marriage, the spouse of another person, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the sponsor has lived separate and apart from the foreign national for at least one year and

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the sponsor is the common-law partner of another person or the sponsor has a conjugal partner, or

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the foreign national is the common-law partner of another person or the conjugal partner of another sponsor; or

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse and if at the time the marriage ceremony was conducted either one or both of the spouses were not physically present unless the foreign national was marrying a person who was not physically present at the ceremony as a result of their service as a member of the Canadian Forces and the marriage is valid both under the laws of the jurisdiction where it took place and under Canadian law;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: subject to subsection (10), the sponsor previously made an application for permanent residence and became a permanent resident and, at the time of that application, the foreign national was a non-accompanying family member of the sponsor and was not examined.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: Subject to subsection (11), paragraph (9)(d) does not apply in respect of a foreign national referred to in that paragraph who was not examined because an officer determined that they were not required by the Act or the former Act, as applicable, to be examined.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: Paragraph (9)(d) applies in respect of a foreign national referred to in subsection (10) if an officer determines that, at the time of the application referred to in that paragraph,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the sponsor was informed that the foreign national could be examined and the sponsor was able to make the foreign national available for examination but did not do so or the foreign national did not appear for examination; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the foreign national was the sponsor’s spouse, was living separate and apart from the sponsor and was not examined.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: In subsection (10), former Act has the same meaning as in section 187 of the Act.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A foreign national who is an adopted dependent child or is a person referred to in paragraph 117(1)(f) or (g) shall not be issued a permanent resident visa as a member of the family class unless the sponsor has provided a statement in writing confirming that they have obtained information about the medical condition of the child or of the foreign national.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A decision shall not be made on an application for a permanent resident visa by a member of the family class if the sponsor withdraws their sponsorship application in respect of that member.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: For the purposes of Part 5,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a permanent resident visa shall not be issued to a foreign national who makes an application as a member of the family class or to their accompanying family members unless a sponsorship undertaking in respect of the foreign national and those family members is in effect; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: a foreign national who makes an application as a member of the family class and their accompanying family members shall not become permanent residents unless a sponsorship undertaking in respect of the foreign national and those family members is in effect and the sponsor who gave that undertaking still meets the requirements of section 133 and, if applicable, section 137.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: Subject to subsection 25.1(1), a person who is a member of the family class or a family member of a member of the family class who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 must be a family member of the applicant or of the sponsor both at the time the application is made and at the time of the determination of the application.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: A foreign national who is an accompanying family member of a person who makes an application as a member of the family class shall become a permanent resident if, following an examination, it is established that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the person who made the application has become a permanent resident; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 1 Family Class
own_text: the family member is not inadmissible.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 12(1) of the Act, the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class is hereby prescribed as a class of persons who may become permanent residents on the basis of the requirements of this Division.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: A foreign national is a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: are the spouse or common-law partner of a sponsor and cohabit with that sponsor in Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: have temporary resident status in Canada; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: are the subject of a sponsorship application.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: A foreign national shall not be considered a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class by virtue of their relationship to the sponsor if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2023-249, s. 7]

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse or common-law partner, the sponsor has an existing sponsorship undertaking in respect of a spouse or common-law partner and the period referred to in subsection 132(1) in respect of that undertaking has not ended;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the sponsor or the spouse was, at the time of their marriage, the spouse of another person, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the sponsor has lived separate and apart from the foreign national for at least one year and

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the sponsor is the common-law partner of another person or the sponsor has a conjugal partner, or

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the foreign national is the common-law partner of another person or the conjugal partner of another sponsor;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse and if at the time the marriage ceremony was conducted either one or both of the spouses were not physically present unless the foreign national was married to a person who was not physically present at the ceremony as a result of their service as a member of the Canadian Forces and the marriage is valid both under the laws of the jurisdiction where it took place and under Canadian law; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: subject to subsection (2), the sponsor previously made an application for permanent residence and became a permanent resident and, at the time of that application, the foreign national was a non-accompanying family member of the sponsor and was not examined.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: Subject to subsection (3), paragraph (1)(d) does not apply in respect of a foreign national referred to in that paragraph who was not examined because an officer determined that they were not required by the Act or the former Act, as applicable, to be examined.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: Paragraph (1)(d) applies in respect of a foreign national referred to in subsection (2) if an officer determines that, at the time of the application referred to in that paragraph,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the sponsor was informed that the foreign national could be examined and the sponsor was able to make the foreign national available for examination but did not do so or the foreign national did not appear for examination; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the foreign national was the sponsor’s spouse, was living separate and apart from the sponsor and was not examined.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: In subsection (2), former Act has the same meaning as in section 187 of the Act.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: A decision shall not be made on an application for permanent residence by a foreign national as a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class if the sponsor withdraws their sponsorship application in respect of that foreign national.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: For the purposes of Part 5, a foreign national who makes an application as a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class and their accompanying family members shall not become a permanent resident unless a sponsorship undertaking in respect of the foreign national and those family members is in effect and the sponsor who gave that undertaking still meets the requirements of section 133 and, if applicable, section 137.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: The requirements with respect to a person who is a family member of a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class who makes an application under Division 6 of Part 5 are the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: subject to subsection 25.1(1), the person is a family member of the applicant both at the time the application is made and at the time of the determination of the application; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: at the time it is made, the application includes a request for the family member to remain in Canada as a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: A foreign national who is an accompanying family member of a person who makes an application as a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class shall become a permanent resident if, following an examination, it is established that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the person who made the application has become a permanent resident; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 2 Spouse or Common-Law Partner in Canada Class
own_text: the family member is not inadmissible.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), a sponsor, for the purpose of sponsoring a foreign national who makes an application for a permanent resident visa as a member of the family class or an application to remain in Canada as a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class under subsection 13(1) of the Act, must be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: is at least 18 years of age;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: resides in Canada; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: has filed a sponsorship application in respect of a member of the family class or the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class in accordance with section 10.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: A sponsor who is a Canadian citizen and does not reside in Canada may sponsor a foreign national who makes an application referred to in subsection (1) and is the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner, conjugal partner or dependent child who has no dependent children, if the sponsor will reside in Canada when the foreign national becomes a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: A sponsor who became a permanent resident or a Canadian citizen after being sponsored as a spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner under subsection 13(1) of the Act may not sponsor a foreign national referred to in subsection (1) as a spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, unless the sponsor has been a permanent resident, or a Canadian citizen, or a combination of the two, for a period of at least five years immediately preceding the day on which a sponsorship application referred to in paragraph (1)(c) is filed by the sponsor in respect of the foreign national.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: The sponsor’s undertaking shall be given

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: to the Minister; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the sponsor resides in a province that has entered into an agreement referred to in subsection 8(1) of the Act that enables the province to determine and apply financial criteria with respect to sponsorship undertakings and to administer sponsorship undertakings, to the competent authority of the province.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), the sponsor’s undertaking obliges the sponsor to reimburse Her Majesty in right of Canada or a province for every benefit provided as social assistance to or on behalf of the sponsored foreign national and their family members during the period

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: beginning

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national enters Canada with a temporary resident permit, on the day of that entry,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is in Canada, on the day on which the foreign national obtains a temporary resident permit following an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in any other case, on the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: ending

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, on the last day of the period of three years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a dependent child of the sponsor or of the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, or is a person referred to in paragraph 117(1)(g), and is less than 22 years of age on the day on which he or she becomes a permanent resident, on the earlier of

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the last day of the period of 10 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident, and

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the day on which the foreign national attains 25 years of age,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a dependent child of the sponsor or of the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner and is 22 years of age or older on the day on which he or she becomes a permanent resident, on the last day of the period of three years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: on the last day of the period of 20 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident, if the foreign national is

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s mother or father,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the mother or father of the sponsor’s mother or father, or

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: an accompanying family member of the foreign national described in clause (A) or (B), and

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a person other than a person referred to in subparagraph (i), (ii), (iii) or (iv), on the last day of the period of 10 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: In the case of an undertaking to a competent authority of a province referred to in paragraph 131(b), the period referred to in subsection (1) shall end not later than

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, on the last day of the period of three years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a dependent child of the sponsor or of the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, or is a person referred to in paragraph 117(1)(g), and is less than 22 years of age on the day on which he or she becomes a permanent resident, the later of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the day on which the foreign national attains 22 years of age, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the last day of the period of 10 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a dependent child of the sponsor or of the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner and is 22 years of age or older on the day on which he or she becomes a permanent resident, on the last day of the period of 10 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: on the last day of the period of 20 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident, if the foreign national is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s mother or father,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the mother or father of the sponsor’s mother or father, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: an accompanying family member of the foreign national described in subparagraph (i) or (ii); and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the foreign national is a person other than a person referred to in paragraphs (a) to (d), on the last day of the period of 10 years following the day on which the foreign national becomes a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Despite subsection (2), the period referred to in subsection (1) shall end not later than the day provided for by the laws of the province if that day is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in paragraph (2)(a), earlier than the last day referred to in that paragraph;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in paragraph (2)(b), earlier than the later of the days referred to in subparagraph (2)(b)(i) and (ii);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in paragraph (2)(c), earlier than the last day referred to in that paragraph;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in paragraph (2)(d), earlier than the last day referred to in that paragraph; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in paragraph (2)(e), earlier than the last day referred to in that paragraph.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Subject to paragraph 137(c), if the person is to be sponsored as a member of the family class or of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class and is 22 years of age or older, or is less than 22 years of age and is the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner, the sponsor, the co-signer, if any, and the person must, before the sponsorship application is approved, enter into a written agreement that includes

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a statement by the sponsor and the co-signer, if any, that they will provide for the basic requirements of the person and their accompanying family members during the applicable period referred to in subsection (1);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a declaration by the sponsor and the co-signer, if any, that their financial obligations do not prevent them from honouring their agreement with the person and their undertaking to the Minister in respect of the person’s application; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a statement by the person that they will make every reasonable effort to provide for their own basic requirements as well as those of their accompanying family members.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Subject to paragraph 137(c), the sponsor’s undertaking may be co-signed by the spouse or common-law partner of the sponsor if the spouse or common-law partner meets the requirements set out in subsection 130(1), except paragraph 130(1)(c), and those set out in subsection 133(1), except paragraph 133(1)(a), and, in that case,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s income shall be calculated in accordance with paragraph 134(1)(b) or (c) or (1.1)(b), as applicable; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the co-signing spouse or common-law partner is jointly and severally or solidarily bound with the sponsor to perform the obligations in the undertaking and is jointly and severally or solidarily liable with the sponsor for any breach of those obligations.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: A sponsorship application shall only be approved by an officer if, on the day on which the application was filed and from that day until the day a decision is made with respect to the application, there is evidence that the sponsor

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: is a sponsor as described in section 130;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: intends to fulfil the obligations in the sponsorship undertaking;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: is not subject to a removal order;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: is not detained in any penitentiary, jail, reformatory or prison;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: has not been convicted under the Criminal Code of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: an offence of a sexual nature, or an attempt or a threat to commit such an offence, against any person,

label: (i.1)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: an indictable offence involving the use of violence and punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of at least 10 years, or an attempt to commit such an offence, against any person, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: an offence that results in bodily harm, as defined in section 2 of the Criminal Code , to any of the following persons or an attempt or a threat to commit such an offence against any of the following persons:

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a current or former family member of the sponsor,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a relative of the sponsor, as well as a current or former family member of that relative,

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a relative of the family member of the sponsor, or a current or former family member of that relative,

label: (D)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a current or former conjugal partner of the sponsor,

label: (E)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a current or former family member of a family member or conjugal partner of the sponsor,

label: (F)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a relative of the conjugal partner of the sponsor, or a current or former family member of that relative,

label: (G)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a child under the current or former care and control of the sponsor, their current or former family member or conjugal partner,

label: (H)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a child under the current or former care and control of a relative of the sponsor or a current or former family member of that relative, or

label: (I)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: someone the sponsor is dating or has dated, whether or not they have lived together, or a family member of that person;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: has not been convicted outside Canada of an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence referred to in paragraph (e);

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: subject to paragraph 137(c), is not in default of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any sponsorship undertaking, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any support payment obligations ordered by a court;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: is not in default in respect of the repayment of any debt referred to in subsection 145(1) of the Act payable to Her Majesty in right of Canada;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: subject to paragraph 137(c), is not an undischarged bankrupt under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act ;

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the sponsor resides

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in a province other than a province referred to in paragraph 131(b),

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: has a total income that is at least equal to the minimum necessary income, if the sponsorship application was filed in respect of a foreign national other than a foreign national referred to in clause (B), or

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: has a total income that is at least equal to the minimum necessary income, plus 30%, for each of the three consecutive taxation years immediately preceding the date of filing of the sponsorship application, if the sponsorship application was filed in respect of a foreign national who is

label: (I)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s mother or father,

label: (II)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the mother or father of the sponsor’s mother or father, or

label: (III)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: an accompanying family member of the foreign national described in subclause (I) or (II), and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in a province referred to in paragraph 131(b), is able, within the meaning of the laws of that province and as determined by the competent authority of that province, to fulfil the undertaking referred to in that paragraph; and

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: is not in receipt of social assistance for a reason other than disability.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Despite paragraph (1)(e), a sponsorship application may not be refused

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: on the basis of a conviction in Canada in respect of which a pardon has been granted and has not ceased to have effect or been revoked under the Criminal Records Act , or in respect of which there has been a final determination of an acquittal; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if a period of five years or more has elapsed since the completion of the sentence imposed for an offence in Canada referred to in paragraph (1)(e).

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Despite paragraph (1)(f), a sponsorship application may not be refused

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: on the basis of a conviction outside Canada in respect of which there has been a final determination of an acquittal; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if a period of five years or more has elapsed since the completion of the sentence imposed for an offence outside Canada referred to in that paragraph and the sponsor has demonstrated that they have been rehabilitated.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Paragraph (1)(j) does not apply if the sponsored person is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner and has no dependent children;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner and has a dependent child who has no dependent children; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: a dependent child of the sponsor who has no dependent children or a person referred to in paragraph 117(1)(g).

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: A person who is adopted outside Canada and whose adoption is subsequently revoked by a foreign authority or by a court in Canada of competent jurisdiction may sponsor an application for a permanent resident visa that is made by a member of the family class only if the revocation of the adoption was not obtained for the purpose of sponsoring that application.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Subject to subsection (3), for the purpose of clause 133(1)(j)(i)(A), the sponsor’s total income shall be calculated in accordance with the following rules:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s income shall be calculated on the basis of the last notice of assessment, or an equivalent document, issued by the Minister of National Revenue in respect of the most recent taxation year preceding the date of filing of the sponsorship application;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the sponsor produces a document referred to in paragraph (a), the sponsor’s income is the income earned as reported in that document less the amounts referred to in subparagraphs (c)(i) to (v);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if the sponsor does not produce a document referred to in paragraph (a), or if the sponsor’s income as calculated under paragraph (b) is less than their minimum necessary income, the sponsor’s income is the sponsor’s Canadian income earned during the 12-month period preceding the date of filing of the sponsorship application not including

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any provincial allowance received by the sponsor for a program of instruction or training,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any social assistance received by the sponsor from a province,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any financial assistance received by the sponsor from the Government of Canada under a resettlement assistance program,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any amounts paid to the sponsor under the Employment Insurance Act , other than special benefits,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any monthly guaranteed income supplement paid to the sponsor under the Old Age Security Act , and

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any Canada child benefit paid to the sponsor under the Income Tax Act ; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if there is a co-signer, the income of the co-signer, as calculated in accordance with paragraphs (a) to (c), with any modifications that the circumstances require, shall be included in the calculation of the sponsor’s income.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: Subject to subsection (3), for the purpose of clause 133(1)(j)(i)(B), the sponsor’s total income shall be calculated in accordance with the following rules:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s income shall be calculated on the basis of the income earned as reported in the notices of assessment, or an equivalent document, issued by the Minister of National Revenue in respect of each of the three consecutive taxation years immediately preceding the date of filing of the sponsorship application;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor’s income is the income earned as reported in the documents referred to in paragraph (a), not including

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any provincial allowance received by the sponsor for a program of instruction or training,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any social assistance received by the sponsor from a province,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any financial assistance received by the sponsor from the Government of Canada under a resettlement assistance program,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any amounts paid to the sponsor under the Employment Insurance Act , other than special benefits,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any monthly guaranteed income supplement paid to the sponsor under the Old Age Security Act , and

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: any Canada child benefit paid to the sponsor under the Income Tax Act ; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: if there is a co-signer, the income of the co-signer, as calculated in accordance with paragraphs (a) and (b), with any modifications that the circumstances require, shall be included in the calculation of the sponsor’s income.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: An officer may request from the sponsor, after the receipt of the sponsorship application but before a decision is made on an application for permanent residence, updated evidence of income if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the officer receives information indicating that the sponsor is no longer able to fulfil the obligations of the sponsorship undertaking; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: more than 12 months have elapsed since the receipt of the sponsorship application.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: When an officer receives the updated evidence of income requested under subsection (2), the sponsor’s total income shall be calculated in accordance with subsection (1) or (1.1), as applicable, except that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of paragraph (1)(a), the sponsor’s income shall be calculated on the basis of the last notice of assessment, or an equivalent document, issued by the Minister of National Revenue in respect of the most recent taxation year preceding the day on which the officer receives the updated evidence;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of paragraph (1)(c), the sponsor’s income is the sponsor’s Canadian income earned during the 12-month period preceding the day on which the officer receives the updated evidence; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: in the case of paragraph (1.1)(a), the sponsor’s income shall be calculated on the basis of the income earned as reported in the notices of assessment, or an equivalent document, issued by the Minister of National Revenue in respect of each of the three consecutive taxation years immediately preceding the day on which the officer receives the updated evidence.

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: For the purpose of subparagraph 133(1)(g)(i), the default of a sponsorship undertaking

heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: begins when

label: (i)

own_text: a government makes a payment that the sponsor has in the undertaking promised to repay, or

own_text: an obligation set out in the undertaking is breached; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: ends, as the case may be, when

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 7 Family Classes > DIVISION 3 Sponsors
own_text: the sponsor reimburses the government concerned, in full or in accordance with an agreement with that government, for amounts paid by it, or

own_text: the sponsor ceases to be in breach of the obligation set out in the undertaking.
