heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: any identity document issued outside Canada before the person’s entry into Canada; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: if there is a reasonable and objectively verifiable explanation related to circumstances in the applicant’s country of nationality or former habitual residence for the applicant’s inability to obtain any identity documents, a statutory declaration made by the applicant attesting to their identity, accompanied by

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: a statutory declaration attesting to the applicant’s identity made by a person who, before the applicant’s entry into Canada, knew the applicant, a family member of the applicant or the applicant’s father, mother, brother, sister, grandfather or grandmother, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: a statutory declaration attesting to the applicant’s identity made by an official of an organization representing nationals of the applicant’s country of nationality or former habitual residence.

heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: A document submitted under subsection (1) shall be accepted in lieu of a document described in any of paragraphs 50(1)(a) to (h) if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: in the case of an identity document, the identity document

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: is genuine,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: identifies the applicant, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: constitutes credible evidence of the applicant’s identity; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: in the case of a statutory declaration, the declaration

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: is consistent with any information previously provided by the applicant to the Department or the Board, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 8 Refugee Classes > DIVISION 5 Protected Persons — Permanent Residence
own_text: constitutes credible evidence of the applicant’s identity.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: An officer shall issue a temporary resident visa to a foreign national if, following an examination, it is established that the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: has applied in accordance with these Regulations for a temporary resident visa as a member of the visitor, worker or student class;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: will leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay under Division 2;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: holds a passport or other document that they may use to enter the country that issued it or another country;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: meets the requirements applicable to that class;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: is not inadmissible;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: meets the requirements of subsections 30(2) and (3), if they must submit to a medical examination under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: is not the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Holders of Temporary Resident Visas
own_text: A foreign national who holds a temporary resident visa is not authorized to enter and remain in Canada as a temporary resident unless, following an examination, it is established that the foreign national and their accompanying family members

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Holders of Temporary Resident Visas
own_text: met the requirements for issuance of their temporary resident visa at the time it was issued; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Holders of Temporary Resident Visas
own_text: continue to meet these requirements at the time of the examination on entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: An officer may cancel a temporary resident visa that was issued to a foreign national if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national is inadmissible;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national did not meet one or more of the requirements under section 179 at the time the temporary resident visa was issued or no longer meets one or more of those requirements;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national was issued, after the issuance of the temporary resident visa, a temporary resident permit under subsection 24(1) of the Act;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the officer has reasonable grounds to believe that the foreign national will not leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay under Division 2;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national was refused, after the issuance of the temporary resident visa, an electronic travel authorization, work permit or study permit or another temporary resident visa;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national is the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act; or

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the officer is satisfied that the temporary resident visa was issued based on an administrative error.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: A temporary resident visa that was issued to a foreign national is cancelled if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national becomes a permanent resident;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the passport or other travel document in respect of which the temporary resident visa was issued is lost, stolen or destroyed;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the passport or other travel document in respect of which the temporary resident visa was issued is abandoned by the foreign national; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Cancellation — Temporary Resident Visa
own_text: the foreign national is deceased.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Applications for Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Applications for Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: A foreign national may apply for an extension of their authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Applications for Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: the application is made by the end of the period authorized for their stay; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Applications for Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: they have complied with all conditions imposed on their entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Applications for Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: An officer shall extend the foreign national’s authorization to remain in Canada as a temporary resident if, following an examination, it is established that the foreign national continues to meet the requirements of section 179.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Restoration of Temporary Resident Status
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Restoration of Temporary Resident Status
own_text: On application made by a visitor, worker or student within 90 days after losing temporary resident status as a result of failing to comply with a condition imposed under paragraph 185(a), any of subparagraphs 185(b)(i) to (iii) or paragraph 185(c), an officer shall restore that status if, following an examination, it is established that the visitor, worker or student meets the initial requirements for their stay, has not failed to comply with any other conditions imposed and is not the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1 Temporary Resident Visa > Restoration of Temporary Resident Status
own_text: Despite subsection (1), an officer shall not restore the status of a student who is not in compliance with a condition set out in subsection 220.1(1).

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: If the Minister makes a declaration under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act in respect of a foreign national, the foreign national is considered to have been given notice of the declaration if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: notice is sent by mail to their last known address;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: notice is sent to their last known email address;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: notice is provided to them by hand, including at a port of entry; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: notice is sent or provided by other reasonable means, if it is not possible to give notice by one of the means referred to in paragraphs (a) to (c).

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: A foreign national who is the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act may make written submissions to the Minister as to why the declaration should be revoked or why its effective period should be shortened.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 1.1 Declaration Under Subsection 22.1(1) of the Act
own_text: The written submissions must be made within 60 days after the day on which the notice of the declaration is sent or provided to the foreign national, as the case may be.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: Subject to section 185, the following conditions are imposed on all temporary residents:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: to leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: to not work, unless authorized by this Part or Part 11;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: if authorized to work by this Part or Part 11, to not enter into an employment agreement, or extend the term of an employment agreement, with an employer who, on a regular basis, offers striptease, erotic dance, escort services or erotic massages;

label: (b.2)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: if authorized to work by this Part or Part 11, to not enter into an employment agreement, or extend the term of an employment agreement, with an employer who is referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: to not study, unless authorized by the Act, this Part or Part 12; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: to comply with all requirements imposed on them by an order or regulation made under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: Subject to subsections (3) to (5), the period authorized for the stay of a temporary resident is six months or any other period that is fixed by an officer on the basis of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the temporary resident’s means of support in Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the period for which the temporary resident applies to stay; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the expiry of the temporary resident’s passport or other travel document.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: The period authorized for the stay of a temporary resident begins on

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: if they are authorized to enter and remain in Canada on a temporary basis, the day on which they first enter Canada after they are so authorized;

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: if they have become a temporary resident in accordance with subsection 46(1.1) of the Act, the day on which their application to renounce their permanent resident status is approved; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: in any other case, the day on which they enter Canada.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: The period authorized for a temporary resident’s stay ends on the earliest of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the day on which the temporary resident leaves Canada without obtaining prior authorization to re-enter Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the day on which their permit becomes invalid, in the case of a temporary resident who has been issued either a work permit or a study permit;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the day on which the second of their permits becomes invalid, in the case of a temporary resident who has been issued a work permit and a study permit;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the day on which any temporary resident permit issued to the temporary resident is no longer valid under section 63;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: in the case of a person who is required by section 10.01 of the Act to provide their biometric information, the day on which the period of 10 years following the latest day on which the person provided their biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act ends; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the day on which the period authorized under subsection (2) ends, if paragraphs (a) to (c) do not apply.

marginal_note: Extension of period authorized for stay
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: Subject to subsection (5.1), if a temporary resident has applied for an extension of the period authorized for their stay and a decision is not made on the application by the end of the period authorized for their stay, the period is extended until

label: (a)
marginal_note: Extension of period authorized for stay
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the day on which a decision is made, if the application is refused; or

label: (b)
marginal_note: Extension of period authorized for stay
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the end of the new period authorized for their stay, if the application is allowed.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: Subsection (5) does not apply in respect of a foreign national who is the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: If the period authorized for the stay of a temporary resident is extended by operation of paragraph (5)(a) or extended under paragraph (5)(b), the temporary resident retains their status, subject to any other conditions imposed, during the extended period.

marginal_note: Condition imposed on members of a crew
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents

marginal_note: Condition imposed on members of a crew
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: A foreign national who enters Canada as a member of a crew must leave Canada within 72 hours after they cease to be a member of a crew.

marginal_note: Conditions imposed on foreign nationals who enter to become members of a crew
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: The following conditions are imposed on a foreign national who enters Canada to become a member of a crew:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Conditions imposed on foreign nationals who enter to become members of a crew
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2004-167, s. 50]

label: (b)
marginal_note: Conditions imposed on foreign nationals who enter to become members of a crew
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: to join the means of transportation within the period imposed as a condition of entry or, if no period is imposed, within 48 hours after they enter Canada; and

label: (c)
marginal_note: Conditions imposed on foreign nationals who enter to become members of a crew
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: to leave Canada within 72 hours after they cease to be a member of a crew.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: An officer may impose, vary or cancel the following specific conditions on a temporary resident:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the period authorized for their stay;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the work that they are permitted to engage in, or are prohibited from engaging in, in Canada, including

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the type of work,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the employer,

label: (ii.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the duration of the work for any one employer,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the location of the work,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the times and periods of the work, and

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: in the case of a member of a crew, the period within which they must join the means of transportation;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the studies that they are permitted to engage in, or are prohibited from engaging in, in Canada, including

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the type of studies or course,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the educational institution,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the location of the studies, and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the times and periods of the studies;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the area within which they are permitted to travel or are prohibited from travelling in Canada; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the times and places at which they must report for

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: medical examination, surveillance or treatment, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 2 Conditions on Temporary Residents
own_text: the presentation of evidence of compliance with applicable conditions.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: A foreign national may work in Canada without a work permit

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a business visitor to Canada within the meaning of section 187;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a foreign representative, if they are properly accredited by the Department of Foreign Affairs and International Trade and are in Canada to carry out official duties as a diplomatic agent, consular officer, representative or official of a country other than Canada, of the United Nations or any of its agencies or of any international organization of which Canada is a member;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: if the foreign national is a family member of a foreign representative in Canada who is accredited with diplomatic status by the Department of Foreign Affairs and International Trade and that Department has stated in writing that it does not object to the foreign national working in Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a member of the armed forces of a country that is a designated state for the purposes of the Visiting Forces Act , including a person who has been designated as a civilian component of those armed forces;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as an officer of a foreign government sent, under an exchange agreement between Canada and one or more countries, to take up duties with a federal or provincial agency;

label: (e.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a cross-border maritime law enforcement officer designated by the United States under the Framework Agreement on Integrated Cross-Border Maritime Law Enforcement Operations between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America, signed on May 26, 2009;

label: (e.2)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as an in-flight security officer employed by a foreign government with which Canada has concluded an arrangement in respect of commercial passenger aircraft security;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: if they are a full-time student, on the campus of the university or college at which they are a full-time student, for the period for which they hold a study permit to study at that university or college;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a performing artist appearing alone or in a group in an artistic performance — other than a performance that is primarily for a film production or a television or radio broadcast — or as a member of the staff of such a performing artist or group who is integral to the artistic performance, if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: they are part of a foreign production or group, or are a guest artist in a Canadian production or group, performing a time-limited engagement, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: they are not in an employment relationship with the organization or business in Canada that is contracting for their services;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a participant in sports activities or events, in Canada, either as an individual participant or as a member of a foreign-based team or Canadian amateur team;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as an employee of a foreign news company for the purpose of reporting on events in Canada;

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a guest speaker for the sole purpose of making a speech or delivering a paper at a dinner, graduation, convention or similar function, or as a commercial speaker or seminar leader delivering a seminar that lasts no longer than five days;

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a member of the executive of a committee that is organizing a convention or meeting in Canada or as a member of the administrative support staff of such a committee;

label: (l)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a person who is responsible for assisting a congregation or group in the achievement of its spiritual goals and whose main duties are to preach doctrine, perform functions related to gatherings of the congregation or group or provide spiritual counselling;

label: (m)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a judge, referee or similar official at an international amateur sports competition, an international cultural or artistic event or competition or an animal or agricultural competition;

label: (n)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as an examiner or evaluator of research proposals or university projects, programs or theses;

label: (o)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as an expert who conducts surveys or analyses that are to be used as evidence before a federal or provincial regulatory body, a tribunal or a court of law or as an expert witness before such a body, tribunal or court of law;

label: (p)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a student in a health field, including as a medical elective or clinical clerk at a medical teaching institution in Canada, for the primary purpose of acquiring training, if they have written approval from the body that regulates that field;

label: (q)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a civil aviation inspector of a national aeronautical authority conducting inspections of the flight operation procedures or cabin safety of a commercial air carrier operating international flights;

label: (r)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as an accredited representative or adviser participating in an aviation accident or incident investigation conducted under the Canadian Transportation Accident Investigation and Safety Board Act ;

label: (s)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a member of a crew who is employed by a foreign company aboard a means of transportation that

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: is foreign-owned and not registered in Canada, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: is engaged primarily in international transportation;

label: (t)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: as a provider of emergency services, including medical services, for the protection or preservation of life or property;

label: (u)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: until a decision is made on an application made by them under subsection 201(1), if they have remained in Canada after the expiry of their work permit and they have continued to comply with the conditions set out on the expired work permit, other than the expiry date;

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: if they are the holder of a study permit and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: they are a full-time student enrolled at a designated learning institution as defined in section 211.1,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: the program in which they are enrolled is a post-secondary academic, vocational or professional training program, or a vocational training program at the secondary level offered in Quebec, in each case, of a duration of six months or more that leads to a degree, diploma or certificate, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: although they are permitted to engage in full-time work during a regularly scheduled break between academic sessions, they work no more than 24 hours per week during a regular academic session;

label: (w)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: if they are or were the holder of a study permit who has completed their program of study and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: they met the requirements set out in paragraph (v), and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: they applied for a work permit before the expiry of that study permit and a decision has not yet been made in respect of their application; or

label: (x)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: if they are an Indian.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 186(a), a business visitor to Canada is a foreign national who is described in subsection (2) or who seeks to engage in international business activities in Canada without directly entering the Canadian labour market.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: The following foreign nationals are business visitors:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: foreign nationals purchasing Canadian goods or services for a foreign business or government, or receiving training or familiarization in respect of such goods or services;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: foreign nationals receiving or giving training within a Canadian parent or subsidiary of the corporation that employs them outside Canada, if any production of goods or services that results from the training is incidental; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: foreign nationals representing a foreign business or government for the purpose of selling goods for that business or government, if the foreign national is not engaged in making sales to the general public in Canada.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: For the purpose of subsection (1), a foreign national seeks to engage in international business activities in Canada without directly entering the Canadian labour market only if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: the primary source of remuneration for the business activities is outside Canada; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 3 Work Without a Permit
own_text: the principal place of business and actual place of accrual of profits remain predominately outside Canada.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: A foreign national may study in Canada without a study permit

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: if they are a family member or a member of the private staff of a foreign representative who is properly accredited by the Department of Foreign Affairs and International Trade and who is in Canada to carry out official duties as a diplomatic agent, consular officer, representative or official of a country other than Canada, of the United Nations or any of its agencies or of any international organization of which Canada is a member;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: as a member of the armed forces of a country that is a designated state for the purposes of the Visiting Forces Act , including a person who has been designated as a civilian component of those armed forces;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: if the duration of their course or program of studies is six months or less and will be completed within the period for their stay authorized upon entry into Canada; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: if they are an Indian.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: Despite paragraph (1)(c), a foreign national may apply for a study permit before entering Canada for a course or program of studies of a duration of six months or less.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: A foreign national who has made an application under subsection 217(1) is authorized to study without a study permit until a decision is made on the application if they have remained in Canada since the expiry of their study permit and continue to comply with the conditions, other than the expiry date, set out on the expired study permit.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: A foreign national who has submitted an application for a new study permit in accordance with section 217.1 is authorized to study at the designated learning institution , as defined in section 211.1, that is named in that application until a decision is made on the application if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: the foreign national has remained in Canada since they received their letter of acceptance from the designated learning institution named in the application;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: the foreign national continues to comply with the conditions set out in their previous study permit, other than the condition that they remain enrolled at the designated learning institution named in that permit; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: before the foreign national completed their course or program of study, the designated learning institution named in the previous study permit

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: closed,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: discontinued the course or program of study in question,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: was placed on the suspension list referred to in subsection 222.6(1), or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 4 Study Without a Permit
own_text: lost its designated status.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: A foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: are a citizen of a country listed in Schedule 1.1;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: are

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: a British citizen,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: a British overseas citizen who is re-admissible to the United Kingdom, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: a citizen of a British overseas territory who derives that citizenship through birth, descent, naturalization or registration in one of the British overseas territories of Anguilla, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Cayman Islands, Falkland Islands, Gibraltar, Montserrat, Pitcairn Island, Saint Helena or Turks and Caicos Islands; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: are a national of the United States or a person who has been lawfully admitted to the United States for permanent residence.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: A foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold a passport that contains a diplomatic acceptance, a consular acceptance or an official acceptance issued by the Chief of Protocol for the Department of Foreign Affairs and International Trade on behalf of the Government of Canada and are a properly accredited diplomat, consular officer, representative or official of a country other than Canada, of the United Nations or any of its agencies, or of any international organization of which Canada is a member;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold a passport or travel document issued by the Holy See;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold a national Israeli passport;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold a passport issued by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British National (Overseas), as a person born, naturalized or registered in Hong Kong;

label: (e.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold a passport issued by the United Kingdom to a British Subject which contains the observation that the holder has the right of abode in the United Kingdom; or

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: hold an ordinary passport issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Taiwan that includes the personal identification number of the individual.

marginal_note: Visa exemption — holders of certain Romanian passports
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: A foreign national who is a citizen of Romania is exempt from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa if they hold a machine-readable passport that contains a contactless integrated circuit chip and that is issued by Romania.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: A foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa if they are seeking to enter and remain in Canada solely

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: subject to an agreement between Canada and one or more foreign countries respecting the obligation to hold such a visa,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: as a member of a crew of a means of transportation other than a vessel or to become a member of a crew of a means of transportation other than a vessel, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to transit through Canada after working, or to work, as a member of a crew of a means of transportation other than a vessel, if they possess a ticket for departure from Canada within 24 hours after their arrival in Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to transit through Canada as a passenger on a flight stopping in Canada for the sole purpose of refuelling and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: they are in possession of the documents required in order to enter the United States and their flight is bound for that country, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: they were lawfully admitted to the United States and their flight originated in that country;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to transit through Canada as a passenger on a flight that, owing to an emergency or other unforeseen circumstances, makes an unscheduled stop in Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to transit through Canada as a passenger on a flight if the foreign national

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: is transported by a commercial transporter and there is a memorandum of understanding referred to in subsection (4) in effect between the Minister and the commercial transporter concerning the transit of passengers through Canada without a Canadian visa,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: holds a passport or travel document that was issued by the country of which the foreign national is a citizen or national and that country is listed in the memorandum of understanding, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: is in possession of any visa required to enter the country of destination;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to carry out official duties as a member of the armed forces of a country that is a designated state for the purposes of the Visiting Forces Act , unless they have been designated under that Act as a civilian component of those armed forces;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2015-77, s. 6]

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to re-enter Canada following a visit solely to the United States or St. Pierre and Miquelon, if they

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: held a study permit or a work permit that was issued before they left Canada on such a visit or were authorized to enter and remain in Canada as a temporary resident, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: return to Canada by the end of the period initially authorized for their stay or any extension to it;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to conduct inspections of the flight operation procedures or cabin safety of a commercial air carrier operating international flights, if they are a civil aviation inspector of a national aeronautical authority and possess valid documentation to that effect; or

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to participate as an accredited representative or as an adviser to an aviation accident or incident investigation conducted under the Canadian Transportation Accident Investigation and Safety Board Act , if they possess valid documentation to that effect.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: A foreign national who is a member of a crew and who is carried to Canada by a vessel is exempt from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa if they are seeking

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to enter Canada as a member of the crew of the vessel; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: to remain in Canada solely as a member of the crew of that vessel or any other vessel.

heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: A memorandum of understanding referred to in paragraph (3)(c) shall include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: the countries to which the memorandum of understanding applies;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: the scheduled flights to which the memorandum of understanding applies; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 9 Temporary Residents > DIVISION 5 Temporary Resident Visa Exemptions
own_text: the commercial transporter’s obligation to control the movement of in-transit passengers.

heading_path: PART 10 Visitors
own_text: The visitor class is prescribed as a class of persons who may become temporary residents.

heading_path: PART 10 Visitors
own_text: A foreign national is a visitor and a member of the visitor class if the foreign national has been authorized to enter and remain in Canada as a visitor.

heading_path: PART 10 Visitors
own_text: A visitor is subject to the conditions imposed under Part 9.
