heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: The worker class is prescribed as a class of persons who may become temporary residents.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: A foreign national is a worker and a member of the worker class if the foreign national has been authorized to enter and remain in Canada as a worker.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: A foreign national must not work in Canada unless authorized to do so by a work permit or these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: A foreign national must not enter into an employment agreement, or extend the term of an employment agreement, with an employer

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: who, on a regular basis, offers striptease, erotic dance, escort services or erotic massages; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: For the purpose of this Part abuse consists of any of the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: physical abuse, including assault and forcible confinement;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: sexual abuse, including sexual contact without consent;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: psychological abuse, including threats and intimidation;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: financial abuse, including fraud and extortion; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: reprisals.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: For the purpose of subsection (1) reprisal consists of any measure, including the following, that is taken by or on behalf of an employer against a foreign national referred to in subparagraph 200(1)(c)(ii.1) or (iii) – and that adversely affects the foreign national’s employment or working conditions – because the foreign national has reported that the conditions set out in section 209.2 or 209.3 have not been complied with or has in good faith cooperated with an inspection conducted under section 209.7, 209.8 or 209.9:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: a disciplinary measure;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: a demotion;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: a dismissal; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: any threat to take any of the measures mentioned above.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: A foreign national may apply for a work permit at any time before entering Canada.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), a foreign national may apply for a work permit when entering Canada if the foreign national is exempt under Division 5 of Part 9 from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: A foreign national may not apply for a work permit when entering Canada if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: a determination under section 203 is required, unless

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: the Department of Employment and Social Development has provided an assessment under paragraph 203(2)(a) in respect of an offer of employment — other than seasonal agricultural employment — to the foreign national, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: the foreign national is a national or permanent resident of the United States or is a resident of Greenland or St. Pierre and Miquelon;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: the foreign national does not hold a medical certificate that they are required to hold under subsection 30(3); or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: the foreign national is a participant in an international youth exchange program, unless they are a national or permanent resident of the United States or their application for a work permit was approved before their entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: A foreign national may apply for a work permit after entering Canada if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: hold a work permit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: are working in Canada under the authority of section 186 and are not a business visitor within the meaning of section 187;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: hold a study permit;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: hold a temporary resident permit issued under subsection 24(1) of the Act that is valid for at least six months;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: are a family member of a person described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: are in a situation described in section 206 or 207;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: applied for a work permit before entering Canada and the application was approved in writing but they have not been issued the permit;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: are applying as a trader or investor, intra-company transferee or professional, as described in Section B, C or D of Annex 1603 of the Agreement, within the meaning of subsection 2(1) of the North American Free Trade Agreement Implementation Act , and their country of citizenship — being a country party to that Agreement — grants to Canadian citizens who submit a similar application within that country treatment equivalent to that accorded by Canada to citizens of that country who submit an application within Canada, including treatment in respect of an authorization for multiple entries based on a single application; or

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 2 Application for Work Permit
own_text: hold a written statement from the Department of Foreign Affairs and International Trade stating that it has no objection to the foreign national working at a foreign mission in Canada.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3) — and, in respect of a foreign national who makes an application for a work permit before entering Canada, subject to section 87.3 of the Act — an officer shall issue a work permit to a foreign national if, following an examination, it is established that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national applied for it in accordance with Division 2;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national will leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay under Division 2 of Part 9;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is described in section 206 or 208,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: intends to perform work described in section 204 or 205 but does not have an offer of employment to perform that work or is described in section 207 or 207.1 but does not have an offer of employment,

label: (ii.1)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: intends to perform work described in section 204 or 205 and has an offer of employment to perform that work or is described in section 207 and has an offer of employment, and an officer has determined, on the basis of any information provided on the officer’s request by the employer making the offer and any other relevant information, that the offer is genuine under subsection (5), or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: has been offered employment, and an officer has made a positive determination under paragraphs 203(1)(a) to (g); and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2004-167, s. 56]

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the requirements of subsections 30(2) and (3) are met, if they must submit to a medical examination under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to a foreign national who satisfies the criteria set out in section 206 or paragraph 207(c) or (d).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: An officer shall not issue a work permit to a foreign national if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: there are reasonable grounds to believe that the foreign national is unable to perform the work sought;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who intends to work in the Province of Quebec and does not hold a Certificat d’acceptation du Québec , a determination under section 203 is required and the laws of that Province require that the foreign national hold a Certificat d’acceptation du Québec ;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the work that the foreign national intends to perform is likely to adversely affect the settlement of any labour dispute in progress or the employment of any person involved in the dispute;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2017-78, s. 8]

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national has engaged in unauthorized study or work in Canada or has failed to comply with a condition of a previous permit or authorization unless

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: a period of six months has elapsed since the cessation of the unauthorized work or study or failure to comply with a condition,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the study or work was unauthorized by reason only that the foreign national did not comply with conditions imposed under paragraph 185(a), any of subparagraphs 185(b)(i) to (iii) or paragraph 185(c);

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: section 206 applies to them; or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national was subsequently issued a temporary resident permit under subsection 24(1) of the Act;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in subparagraphs (1)(c)(i) to (iii), the issuance of a work permit would be inconsistent with the terms of a federal-provincial agreement that apply to the employment of foreign nationals;

label: (f.1)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: in the case of a foreign national referred to in subparagraph (1)(c)(ii.1), the fee referred to in section 303.1 has not been paid or the information referred to in section 209.11 has not been provided before the foreign national makes an application for a work permit;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2018-61, s. 1]

label: (g.1)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national intends to work for an employer who, on a regular basis, offers striptease, erotic dance, escort services or erotic massages; or

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national intends to work for an employer who is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2022-142, s. 6]

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: ineligible under paragraph 209.95 (1)(b), or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: in default of any amount payable in respect of an administrative monetary penalty, including if the employer fails to comply with a payment agreement for the payment of that amount.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: Paragraph (3)(e) does not apply to a foreign national referred to in subsection 207.1(1) who engaged in unauthorized work in Canada or failed to comply with a condition of a previous permit or authorization.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2018-61, s. 1]

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A determination of whether an offer of employment is genuine shall be based on the following factors:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the offer is made by an employer that is actively engaged in the business in respect of which the offer is made, unless the offer is made for employment as a live-in caregiver;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the offer is consistent with the reasonable employment needs of the employer;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the terms of the offer are terms that the employer is reasonably able to fulfil; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the past compliance of the employer, or any person who recruits the foreign national for the employer, with the federal or provincial laws that regulate the employment or recruitment of employees, including foreign nationals, in the province in which it is intended that the foreign national will work.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A foreign national may apply for the renewal of their work permit if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the application is made before their work permit expires; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: they have complied with all conditions imposed on their entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: An officer shall renew the foreign national’s work permit if, following an examination, it is established that the foreign national continues to meet the requirements of section 200.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A foreign national who is issued a work permit under section 206 or paragraph 207(c) or (d) does not, by reason only of being issued a work permit, become a temporary resident.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: On application under Division 2 for a work permit made by a foreign national other than a foreign national referred to in subparagraphs 200(1)(c)(i) to (ii.1), an officer must determine, on the basis of an assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development, of any information provided on the officer’s request by the employer making the offer and of any other relevant information, if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the job offer is genuine under subsection 200(5);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employment of the foreign national is likely to have a neutral or positive effect on the labour market in Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the issuance of a work permit would not be inconsistent with the terms of any federal-provincial agreement that apply to the employers of foreign nationals;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who seeks to enter Canada as a live-in caregiver,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national will reside in a private household in Canada and provide child care, senior home support care or care of a disabled person in that household without supervision,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer will provide the foreign national with adequate furnished and private accommodations in the household, and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer has sufficient financial resources to pay the foreign national the wages that are offered to the foreign national;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: has not, directly or indirectly, charged or recovered from the foreign national the fees referred to in subsection 315.2(1) or any fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national, with the exception of the fees referred to in subsections 296(1), 298(1) and 299(1) and fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national that are authorized to be charged or recovered under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries concerning seasonal agricultural workers,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: ensured that any person who recruits the foreign national for the employer did not, directly or indirectly, charge or recover from the foreign national the fees referred to in subsection 315.2(1) or any fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national, with the exception of the fees referred to in subsections 296(1), 298(1) and 299(1) and fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national that are authorized to be charged or recovered under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries concerning seasonal agricultural workers;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: in the case where the employer has not employed a foreign national referred to in subparagraph 200(1)(c)(iii) during the six years before the day on which the request for an assessment made under subsection (2) is received by the Department of Employment and Social Development, during the period beginning two years before the day on which the request for an assessment is received and ending on the day that an assessment is provided, when the employer was actively engaged in the business for which the employer has provided information under this subsection and subsection (2.1), the employer

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: made reasonable efforts to provide a workplace that is free of abuse, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: was not an affiliate of an employer referred to in subparagraphs 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii); and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer committed

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: to conclude with the foreign national, on or before the first day of work of the foreign national that is during the period of employment for which the work permit is issued to them, an employment agreement that

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: provides for employment in the same occupation and the same wages and working conditions as those set out in the offer of employment,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is drafted in the foreign national’s chosen official language of Canada, and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is signed by both the employer and the foreign national,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: to provide the foreign national, on or before the first day of work of the foreign national that is during the period of employment for which the work permit is issued to them, a copy of the employment agreement referred to in subparagraph (i),

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: to not, directly or indirectly, charge or recover from the foreign national the fees referred to in subsection 315.2(1) or any fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national, with the exception of the fees referred to in subsections 296(1), 298(1) and 299(1) and fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national that are authorized to be charged or recovered under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries concerning seasonal agricultural workers, and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: to ensure that any person who recruits the foreign national for the employer does not, directly or indirectly, charge or recover from the foreign national the fees referred to in subsection 315.2(1) or any fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national, with the exception of the fees referred to in subsections 296(1), 298(1) and 299(1) and fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national that are authorized to be charged or recovered under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries concerning seasonal agricultural workers.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), the employment of a foreign national is unlikely to have a positive or neutral effect on the labour market in Canada if the offer of employment requires the ability to communicate in a language other than English or French, unless

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer or group of employers demonstrates that the ability to communicate in the other language is a bona fide requirement for performing the duties associated with the employment;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the offer of employment relates to work to be performed under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries concerning seasonal agricultural workers; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the offer of employment relates to other work to be performed in the primary agriculture sector, within the meaning of subsection 315.2(4).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(b), the employment of the foreign national is unlikely to have a positive or neutral effect on the labour market in Canada if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the wages set out in the offer of employment are not consistent with the prevailing wage rate for the occupation; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employment of the foreign national is likely to adversely affect the settlement of any labour dispute in progress or the employment of any person involved in the dispute.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: Subject to subsection (2.02), the Department of Employment and Social Development must provide the assessment referred to in subsection (1) on the request of an officer or an employer or group of employers, none of whom is an employer who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: on a regular basis, offers striptease, erotic dance, escort services or erotic massages; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is referred to in subparagraph 200(3)(h)(ii) or (iii).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A request may be made in respect of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: an offer of employment to a foreign national; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: offers of employment made, or anticipated to be made, by an employer or group of employers.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: If any of the circumstances set out in section 209.5 exist, the processing of a request for an assessment under subsection (2) is suspended so long as the Department of Employment and Social Development has a reason to suspect that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer who made the request is not complying with or has not complied with any of the conditions set out in subparagraph 209.3(1)(a)(i), 209.3(1)(a)(iv) with regard to the working conditions referred to in that subparagraph, 209.3(1)(a)(v) or 209.3(1)(a)(vii) to 209.3(1)(a)(xii); and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the employer’s failure to comply with any of the conditions referred to in paragraph (a) would put at serious risk the health or safety of the foreign national, if the work permit was issued.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: The assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development on the matters set out in paragraphs (1)(a) to (g) must be based on any information provided by the employer making the offer and any other relevant information.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: An assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development with respect to the matters referred to in paragraph (1)(b) must, unless the employment of the foreign national is unlikely to have a positive or neutral effect on the labour market in Canada as a result of the application of subsection (1.01) or (1.1) be based on the following factors:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the employment of the foreign national will or is likely to result in direct job creation or job retention for Canadian citizens or permanent residents;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the employment of the foreign national will or is likely to result in the development or transfer of skills and knowledge for the benefit of Canadian citizens or permanent residents;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the employment of the foreign national is likely to fill a labour shortage;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the working conditions offered to the foreign national meet generally accepted Canadian standards;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the employer will hire or train Canadian citizens or permanent residents or has made, or has agreed to make, reasonable efforts to do so;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2022-142, s. 7]

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: whether the employer has fulfilled or has made reasonable efforts to fulfill any commitments made, in the context of any assessment that was previously provided under subsection (2), with respect to the matters referred to in paragraphs (a), (b) and (e).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: An assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development shall indicate the period during which the assessment is in effect for the purposes of subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: In the case of a foreign national who intends to work in the Province of Quebec, the assessment provided by the Department of Employment and Social Development shall be made in concert with the competent authority of that Province.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: For the purposes of this section, an affiliate includes

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: an employer that is controlled by another employer;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: two employers that are under common control; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: employers that are not operated at arm’s length.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: For the purposes of subsection (5), control, whether direct or indirect, exercised or not, includes

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: common ownership;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: common management;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: common interests;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: shared facilities or equipment; or

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: common use of services of employees.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national who intends to perform work under

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: an agreement or arrangement between Canada and the government of a foreign state or an international organization, other than an agreement or arrangement concerning seasonal agricultural workers;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: an agreement entered into by one or more countries and by or on behalf of one or more provinces;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: an agreement entered into by the Minister with a province or group of provinces under subsection 8(1) of the Act; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: a youth mobility agreement or arrangement between Canada and the government of a foreign state or the competent authority of any other foreign territory, or between Canada and an international or domestic organization, that would create or maintain reciprocal employment for Canadian citizens in a foreign state or territory.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national who intends to perform work that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: would create or maintain significant social, cultural or economic benefits or opportunities for Canadian citizens or permanent residents;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: would create or maintain reciprocal employment of Canadian citizens or permanent residents of Canada in other countries;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is designated by the Minister as being work that can be performed by a foreign national on the basis of the following criteria, namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the work is related to a research program,

label: (i.1)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the work is an essential part of a post-secondary academic, vocational or professional training program offered by a designated learning institution as defined in section 211.1,

label: (i.2)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the work is an essential part of a program at the secondary level

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: that is a vocational training program offered by a designated learning institution in Quebec, or

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: that is a program offered by a designated learning institution that requires students to work in order to obtain their secondary or high school diploma or certificate of graduation, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: limited access to the Canadian labour market is necessary for reasons of public policy relating to the competitiveness of Canada’s academic institutions or economy; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is of a religious or charitable nature.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national in Canada who cannot support themself without working, if the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: has made a claim for refugee protection that has been referred to the Refugee Protection Division but has not been determined; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is subject to an unenforceable removal order.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: Despite subsection (1), a work permit must not be issued to a claimant referred to in subsection 111.1(2) of the Act unless at least 180 days have elapsed since their claim was referred to the Refugee Protection Division.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national in Canada who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2017-78, s. 9]

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class set out in Division 2 of Part 7;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is a protected person within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: has applied to become a permanent resident and the Minister has granted them an exemption under subsection 25(1), 25.1(1) or 25.2(1) of the Act; or

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: is a family member of a person described in any of paragraphs (a) to (d).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national in Canada if there are reasonable grounds to believe that the foreign national is experiencing or is at risk of experiencing abuse in the context of their employment in Canada and if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: hold a work permit issued under subparagraph 200(1)(c)(ii.1) or (iii); or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: previously held a work permit issued under subparagraph 200(1)(c)(ii.1) or (iii), have applied for a renewal of that permit under subsection 201(1) and are authorized to work in Canada under paragraph 186(u).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national in Canada who is a family member of a person described in paragraph (1)(a) or (b).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit may be issued under section 200 to a foreign national in Canada who cannot support themself without working, if the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: holds a study permit and has become temporarily destitute through circumstances beyond their control and beyond the control of any person on whom that person is dependent for the financial support to complete their term of study; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: holds a temporary resident permit issued under subsection 24(1) of the Act that is valid for at least six months.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit becomes invalid when it expires or when it is cancelled under section 209.01, 209.02 or 243.2.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: An officer may cancel a work permit that was issued to a foreign national if the officer is satisfied that the work permit was issued based on an administrative error.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: A work permit that was issued to a foreign national is cancelled if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national becomes a permanent resident; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Work Permits
own_text: the foreign national is deceased.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: For the purposes of this Division, document means anything on which information that is capable of being understood by a person, or read by a computer or other device, is recorded or marked.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: An employer who has made an offer of employment to a foreign national referred to in subparagraph 200(1)(c)(ii.1) must, before the foreign national makes an application for a work permit in respect of that employment, provide the following information to the Minister using the electronic means that is made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: their name, address and telephone number and their fax number and electronic mail address, if any;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the business number assigned to the employer by the Minister of National Revenue, if applicable;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: information that demonstrates that the foreign national will be performing work described in section 204 or 205 or is a foreign national described in section 207;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: a copy of the offer of employment made in the form made available by the Department; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an attestation that

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer has entered into an employment agreement with the foreign national that

label: (A)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: provides for employment in the same occupation and the same wages and working conditions as those set out in the offer of employment,

label: (B)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: is drafted in the foreign national’s chosen official language of Canada, and

label: (C)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: is signed by both the employer and the foreign national,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer has provided a copy of the employment agreement referred to in subparagraph (i) to the foreign national,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer has not, directly or indirectly, charged or recovered from the foreign national the fee referred to in subsection 303.1(1) or any fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national, with the exception of the fees referred to in subsections 296(1), 298(1) and 299(1), and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer has ensured that any person who recruited the foreign national for the employer did not, directly or indirectly, charge or recover from the foreign national the fee referred to in subsection 303.1(1) or any fees related to the recruitment of the foreign national, with the exception of the fees referred to in subsections 296(1), 298(1) and 299(1).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: For the purposes of subsection (1), the period of employment for which the work permit is issued includes any period during which

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the foreign national may, under paragraph 186(u), work in Canada without a permit after the expiry of their work permit; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the foreign national is required to isolate or quarantine themselves on entry into Canada in accordance with an order made under the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A failure to comply with any of the conditions set out in subparagraphs (1)(a)(i) to (viii) and paragraph (1)(a.1) is justified if it results from

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: a change in federal or provincial law;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: a change to the provisions of a collective agreement;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the implementation of measures by the employer in response to a dramatic change in economic conditions that directly affected the business of the employer, provided that the measures were not directed disproportionately at foreign nationals employed by the employer;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an error in interpretation made in good faith by the employer with respect to its obligations to a foreign national, if the employer subsequently provided compensation — or if it was not possible to provide compensation, made sufficient efforts to do so — to all foreign nationals who suffered a disadvantage as a result of the error;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an accounting or administrative error made by the employer, if the employer subsequently provided compensation — or if it was not possible to provide compensation, made sufficient efforts to do so — to all foreign nationals who suffered a disadvantage as a result of the error;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: circumstances similar to those set out in paragraphs (a) to (e);

own_text: an error in interpretation made in good faith by the employer with respect to its compliance with the conditions set out in any of subparagraphs (1)(a)(v) and (vi).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A failure to comply with either of the conditions set out in paragraph (1)(b) is justified if the employer made all reasonable efforts to comply with the condition.

own_text: during the period of employment for which the work permit is issued to the foreign national or any other period that was agreed on by the employer and the Department of Employment and Social Development at the time the assessment referred to in subsection 203(2) was provided,

label: (i)

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer must ensure that the employment of the foreign national will result in direct job creation or job retention for Canadian citizens or permanent residents, if that was one of the factors that led to the issuance of the work permit,

label: (ii)

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer must ensure that the employment of the foreign national will result in the development or transfer of skills and knowledge for the benefit of Canadian citizens or permanent residents, if that was one of the factors that led to the issuance of the work permit,

label: (iii)
marginal_note: Foreign national referred to in subparagraph 200(1)(c)(iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer must hire or train Canadian citizens or permanent residents, if that was one of the factors that led to the issuance of the work permit, and

label: (iv)
marginal_note: Foreign national referred to in subparagraph 200(1)(c)(iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer must make reasonable efforts to hire or train Canadian citizens or permanent residents, if that was one of the factors that led to the issuance of the work permit; and

label: (c)
marginal_note: Foreign national referred to in subparagraph 200(1)(c)(iii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: during a period of six years beginning on the first day of the period of employment for which the work permit is issued to the foreign national, the employer must

label: (i)

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: For the purposes of subsection (1), the period of employment for which the work permit is issued includes any period during which

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the foreign national may, under paragraph 186(u), work in Canada without a permit after the expiry of their work permit; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the foreign national is required to isolate or quarantine themselves on entry into Canada in accordance with an order made under the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A failure to comply with any of the conditions set out in subparagraphs (1)(a)(i) to (xiv) and paragraphs (1)(a.1) and (b) is justified if it results from a:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: a change in federal or provincial law;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: a change to the provisions of a collective agreement;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the implementation of measures by the employer in response to a dramatic change in economic conditions that directly affected the business of the employer, provided that the measures were not directed disproportionately at foreign nationals employed by the employer;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an error in interpretation made in good faith by the employer with respect to its obligations to a foreign national, if the employer subsequently provided compensation — or if it was not possible to provide compensation, made sufficient efforts to do so — to all foreign nationals who suffered a disadvantage as a result of the error;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an accounting or administrative error made by the employer, if the employer subsequently provided compensation — or if it was not possible to provide compensation, made sufficient efforts to do so — to all foreign nationals who suffered a disadvantage as a result of the error;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: circumstances similar to those set out in paragraphs (a) to (e);

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: superior force; or

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an error in interpretation made in good faith by the employer with respect to its compliance with the conditions set out in any of subparagraphs (1)(a)(vii) to (xi).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A failure to comply with either of the conditions set out in paragraph (1)(c) is justified if the employer made all reasonable efforts to comply with the condition.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A failure to comply with any of the conditions set out in subparagraphs (1)(a)(xv) and (xvi) is justified if the employer

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: made all reasonable efforts to comply with the condition; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: subsequently provided full compensation to the foreign national for the fees that were incorrectly charged or recovered.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: An employer referred to in section 209.2 or 209.3 must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: report at any specified time and place to answer questions and provide documents, in accordance with section 209.6;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: provide any documents that are required under paragraphs 209.7(1)(a) and (b); and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: attend any inspection referred to in section 209.8 or 209.9, unless the employer was not notified of it, give all reasonable assistance to the person conducting that inspection and provide that person with any document or information that the person requires.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A failure to comply with any of the conditions set out in subsection (1) is justified if the employer made all reasonable efforts to comply with the condition or if it results from anything done or omitted to be done by the employer in good faith.

marginal_note: Circumstances for exercise of powers – sections 209.6 to 209.9
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: The powers set out in sections 209.6 to 209.9 may be exercised in the following circumstances:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Circumstances for exercise of powers – sections 209.6 to 209.9
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development has a reason to suspect that the employer is not complying or has not complied with any of the conditions set out in section 209.2 or 209.3;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Circumstances for exercise of powers – sections 209.6 to 209.9
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer has not complied with any of the conditions set out in section 209.2 or 209.3 in the past;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Circumstances for exercise of powers – sections 209.6 to 209.9
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer is chosen as part of a random verification of compliance with the conditions set out in sections 209.2 or 209.3;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Circumstances for exercise of powers – sections 209.6 to 209.9
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development is notified that there has been the introduction or spread of a communicable disease , as defined in section 2 of the Quarantine Act , at any premises or place in which a foreign national performs work; or

label: (e)
marginal_note: Circumstances for exercise of powers – sections 209.6 to 209.9
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the employer employs a foreign national who is or was subject to an order or regulation made under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: If any of the circumstances set out in section 209.5 exists,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: an officer may, for the purpose of verifying compliance with the conditions set out in section 209.2, require an employer to report at any specified time and place to answer questions and provide documents that relate to compliance with those conditions; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the Minister of Employment and Social Development may, for the purpose of verifying compliance with the conditions set out in section 209.3, require an employer to report at any specified time and place to answer questions and provide documents that relate to compliance with those conditions.

marginal_note: Minister of Employment and Social Development
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: The Minister of Employment and Social Development may exercise the powers set out in paragraph (1)(a) on the request of an officer.

label: (a)

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: The Minister of Employment and Social Development may exercise the powers set out in paragraphs (1)(a) and (c) on the request of an officer.

marginal_note: Entry to verify compliance with section 209.2
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers

marginal_note: Entry to verify compliance with section 209.2
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: Subject to subsection (5), if any of the circumstances set out in section 209.5 exists, an officer may, for the purpose of verifying compliance with the conditions set out in section 209.2, enter and inspect any premises or place in which a foreign national referred to in that section performs work.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: The officer may, for that purpose,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: ask the employer and any person employed by the employer any relevant questions;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: require from the employer, for examination, any documents found in the premises or place;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: use copying equipment in the premises or place, or require the employer to make copies of documents, and remove the copies for examination or, if it is not possible to make copies in the premises or place, remove the documents to make copies;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: take photographs and make video or audio recordings;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: examine anything in the premises or place;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: require the employer to use any computer or other electronic device in the premises or place to allow the officer to examine any relevant document contained in or available to it; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: be accompanied or assisted in the premises or place by any person required by the officer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: An officer and any person accompanying the officer may enter on and pass through private property, other than a dwelling-house, to gain entry to a premises or place referred to in subsection (1). For greater certainty, they are not liable for doing so.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: A person may, at an officer’s request, accompany the officer to assist them to access the premises or place referred to in subsection (1) and is not liable for doing so.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: In the case of a dwelling-house, an officer may enter it without the occupant’s consent only under the authority of a warrant issued under subsection (6).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: On ex parte application, a justice of the peace may issue a warrant authorizing an officer who is named in it or the Minister of Employment and Social Development, as the case may be, to enter a dwelling-house, subject to any conditions specified in the warrant, if the justice of the peace is satisfied by information on oath that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: there are reasonable grounds to believe that the dwelling-house is a premises or place referred to in subsection (1);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: entry into the dwelling-house is necessary to verify compliance with the conditions set out in section 209.2; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: entry was refused by the occupant or there are reasonable grounds to believe that entry will be refused or that consent to entry cannot be obtained from the occupant.

marginal_note: Minister of Employment and Social Development
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: The Minister of Employment and Social Development may exercise the powers set out in this section on the request of an officer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: The following employers are exempt from the application of sections 209.11 and 209.2:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the government of a foreign state that makes an offer of employment to a foreign national in respect of the performance of duties as an official of that state;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the office of a political subdivision of a foreign state that enjoys privileges and immunities granted under subsection 6(1) of the Foreign Missions and International Organizations Act ;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: a foreign diplomatic mission or consular post referred to in Part I of the Foreign Missions and International Organizations Act or an international organization or accredited mission as defined in subsection 2(1) of that Act; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 4 Conditions Imposed on Employers
own_text: the owner or operator of an international bridge or tunnel , as defined in section 2 of the International Bridges and Tunnels Act .

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 5 Collection and Disclosure of Information
own_text: The Minister of Employment and Social Development may collect information related to an employer’s compliance with the conditions set out in section 209.2.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 5 Collection and Disclosure of Information
own_text: An officer may, for the purposes of determining whether a work permit is to be issued to a foreign national under subsection 200(1), of making a determination under paragraphs 203(1)(a) to (g), if applicable, or of verifying compliance with the conditions set out in sections 209.2 to 209.4, disclose to the Minister of Employment and Social Development and to the competent authorities of the provinces concerned information that relates to an application for a work permit or to an employer’s compliance with the conditions set out in sections 209.2 to 209.4.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Interpretation
own_text: The following definitions apply in this Division. large business means any business that is not a small business. ( grande entreprise ) small business means any business, including its affiliates, that has fewer than 100 employees or less than $5 million in annual gross revenues at the time a request for an assessment under subsection 203(2) is received, or if no such request is made, at the time a copy of an offer of employment for a work permit application is provided to the Minister under paragraph 209.11(1)(d). ( petite entreprise )

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Purpose
own_text: The purpose of this Division is to encourage compliance with the provisions of the Act and these Regulations and not to punish.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Violations
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Violations
own_text: An employer referred to in subsection 209.2(1) or 209.3(1) who fails to comply with one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 — if the failure to do so is not justified under subsection 209.2(3), (3.1) or (4), 209.3(3), (4) or (5), or 209.4(2) — commits a violation and

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Violations
own_text: is liable to an administrative monetary penalty of an amount that is determined in accordance with section 209.98 or if it is determined under that section that there is no penalty, is issued a warning informing the employer that there is no administrative monetary penalty for the violation but that the violation will be considered in the calculation of the total number of points under subparagraph 209.991 (1)(a)(i) for any subsequent violation; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Violations
own_text: if applicable, is ineligible to employ a foreign national for whom a work permit is required for the period determined in accordance with section 209.99 .

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Violations
own_text: In the event of a discrepancy between the short-form description in column 2 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 and the provision to which it pertains, the provision prevails.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: A failure to comply — that is not justified under subsection 209.2(3), (4) or (5), 209.3(3), (4) or (5) or 209.4(2) — with a condition that affects more than one foreign national constitutes a separate violation for each foreign national affected.

marginal_note: Separate violation — occupation, wages or working conditions
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: A failure to comply — that is not justified under subsection 209.2(3) or 209.3(3) — with any one of the following elements of the condition set out in item 9 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, constitutes a separate violation:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Separate violation — occupation, wages or working conditions
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: to provide the foreign national with employment in the same occupation as the occupation that is set out in the foreign national’s offer of employment;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Separate violation — occupation, wages or working conditions
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: to provide the foreign national with wages that are substantially the same as — but not less favourable than — those set out in the foreign national’s offer of employment; and

label: (c)
marginal_note: Separate violation — occupation, wages or working conditions
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: to provide the foreign national with working conditions that are substantially the same as — but not less favourable than — those set out in the foreign national’s offer of employment.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: With respect to employers who employ foreign nationals as live-in caregivers, a failure to comply — that is not justified under subsection 209.3(3) — with either one of the following elements of the condition set out in item 10 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, constitutes a separate violation:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: to ensure that the foreign national resides in a private household in Canada,

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: to ensure that the foreign national provides child care, senior home support care or care of a disabled person in that household without supervision.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Rules Applicable to Violations
own_text: A failure to comply — that is not justified under subsection 209.2(3) or 209.3(3) — with the condition set out in item 17 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 with respect to any one of the elements set out in paragraphs 196.2(1)(a) to (e) constitutes a separate violation.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Classification
own_text: A failure to comply — that is not justified under subsection 209.2(3), (4) or (5), 209.3(3), (4) or (5) or 209.4(2) — with a condition that is set out in one of the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 is classified as a violation of Type A, Type B or Type C as set out in column 3 of that Table.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Administrative Monetary Penalty Amount
own_text: The administrative monetary penalty for a violation is the amount set out in column 2, 3 or 4 of Table 2 of Schedule 2 opposite the total number of points determined under section 209.991 as set out in column 1, depending on the type of violation and whether it is committed by an individual or small business, or a large business.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Period of Ineligibility
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Period of Ineligibility
own_text: The period of ineligibility for a violation is the period set out in column 2, 3 or 4 of Table 3 of Schedule 2 opposite the total number of points determined under section 209.991 as set out in column 1 depending on the type of violation.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Period of Ineligibility
own_text: The period referred to in subsection (1) begins on the day on which the determination referred to in subsection 209.996(1) or (2) is made in respect of the employer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: The total number of points in respect of each violation is determined by

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: considering

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: the compliance history of the employer who committed the violation set out in column 1 of Table 4 of Schedule 2, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: the severity criteria set out in column 1 of Table 5 of Schedule 2;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: ascribing

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: for the criterion described in subparagraph (a)(i), the applicable number of points set out in column 2 of Table 4 of Schedule 2,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: for the criteria described in subparagraph (a)(ii), the applicable number of points set out in column 2 of Table 5 of Schedule 2 having regard to the severity or the impact of the violation, as the case may be,

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: adding the values obtained under paragraph (b); and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: if the employer made an acceptable voluntary disclosure in accordance with subsections (2) and (3) and the value obtained under paragraph (c)

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: is four or more, subtracting four points from the value obtained under that paragraph , or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: is less than four, replacing that value with a value of zero.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: The voluntary disclosure made by an employer with respect to the commission of a violation by the employer is acceptable if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: the disclosure is complete; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: at the time the voluntary disclosure is made, the powers set out in sections 209.6 to 209.9 are not being exercised in respect of the employer nor is any enforcement action related to an offence arising out of the contravention of a provision of the Act being undertaken in respect of the employer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: Despite subsection (2), an officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development may consider that the voluntary disclosure is not acceptable after considering

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: the severity of the impact of the violation on the foreign national;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: in the case of an employer described in subsection 209.2(1), the severity of the impact of the violation on the Canadian economy, or in the case of an employer described in subsection 209.3(1), the severity of the impact of the violation on the Canadian labour market;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: whether the disclosure was made in a timely manner;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: the number of times an acceptable voluntary disclosure is made by the employer; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Total Number of Points
own_text: the nature of the condition with which the employer failed to comply.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Multiple Violations
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Multiple Violations
own_text: If a notice of preliminary finding under section 209.993 or a notice of final determination under section 209.996 that is issued to an employer lists more than one violation, the administrative monetary penalty amounts are cumulative but the total must not exceed $1 million.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Multiple Violations
own_text: If a notice of preliminary finding or a notice of final determination that is issued to an employer includes more than one period of ineligibility, the longest period of ineligibility applies.
