heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: If an officer assesses, on the basis of information obtained by any officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development during the exercise of the powers set out in sections 209.6 to 209.8 and any other relevant information, that an employer has committed a violation because that employer failed to comply with one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 and the failure to do so was not justified under subsection 209.2(3), (4) or (5) or 209.4(2), the officer must issue a notice of preliminary finding to the employer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: If the Minister of Employment and Social Development assesses, on the basis of information obtained during the exercise of the powers set out in sections 209.6, 209.7 and 209.9 and any other relevant information, that an employer has committed a violation because that employer failed to comply with one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 and the failure to do so was not justified under subsection 209.3(3), (4) or (5) or 209.4(2), that Minister must issue a notice of preliminary finding to the employer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: The notice of preliminary finding must include the following information:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: the name of the employer referred to in subsection (1) or (2), as the case may be;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: the condition with which the employer failed to comply as well as the provision listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, the relevant facts surrounding the violation and the reasons for the preliminary finding;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: if applicable, the administrative monetary penalty amount and the period of ineligibility for the violation as well as the statement that the violation will be considered in the calculation of the total number of points under subparagraph 209.991 (1)(a)(i) for any subsequent violation;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: if applicable, the statement that a warning may be issued to the employer informing them that there is no administrative monetary penalty for the violation but that the violation will be considered in the calculation of the total number of points under subparagraph 209.991 (1)(a)(i) for any subsequent violation; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: the statement that the employer may make written submissions within the period set out in section 209.994 with respect to the information referred to in paragraphs (b) to (d).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: An employer to whom a notice of preliminary finding under section 209.993 or a corrected notice of preliminary finding under section 209.995 is issued may, within 30 days after the day on which it is received,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: make written submissions with respect to the information referred to in paragraphs 209.993(3)(b) to (d); or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: request an extension of that period.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: Despite subsection (1), if the notice of preliminary finding or the corrected notice of preliminary finding is solely in respect of a failure to comply with any one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in items 18 to 23 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, the employer may make a written submission or request referred to in paragraph (1)(a) or (b) within five days after the day on which the notice or corrected notice is received.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: Despite section 9.3(2) of these Regulations and section 3 of the Electronic Documents and Electronic Information Regulations , a notice of preliminary finding or a corrected or cancelled notice of preliminary finding is deemed to have been received 10 days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: Despite subsection (2), if the notice of preliminary finding or the corrected notice of preliminary finding is solely in respect of a failure to comply with any one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in items 18 to 23 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, the notice or corrected notice is deemed to have been received five days after the day on which it is sent.

marginal_note: Submissions by employer — extension of period
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: An officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development may extend the period referred to in subsection (1) if there is a reasonable explanation justifying its extension.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Preliminary Finding
own_text: An officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development may correct any information in a notice of preliminary finding that is issued under subsection 209.993 (1) or (2), or cancel one, at any time before a notice of final determination is issued under section 209.996 .

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: Subject to subsection (3), if an officer determines, on the basis of information obtained by any officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development during the exercise of the powers set out in sections 209.6 to 209.8 and any other relevant information, that an employer has committed a violation because that employer failed to comply with one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 and the failure to do so was not justified under subsection 209.2(3), (4) or (5) or 209.4(2), the officer must issue a notice of final determination to the employer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: Subject to subsection (3), if the Minister of Employment and Social Development determines, on the basis of information obtained during the exercise of the powers set out in sections 209.6, 209.7 and 209.9 and any other relevant information, that an employer has committed a violation because that employer failed to comply with one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 and the failure to do so was not justified under subsection 209.3(3), (4) or (5) or 209.4(2), that Minister must issue a notice of final determination to the employer.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: An officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development must not make a determination before the expiry of the period set out in subsection 209.994 (1) or the period extended under subsection 209.994 (3) as the case may be.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: The notice of final determination must include the following information:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: the name of the employer referred to in subsection (1) or (2), as the case may be;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: the condition with which the employer failed to comply as well as the provision listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, the relevant facts surrounding the violation and the reasons for the determination;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: if applicable, the administrative monetary penalty amount and the period of ineligibility for the violation as well as the statement indicating that the violation will be considered in the calculation of the total number of points under subparagraph 209.991 (1)(a)(i) for any subsequent violation;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: if applicable, a warning informing the employer that there is no administrative monetary penalty for the violation but that the violation will be considered in the calculation of the total number of points under subparagraph 209.991 (1)(a)(i) for any subsequent violation;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: if applicable, a statement that the administrative monetary penalty amount must be paid within 30 days after the day on which the notice of final determination is received by the employer, unless a payment agreement for the payment of amount and interest has been reached within that period; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: how the administrative monetary penalty is to be paid.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: If the sum of the administrative monetary penalty amount described in paragraph (4)(c) and all previous administrative monetary penalty amounts provided for in notices of final determination issued to the employer in question within 12 months before the day on which the determination is made exceeds $1 million, then the amount of the penalty must be reduced by that excess.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: Despite section 9.3(2) of these Regulations and section 3 of the Electronic Documents and Electronic Information Regulations , a notice of final determination is deemed to have been received 10 days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > Notice of Final Determination
own_text: Despite subsection (6), if the notice of final determination is solely in respect of a failure to comply with any one of the conditions set out in the provisions listed in items 18 to 23 of Table 1 of Schedule 2, the notice is deemed to have been received five days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: If an officer or the Minister of Employment and Social Development makes a determination under subsection 209.996 (1) or (2) in respect of an employer, the Department or that Minister, as the case may be, must add the information referred to in subsection (2) to the list referred to in that subsection, except if the officer or that Minister issues a warning to the employer in accordance with paragraph 209.996(4)(d).

heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: A list is posted on one or more Government of Canada websites and includes the following information:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the employer’s name;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the employer’s address;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the conditions set out in the provisions listed in column 1 of Table 1 of Schedule 2 with which the employer failed to comply;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the day on which the determination was made;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the eligibility status of the employer;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: if applicable,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the administrative monetary penalty amount, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 11 Workers > DIVISION 6 Administrative Monetary Penalties and Other Consequences for Failure To Comply with Conditions Imposed on Employers > List of Employers
own_text: the ineligibility period of the employer.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: The student class is prescribed as a class of persons who may become temporary residents.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: A foreign national is a student and a member of the student class if the foreign national has been authorized to enter and remain in Canada as a student.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: In this Part, designated learning institution means

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: the following learning institutions:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: a learning institution that is administered by a federal department or agency,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: if a province has entered into an agreement or arrangement with the Minister in respect of post-secondary learning institutions in Canada that host international students, a post-secondary learning institution located in the province that is designated by the province for the purposes of these Regulations on the basis that the institution meets provincial requirements in respect of the delivery of education,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: if a province has entered into an agreement or arrangement with the Minister in respect of primary or secondary learning institutions in Canada that host international students, a primary or secondary learning institution located in the province that is designated by the province for the purposes of these Regulations on the basis that the institution meets provincial requirements in respect of the delivery of education, and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: if a province has not entered into an agreement or arrangement with the Minister in respect of primary or secondary learning institutions in Canada that host international students, any primary or secondary level learning institution in the province; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: in the case of Quebec, the following additional learning institutions:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: any educational institution within the meaning of section 36 of the Education Act of Quebec, R.S.Q. c. I-13.3,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: any college established in accordance with section 2 of the General and Vocational Colleges Act of Quebec, R.S.Q. c. 29,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: any private educational institution for which a permit is issued under section 10 of the Act respecting private education of Quebec, R.S.Q. c. E-9.1,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: any educational institution operated under an Act of Quebec by a government department or a body that is a mandatary of the province,

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: the Conservatoire de musique et d’art dramatique du Québec established by the Act respecting the Conservatoire de musique et d’art dramatique du Québec of Quebec, R.S.Q. c. C-62.1, and

label: (vi)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: any educational institution at the university level referred to in section 1 of the Act respecting educational institutions at the university level , R.S.Q. c. E-14.1.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: The Minister shall publish a list of those provinces with which the Minister has entered into an agreement or arrangement in respect of learning institutions that host international students.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 1 General Rules
own_text: A foreign national may not study in Canada unless authorized to do so by the Act, a study permit or these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: Subject to sections 214 and 215, in order to study in Canada, a foreign national shall apply for a study permit before entering Canada.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: A foreign national may apply for a study permit when entering Canada if they are

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: a national or a permanent resident of the United States;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: a person who has been lawfully admitted to the United States for permanent residence;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: a resident of Greenland; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: a resident of St. Pierre and Miquelon.

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2014-14, s. 10]

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: A foreign national may apply for a study permit after entering Canada if they

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: hold a study permit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: apply within the period beginning 90 days before the expiry of their authorization to engage in studies in Canada under subsection 30(2) of the Act, or paragraph 188(1)(a) of these Regulations, and ending 90 days after that expiry;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: hold a work permit;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: are subject to an unenforceable removal order;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: hold a temporary resident permit issued under subsection 24(1) of the Act that is valid for at least six months;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: are a temporary resident who

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is studying at the preschool, primary or secondary level,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is a visiting or exchange student who is studying at a designated learning institution, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: has completed a course or program of study that is a prerequisite to their enrolling at a designated learning institution; or

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: are in a situation described in section 207.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: A family member of a foreign national may apply for a study permit after entering Canada if the foreign national resides in Canada and the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: holds a study permit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: holds a work permit;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: holds a temporary resident permit issued under subsection 24(1) of the Act that is valid for at least six months;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is subject to an unenforceable removal order;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is a member of the armed forces of a country that is a designated state described in paragraph 186(d);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is an officer of a foreign government described in paragraph 186(e);

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is a participant in sports activities or events, as described in paragraph 186(h);

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is an employee of a foreign news company as described in paragraph 186(i); or

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: is a person who is responsible for assisting a congregation or group, as described in paragraph 186(l).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 2 Application for Study Permit
own_text: An application for a study permit that names a designated learning institution that is a post-secondary institution must be returned to the applicant without being processed, along with all documents submitted in support of the application and the fee for processing it, if that designated learning institution does not provide the confirmation referred to in paragraph 222.1(1)(a) to the Minister in accordance with that paragraph, subject to any extension granted under subsection 222.1(2).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), an officer shall issue a study permit to a foreign national if, following an examination, it is established that the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: applied for it in accordance with this Part;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: will leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay under Division 2 of Part 9;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: meets the requirements of this Part;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: meets the requirements of subsections 30(2) and (3), if they must submit to a medical examination under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: has been accepted to undertake a course or program of study at a designated learning institution and, in the case of a designated learning institution that is a post-secondary institution, that designated learning institution has provided the confirmation referred to in paragraph 222.1(1)(a) to the Minister in accordance with that paragraph, subject to any extension granted under subsection 222.1(2).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: Paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to persons described in section 206 and paragraphs 207(c) and (d).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: An officer shall not issue a study permit to a foreign national who intends to study in the Province of Quebec — other than under a federal assistance program for developing countries — and does not hold a Certificat d’acceptation du Québec , if the laws of that Province require that the foreign national hold a Certificat d’acceptation du Québec .

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: A foreign national may apply for the renewal of their study permit if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: the application is made before the expiry of their study permit; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: they have complied with all conditions imposed on their entry into Canada.

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2014-14, s. 13]

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: An officer shall renew the foreign national’s study permit if, following an examination, it is established that the foreign national continues to meet the requirements of section 216.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: If the holder of a study permit in Canada whose permit names a designated learning institution is accepted to undertake a course or program of study at a different designated learning institution and intends to attend that new institution, they must submit an application for a new study permit that names the new designated learning institution.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 3 Issuance of Study Permits
own_text: A foreign national referred to in paragraph 215(1)(d) and their family members do not, by reason only of being issued a study permit, become temporary residents.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: A study permit must not be issued to a foreign national unless

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: in the case of an application for a study permit that names a designated learning institution that is a post-secondary institution, that designated learning institution has provided confirmation to the Minister in accordance with paragraph 222.1(1)(a), subject to any extension granted under subsection 222.1(2), that the designated learning institution has accepted the foreign national to the course or program of study that is indicated in the application for the study permit; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: in any other case, the foreign national has provided written documentation from the designated learning institution where they intend to study that states that they have been accepted to study there.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a foreign national who applies for a study permit before entering Canada if they are an accompanying family member of a foreign national whose application for a work permit or a study permit is approved in writing before their entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: An officer shall not issue a study permit to a foreign national, other than one described in paragraph 215(1)(d) or (e), unless they have sufficient and available financial resources, without working in Canada, to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: pay the tuition fees for the course or program of studies that they intend to pursue;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: maintain themself and any family members who are accompanying them during their proposed period of study; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: pay the costs of transporting themself and the family members referred to in paragraph (b) to and from Canada.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: The holder of a study permit in Canada is subject to the following conditions:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: they shall enroll at the designated learning institution that is named in their permit and remain enrolled there until they complete their studies; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: they shall actively pursue their course or program of study.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: In the event that the learning institution at which the holder of a study permit is enrolled loses its designated status after the issuance of the permit by virtue of any of the following events, subsection (1) shall apply to that holder for the duration of their permit as if the learning institution at which they are enrolled continues to be a designated learning institution:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: termination of an agreement or arrangement between the province and the Minister in respect of learning institutions that host international students under which the learning institution had been designated;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: the coming into force of an agreement or arrangement between the province and the Minister in respect of learning institutions that host international students under which the learning institution no longer qualifies for designation; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: revocation of the designation by the province.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: a person described in any of paragraphs 300(2)(a) to (i); or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: a family member of a foreign national who resides in Canada and is described in any of paragraphs 215(2)(a) to (i).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: The holder of a study permit must provide evidence to an officer of their compliance with the conditions set out in subsection (1) if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: the officer requests the evidence because the officer has reason to believe that the permit holder is not complying or has not complied with one or more of the conditions; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: the officer requests the evidence as part of a random assessment of the overall level of compliance with those conditions by permit holders who are or were subject to them.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: Despite Division 2, a study permit shall not be issued to a foreign national who has engaged in unauthorized work or study in Canada or who has failed to comply with a condition of a permit unless

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: a period of six months has elapsed since the cessation of the unauthorized work or study or failure to comply with a condition;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: the work or study was unauthorized by reason only that the foreign national did not comply with conditions imposed under paragraph 185(a), any of subparagraphs 185(b)(i) to (iii) or paragraph 185(c); or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 4 Restrictions on Studying in Canada
own_text: the foreign national was subsequently issued a temporary resident permit under subsection 24(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: A study permit becomes invalid upon the first to occur of the following days:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: the day that is 90 days after the day on which the permit holder completes their studies,

label: (a.1)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: the day on which the permit holder is no longer enrolled at the designated learning institution that is named in the permit, other than as a result of completing their studies;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: the day on which the study permit is cancelled under section 222.7, 222.8 or 243.2; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: the day on which the permit expires.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: a person described in any of paragraphs 300(2)(a) to (i); or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 5 Validity and Expiry of Study Permits
own_text: a family member of a foreign national who resides in Canada and is described in any of paragraphs 215(2)(a) to (i).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: A designated learning institution that is a post-secondary institution must comply with the following conditions:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: it must, using the electronic means that are made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose, within 10 days after the day on which it is requested to do so by the Minister, confirm whether the designated learning institution has accepted a foreign national to the course or program of study that is indicated in their application for a study permit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: it must, using the electronic means that are made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose, within 60 days after the day on which it is requested to do so by the Minister, provide a compliance report that sets out the enrolment status of each foreign national who has been accepted to the designated learning institution;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: it must, using the electronic means that are made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose, within 10 days after the day on which it is requested to do so by the Minister, provide any additions or corrections to the information in the compliance report; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: it must, using the electronic means that are made available or specified by the Minister for that purpose, within 10 days after the day on which it is requested to do so by the Minister, provide any further information that the Minister requires in relation to study permits or applications for study permits that name the designated learning institution, or otherwise in relation to the administration of this Part.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: The Minister may, on request from a designated learning institution or on their own initiative, extend the time within which a confirmation, a report or information must be provided under this section if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: in the case of a confirmation required under paragraph (1)(a), the Minister determines that the designated learning institution’s provision of that confirmation has been prevented or impeded by

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: a prolonged failure of power, communications or other infrastructure systems,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: a natural disaster,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: a public health emergency, or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: a labour dispute; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: in the case of a report required under paragraph (1)(b) or information required under paragraph (1)(c) or (d), the Minister determines that the designated learning institution’s provision of the report or information has been prevented or impeded by exceptional circumstances.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: An officer may verify a designated learning institution’s compliance with the conditions set out in subsection 222.1(1) in the following circumstances:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the officer has a reason to suspect that the designated learning institution is not complying or has not complied with those conditions, including by providing inaccurate information;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the officer has a reason to suspect that a letter of acceptance that purports to be from the designated learning institution was improperly issued;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the designated learning institution is chosen as part of a random verification of compliance with the conditions; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the designated learning institution has not complied with those conditions in the past.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: The officer may, for the purpose of verifying compliance with the conditions, require the designated learning institution to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: provide any relevant documents; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: make a representative available to respond to questions at a time and by a means specified by the officer.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: A failure to comply with a condition is justified if the designated learning institution made all reasonable efforts to comply with it or if the failure results from anything done or omitted to be done by the designated learning institution in good faith.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: An officer who determines that a designated learning institution has failed to comply with a condition set out in subsection 222.1(1) must, unless they are satisfied that the failure is justified, issue to the designated learning institution a notice of preliminary finding that sets out

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the name of the designated learning institution;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the condition with which the designated learning institution failed to comply;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the details of the designated learning institution’s failure to comply with the condition;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the period for which the officer recommends that the designated learning institution be placed on the suspension list referred to in subsection 222.6(1);

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the reasons for the determination and for the recommended period of placement on the suspension list; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: an indication that the designated learning institution may make written submissions with respect to the information referred to in paragraphs (b) to (e) or any justification under subsection 222.2(3) within 30 days after the day on which it receives the notice.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: Despite subsection 9.3(2), the notice of preliminary finding is deemed to have been received 10 days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: The officer may, at any time before the notice of final determination is issued, cancel a notice of preliminary finding or issue a corrected notice of preliminary finding.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: A designated learning institution to which is issued a notice of preliminary finding under subsection 222.3(1) or a corrected notice of preliminary finding under subsection 222.3(3) may, within 30 days after the day on which it receives the notice, make written submissions with respect to the information referred to in paragraphs 222.3(1)(b) to (e) or any justification under subsection 222.2(3) and include with those submissions any relevant document.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: The Minister may, on the request of a designated learning institution, grant a single extension of not more than 30 days for the designated learning institution to make written submissions under subsection (1) if the Minister determines that exceptional circumstances have prevented or impeded the designated learning institution from making those submissions.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: If, after the time for making written submissions has elapsed, the Minister determines that a designated learning institution has failed to comply with a condition set out in subsection 222.1(1) and that the failure is not justified, they must issue to the designated learning institution a notice of final determination that sets out

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the name of the designated learning institution;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the condition with which the designated learning institution failed to comply;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: either

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the period for which the designated learning institution is to be placed on the suspension list referred to in subsection 222.6(1), or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: a warning advising the designated learning institution that it is not to be placed on the suspension list but that the determination of non-compliance may be considered in determining whether, in the event of any subsequent failure to comply with a condition set out in subsection 222.1(1), the designated learning institution is to be placed on the list; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the reasons for the determination and, if applicable, for the designated learning institution’s placement on the suspension list.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: In determining whether the designated learning institution is to be placed on the suspension list referred to in subsection 222.6(1) and, if applicable, the period for which it is to be placed on that list, the Minister must consider

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the frequency with which the designated learning institution has failed to comply with the conditions set out in subsection 222.1(1), including any such failures for which a warning was issued;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the seriousness of the designated learning institution’s failure to comply with the conditions;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the designated learning institution’s efforts to comply with the conditions;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the designated learning institution’s cooperation during the verification referred to in subsection 222.2(2); and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: any written submissions made by the designated learning institution under subsection 222.4(1).

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: The maximum period for which a designated learning institution may remain on the suspension list is 12 consecutive months.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: The Minister must publish and maintain a suspension list that is accessible to the public and that sets out, for each designated learning institution that received a notice of final determination indicating that it was to be placed on the list,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the designated learning institution’s name, mailing address and website;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the conditions set out in subsection 222.1(1) with which the designated learning institution failed to comply;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the date on which the designated learning institution was placed on the list; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: the period for which the designated learning institution is to remain on the list.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: An application for a study permit that names a designated learning institution and that is received during a period in which that designated learning institution is on the suspension list must be returned to the applicant without being processed, along with all documents submitted in support of the application and the fee for processing it.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 6 Conditions Imposed on Post-Secondary Designated Learning Institutions
own_text: For greater certainty, subsection (2) does not apply to an application for the renewal of a study permit to allow the applicant to complete their course or program of study.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 7 Cancellation — Study Permits
own_text: An officer may cancel a study permit that was issued to a foreign national if the officer is satisfied that the study permit was issued based on an administrative error.

heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 7 Cancellation — Study Permits
own_text: A study permit that was issued to a foreign national is cancelled if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 7 Cancellation — Study Permits
own_text: the foreign national becomes a permanent resident; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 12 Students > DIVISION 7 Cancellation — Study Permits
own_text: the foreign national is deceased.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: There are three types of removal orders, namely, departure orders, exclusion orders and deportation orders.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, an enforced departure order is a circumstance in which the foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain an authorization in order to return to Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: A foreign national who is issued a departure order must meet the requirements set out in paragraphs 240(1)(a) to (c) within 30 days after the order becomes enforceable, failing which the departure order becomes a deportation order.

marginal_note: Exception — stay of removal and detention
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: If the foreign national is detained within the 30-day period or the removal order against them is stayed, the 30-day period is suspended until the foreign national’s release or the removal order becomes enforceable.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, and subject to subsections (3) and (4), an exclusion order obliges the foreign national to obtain a written authorization in order to return to Canada during the one-year period after the exclusion order was enforced.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, the expiry of a one-year period following the enforcement of an exclusion order, or a five-year period if subsection (3) applies, is a circumstance in which the foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain an authorization in order to return to Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: A foreign national who is issued an exclusion order as a result of the application of paragraph 40(2)(a) of the Act must obtain a written authorization in order to return to Canada within the five-year period after the exclusion order was enforced.

marginal_note: Application of par. 42(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, the making of an exclusion order against a foreign national on the basis of inadmissibility under paragraph 42(1)(b) of the Act is a circumstance in which the foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain an authorization in order to return to Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, and subject to subsection (2), a deportation order obliges the foreign national to obtain a written authorization in order to return to Canada at any time after the deportation order was enforced.

marginal_note: Application of par. 42(1)(b) of the Act
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, the making of a deportation order against a foreign national on the basis of inadmissibility under paragraph 42(1)(b) of the Act is a circumstance in which the foreign national is exempt from the requirement to obtain an authorization in order to return to Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 52(1) of the Act, a removal order referred to in section 80 of the Act obliges the foreign national to obtain a written authorization in order to return to Canada at any time after the removal order was enforced.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: For the purposes of section 42 of the Act, a report prepared under subsection 44(1) of the Act against a foreign national is also a report against the foreign national’s family members in Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order made by the Immigration Division against a foreign national is also a removal order against their family members in Canada to whom subsection (1) applies if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: an officer informed the family members of the report, that they are the subject of an admissibility hearing and of their right to make submissions and be represented, at their own expense, at the admissibility hearing; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 1 Removal Orders
own_text: the family members are subject to a decision of the Immigration Division that they are inadmissible under section 42 of the Act on grounds of the inadmissibility of the foreign national.

marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order

marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 44(2) of the Act, and subject to subsections (3) and (4), if a report in respect of a foreign national does not include any grounds of inadmissibility other than those set out in the following circumstances, the report shall not be referred to the Immigration Division and any removal order made shall be

label: (a)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible under paragraph 36(1)(a) or (2)(a) of the Act on grounds of serious criminality or criminality, a deportation order;

label: (a.01)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of transborder criminality under subsection 36(2.1) of the Act for having committed one of the following offences on their entry into Canada, a deportation order:

label: (i)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an offence under section 86, 87, 90, 91, 95 or 104 or subsection 320.15(1) of the Criminal Code ,

label: (ii)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an offence under paragraph 124(1)(b) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act ,

label: (iii)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an offence under section 110 of the Firearms Act ,

label: (iv)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an offence under subsection 159(1) of the Customs Act with respect to goods referred to in subparagraph 19(1)(d)(ii) of these Regulations,

label: (v)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an offence under subsection 160(1) of the Customs Act that is one of the following contraventions:

label: (A)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a contravention of section 12 of that Act, with respect to goods referred to in clause 19(1)(e)(i)(B) of these Regulations, or

label: (B)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a contravention of section 156 of that Act;

label: (a.1)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible under paragraph 40(1)(a) of the Act on grounds of misrepresentation relating to their exemption from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa when applying for an electronic travel authorization, an exclusion order;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible under paragraph 40(1)(c) of the Act on grounds of misrepresentation, a deportation order;

label: (b.1)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible under subsection 40.1(1) of the Act on grounds of the cessation of refugee protection, a departure order;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible under section 41 of the Act on grounds of

label: (i)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to appear for further examination or an admissibility hearing under Part 1 of the Act, an exclusion order,

label: (ii)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to obtain the authorization of an officer required by subsection 52(1) of the Act, a deportation order,

label: (iii)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to establish that they hold the visa or other document as required under section 20 of the Act, an exclusion order,

label: (iv)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay as required by subsection 29(2) of the Act, an exclusion order,

label: (v)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to comply with subsection 29(2) of the Act as a result of non-compliance with any condition set out in paragraph 183(1)(d), section 184 or subsection 220.1(1), an exclusion order,

label: (vi)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to comply with the requirement under subsection 20(1.1) of the Act to not seek to enter or remain in Canada as a temporary resident while being the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act, an exclusion order,

label: (vii)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to comply with the condition set out in paragraph 43(1)(e), an exclusion order,

label: (viii)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to submit to a medical examination as required by paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act, an exclusion order, or

label: (ix)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: failing to appear for examination as required by subsection 18(1) of the Act when seeking to enter Canada at a port of entry, an exclusion order;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: subject to paragraph (e), if the foreign national is inadmissible under section 42 of the Act on grounds of an inadmissible family member, the same removal order as was made in respect of the inadmissible family member;

label: (e)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of an inadmissible family member in accordance with paragraph 42(2)(a) of the Act, a deportation order; and

label: (f)
marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: if the foreign national is inadmissible under subsection 35.1(1) of the Act on grounds of sanctions, a deportation order.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 44(2) of the Act, and subject to subsection (4), if a foreign national is the subject of a report and the following circumstances apply, the report shall not be referred to the Immigration Division and the removal order made shall be an exclusion order:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an officer directed the foreign national to return temporarily to the United States under section 41; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: the foreign national is inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for failing to establish that they will leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay.

marginal_note: Subsection 44(2) of the Act — permanent residents
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 44(2) of the Act, if a removal order is made against a permanent resident who fails to comply with the residency obligation under section 28 of the Act, the order shall be a departure order.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: If a claim for refugee protection is made and the claim has been determined to be eligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division or no determination has been made, a departure order is the applicable removal order in the circumstances set out in paragraph (1)(a.1) or any of subparagraphs (1)(c)(i), (iii) to (v), (viii) and (ix).

marginal_note: Reports in respect of certain foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: For the purposes of subsections (1) and (1.1), a report in respect of a foreign national does not include a report in respect of a foreign national who

label: (a)
marginal_note: Reports in respect of certain foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: is under 18 years of age and not accompanied by a parent or an adult legally responsible for them; or

label: (b)
marginal_note: Reports in respect of certain foreign nationals
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: is unable, in the opinion of the Minister, to appreciate the nature of the proceedings and is not accompanied by a parent or an adult legally responsible for them.

marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order

marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 45(d) of the Act, the applicable removal order to be made by the Immigration Division against a person is

label: (a)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, if they are inadmissible under subsection 34(1) of the Act on security grounds;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, if they are inadmissible under subsection 35(1) of the Act on grounds of violating human or international rights;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, in the case of a permanent resident inadmissible under subsection 36(1) of the Act on grounds of serious criminality or a foreign national inadmissible under paragraph 36(1)(b) or (c) of the Act on grounds of serious criminality;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 36(2)(b) or (c) of the Act on grounds of criminality;

label: (d.1)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, if they are inadmissible under subsection 36(2.1) of the Act on grounds of transborder criminality for having committed, on their entry into Canada, an offence other than one referred to in any of subparagraphs 228(1)(a.01)(i) to (v);

label: (e)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, if they are inadmissible under subsection 37(1) of the Act on grounds of organized criminality;

label: (f)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under subsection 38(1) of the Act on health grounds, unless subsection (2) or (3) applies;

label: (g)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under section 39 of the Act for financial reasons, unless subsection (2) or (3) applies;

label: (h)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 40(1)(a) or (b) of the Act for misrepresentation, unless subsection (3) applies;

label: (i)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a deportation order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 40(1)(d) of the Act for misrepresentation;

label: (j)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for failing to comply with the requirement to appear for examination, unless subsection (2) or (3) applies;

label: (k)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: a departure order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 41(b) of the Act;

label: (l)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for failing to establish that they have come to Canada in order to establish permanent residence, unless subsection (3) applies;

label: (m)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for failing to establish that they will leave Canada by the end of the period authorized for their stay, unless subsection (2) applies; and

label: (n)
marginal_note: Paragraph 45(d) of the Act — applicable removal order
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: an exclusion order, if they are inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for any other failure to comply with the Act, unless subsection (2) or (3) applies.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: If a claim for refugee protection is made and the claim has been determined to be eligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division or no determination has been made, a departure order is the applicable removal order in the circumstances set out in paragraph (1)(f), (g), (j), (m) or (n).

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: The applicable removal order in the circumstances set out in paragraph (1)(f), (g), (h), (j), (l) or (n) is a deportation order if the person

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: was previously subject to a removal order and they are inadmissible on the same grounds as in that order;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: has failed to comply with any condition or obligation imposed under the Act or the Immigration Act , chapter I-2 of the Revised Statutes of Canada, 1985, unless the failure is the basis for the removal order; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: has been convicted in Canada of an offence under an Act of Parliament punishable by way of indictment or of two offences under any Act of Parliament not arising out of a single occurrence, unless the conviction or convictions are the grounds for the removal order.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (3)(c), an offence that may be prosecuted either summarily or by way of indictment is deemed to be an offence punishable by way of indictment, even if it has been prosecuted summarily.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: If the Immigration Division makes a removal order against a foreign national with respect to any grounds of inadmissibility that are circumstances set out in section 228, the Immigration Division shall make

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: the removal order that would have been applicable under subsection 228(1) or (3) if the report had not been referred to the Immigration Division under subsection 44(2) of the Act; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 2 Specified Removal Order
own_text: in the case of a foreign national described in paragraph 228(4)(a) or (b), the removal order that would have been applicable under subsection 228(1) or (3) if the foreign national had not been described in that paragraph.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: The Minister may impose a stay on removal orders with respect to a country or a place if the circumstances in that country or place pose a generalized risk to the entire civilian population as a result of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: an armed conflict within the country or place;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: an environmental disaster resulting in a substantial temporary disruption of living conditions; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: any situation that is temporary and generalized.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: The Minister may cancel the stay if the circumstances referred to in subsection (1) no longer pose a generalized risk to the entire civilian population.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: The stay does not apply to a person who
