label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: is inadmissible under subsection 34(1) of the Act on security grounds;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: is inadmissible under subsection 35(1) of the Act on grounds of violating human or international rights;

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: is inadmissible under subsection 35.1(1) of the Act on grounds of sanctions;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: is inadmissible under subsection 36(1) of the Act on grounds of serious criminality, under subsection 36(2) of the Act on grounds of criminality or under subsection 36(2.1) of the Act on grounds of transborder criminality;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: is inadmissible under subsection 37(1) of the Act on grounds of organized criminality;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: is a person referred to in section F of Article 1 of the Refugee Convention; or

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: informs the Minister in writing that they consent to their removal to a country or place to which a stay of removal applies.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) to (4), a removal order is stayed if the subject of the order makes an application for leave for judicial review in accordance with section 72 of the Act with respect to a decision of the Refugee Appeal Division that rejects, or confirms the rejection of, a claim for refugee protection, and the stay is effective until the earliest of the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the application for leave is refused,

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the application for leave is granted, the application for judicial review is refused and no question is certified for the Federal Court of Appeal,

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: if a question is certified by the Federal Court,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the appeal is not filed within the time limit, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the Federal Court of Appeal decides to dismiss the appeal, and the time limit in which an application to the Supreme Court of Canada for leave to appeal from that decision expires without an application being made,

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: if an application for leave to appeal is made to the Supreme Court of Canada from a decision of the Federal Court of Appeal referred to in paragraph (c), the application is refused, and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: if the application referred to in paragraph (d) is granted, the appeal is not filed within the time limit or the Supreme Court of Canada dismisses the appeal.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply if, when leave is applied for, the subject of the removal order is a designated foreign national.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: There is no stay of removal if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the person is subject to a removal order because they are inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the subject of the removal order resides or sojourns in the United States or St. Pierre and Miquelon and is the subject of a report prepared under subsection 44(1) of the Act on their entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply if the person applies for an extension of time to file an application referred to in that subsection.

marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order is stayed when a person is notified by the Department under subsection 160(3) that they may make an application under subsection 112(1) of the Act, and the stay is effective until the earliest of the following events occurs:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the Department receives confirmation in writing from the person that they do not intend to make an application;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the person does not make an application within the period provided under section 162;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: the application for protection is rejected;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2012-154, s. 12]

label: (e)
marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: if a decision to allow the application for protection is made under paragraph 114(1)(a) of the Act, the decision with respect to the person’s application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident is made; and

label: (f)
marginal_note: Stay of removal — pre-removal risk assessment
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: in the case of a person to whom subsection 112(3) of the Act applies, the stay is cancelled under subsection 114(2) of the Act.

marginal_note: Stay of removal — humanitarian and compassionate or public policy considerations
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order made against a foreign national, and any family member of the foreign national, is stayed if the Minister is of the opinion that the stay is justified by humanitarian and compassionate considerations, under subsection 25(1) or 25.1(1) of the Act, or by public policy considerations, under subsection 25.2(1) of the Act. The stay is effective until a decision is made to grant, or not grant, permanent resident status.

marginal_note: Application of par. 50(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: For greater certainty and for the purposes of paragraph 50(a) of the Act, a decision made in a judicial proceeding would not be directly contravened by the enforcement of a removal order if

label: (a)
marginal_note: Application of par. 50(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: there is an agreement between the Canada Border Services Agency and the Attorney General of Canada or the attorney general of a province that criminal charges will be withdrawn or stayed on the removal of the person from Canada; or

label: (b)
marginal_note: Application of par. 50(a) of the Act
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 3 Stay of Removal Orders
own_text: there is an agreement between the Canada Border Services Agency and the Attorney General of Canada or the attorney general of a province to withdraw or cancel any summons or subpoena on the removal of the person from Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: For greater certainty, and subject to section 51 of the Act, a removal order does not become void by reason of any lapse of time.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A person against whom a removal order is made shall be provided with a copy of the order when it is made.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order is enforced by the voluntary compliance of a foreign national with the removal order or by the removal of the foreign national by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A foreign national who wants to voluntarily comply with a removal order must appear before an officer who shall determine if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the foreign national has sufficient means to effect their departure to a country that they will be authorized to enter; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the foreign national intends to voluntarily comply with the requirements set out in paragraphs 240(1)(a) to (c) and will be able to act on that intention.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: Following the appearance referred to in subsection (1), the foreign national must submit their choice of destination to the officer who shall approve the choice unless the foreign national is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: a danger to the public;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: a fugitive from justice in Canada or another country; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: seeking to evade or frustrate the cause of justice in Canada or another country.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If a foreign national does not voluntarily comply with a removal order, a negative determination is made under subsection 238(1) or the foreign national’s choice of destination is not approved under subsection 238(2), the removal order shall be enforced by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order against a foreign national, whether it is enforced by voluntary compliance or by the Minister, is enforced when the foreign national

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: appears before an officer at a port of entry to verify their departure from Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: obtains a certificate of departure from the Canada Border Services Agency;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: departs from Canada; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: is authorized to enter, other than for purposes of transit, their country of destination.

marginal_note: When removal order is enforced by officer outside Canada
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If a foreign national against whom a removal order has not been enforced has departed from Canada and applies outside Canada for a visa, an electronic travel authorization or an authorization to return to Canada, an officer shall enforce the order if, following an examination, the foreign national establishes that they are the person described in the order.

marginal_note: When removal order is enforced by officer in Canada
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A removal order against a foreign national is enforced by an officer in Canada when the officer confirms that the foreign national has departed from Canada.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: For greater certainty, subsections (2) and (3) apply in respect of any removal order made before the day on which those subsections come into force.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If a removal order is enforced under section 239, the foreign national shall be removed to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the country from which they came to Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the country in which they last permanently resided before coming to Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: a country of which they are a national or citizen; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: the country of their birth.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: If none of the countries referred to in subsection (1) is willing to authorize the foreign national to enter, the Minister shall select any country that will authorize entry within a reasonable time and shall remove the foreign national to that country.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: Despite section 238 and subsection (1), the Minister shall remove a person who is subject to a removal order on the grounds of inadmissibility referred to in paragraph 35(1)(a) of the Act to a country that the Minister determines will authorize the person to enter.

marginal_note: Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: A person transferred under an order made under the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act is not, for the purposes of paragraph 240(1)(d), a person who has been authorized to enter their country of destination.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: Unless expenses incurred by His Majesty in right of Canada have been recovered from a transporter, a foreign national who is removed from Canada at His Majesty’s expense shall not return to Canada if the foreign national has not paid to His Majesty the removal costs of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: $3,840 for removal without escort or under escort other than by air; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: $12,880 for removal under escort by air.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: Despite paragraph 1(b), a foreign national who is removed by air under medical escort is subject to the removal cost set out in paragraph (1)(a).

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 4 Enforcement of Removal Orders
own_text: Subsections (1) and (2) do not apply to a foreign national who is under 18 years of age at the time the removal order is made.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: The following documents, held by a foreign national, are cancelled when a removal order is made against that foreign national :

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: a temporary resident visa;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: an electronic travel authorization; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: a temporary resident permit.

heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: The following documents, held by a foreign national, are cancelled when a removal order made against that foreign national becomes enforceable:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: a work permit; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 13 Removal > DIVISION 5 Cancellation of Immigration Documents
own_text: a study permit.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the purposes of Division 6 of Part 1 of the Act, the factors set out in this Part shall be taken into consideration when assessing whether a person

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: is unlikely to appear for examination, an admissibility hearing, removal from Canada, or at a proceeding that could lead to the making of a removal order by the Minister under subsection 44(2) of the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: is a danger to the public; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: is a foreign national whose identity has not been established.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 244(a), the factors are the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: being a fugitive from justice in a foreign jurisdiction in relation to an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: voluntary compliance with any previous departure order;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: voluntary compliance with any previously required appearance at an immigration or criminal proceeding;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: previous compliance with any conditions imposed in respect of entry, release or a stay of removal;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: any previous avoidance of examination or escape from custody, or any previous attempt to do so;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: involvement with a people smuggling or trafficking in persons operation that would likely lead the person to not appear for a measure referred to in paragraph 244(a) or to be vulnerable to being influenced or coerced by an organization involved in such an operation to not appear for such a measure; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the existence of strong ties to a community in Canada.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 244(b), the factors are the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the fact that the person constitutes, in the opinion of the Minister, a danger to the public in Canada or a danger to the security of Canada under paragraph 101(2)(b), subparagraph 113(d)(i) or (ii) or paragraph 115(2)(a) or (b) of the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: association with a criminal organization within the meaning of subsection 121(2) of the Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: engagement in people smuggling or trafficking in persons;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: conviction in Canada under an Act of Parliament for

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: a sexual offence, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: an offence involving violence or weapons;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: conviction for an offence in Canada under any of the following provisions of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act , namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 5 (trafficking),

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 6 (importing and exporting), and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 7 (production);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: conviction outside Canada, or the existence of pending charges outside Canada, for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament for

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: a sexual offence, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: an offence involving violence or weapons;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: conviction outside Canada, or the existence of pending charges outside Canada, for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under any of the following provisions of the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act , namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 5 (trafficking),

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 6 (importing and exporting), and

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 7 (production);

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: conviction for an offence in Canada under any of the following provisions of the Cannabis Act , namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 9 (distribution),

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 10 (selling),

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 11 (importing and exporting), and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 12 (production); and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: conviction outside Canada, or the existence of pending charges outside Canada, for an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under any of the following provisions of the Cannabis Act , namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 9 (distribution),

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 10 (selling),

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 11 (importing and exporting), and

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: section 12 (production).

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 244(c), the factors are the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the foreign national’s cooperation in providing evidence of their identity or assisting the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency in obtaining evidence of their identity, in providing the date and place of their birth as well as the names of their mother and father, in providing detailed information on the itinerary they followed in travelling to Canada or in completing an application for a travel document;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: in the case of a foreign national who makes a claim for refugee protection, the possibility of obtaining identity documents or information without divulging personal information to government officials of their country of nationality or, if there is no country of nationality, their country of former habitual residence;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the foreign national’s destruction of their identity or travel documents, or the use of fraudulent documents by the foreign national in order to mislead the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency, and the circumstances under which the foreign national acted;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the provision of contradictory information by the foreign national with respect to their identity during the processing of an application by the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the existence of documents that contradict information provided by the foreign national with respect to their identity.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: Consideration of the factors set out in paragraph (1)(a) shall not have an adverse impact with respect to minor children referred to in section 249.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: If it is determined that there are grounds for detention, the following factors shall be considered before a decision is made on detention or release:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the reason for detention;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the length of time in detention;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: whether there are any elements that can assist in determining the length of time that detention is likely to continue and, if so, that length of time;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: any unexplained delays or unexplained lack of diligence caused by the Department, the Canada Border Services Agency or the person concerned;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the existence of alternatives to detention; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the best interests of a directly affected child who is under 18 years of age.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the purpose of paragraph 248(f) and for the application, in respect of children who are under 18 years of age, of the principle affirmed in section 60 of the Act, that a minor child shall be detained only as a measure of last resort, the following factors must be considered when determining the best interests of the child:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the child’s physical, emotional and psychological well-being;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the child’s healthcare and educational needs;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the importance of maintaining relationships and the stability of the family environment, and the possible effect on the child of disrupting those relationships or that stability;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the care, protection and safety needs of the child; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the child’s views and preferences, provided the child is capable of forming their own views or expressing their preferences, taking into consideration the child’s age and maturity.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the purpose of paragraph 248(f), the level of dependency of the child on the person for whom there are grounds to detain shall also be considered when determining the best interests of the child.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: For the application of the principle affirmed in section 60 of the Act that a minor child shall be detained only as a measure of last resort, the special considerations that apply in relation to the detention of minor children who are less than 18 years of age are

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the availability of alternative arrangements with local child-care agencies or child protection services for the care and protection of the minor children;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the anticipated length of detention;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the risk of continued control by the human smugglers or traffickers who brought the children to Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the type of detention facility envisaged and the conditions of detention;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the availability of accommodation that allows for the segregation of the minor children from adult detainees who are not the parent of or the adult legally responsible for the detained minor children; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: the availability of services in the detention facility, including education, counselling and recreation.

heading_path: PART 14 Detention and Release
own_text: If a completed application for a passport or travel document must be provided as a condition of release from detention, any completed application provided by a foreign national who makes a claim for refugee protection shall not be divulged to government officials of their country of nationality or, if there is no country of nationality, their country of previous habitual residence, as long as the removal order to which the foreign national is subject is not enforceable.

marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: For the purposes of subsections 44(4), 56(3), 58(5), 58.1(4), 77.1(1) and 82(6) of the Act, the conditions that must be imposed on a foreign national or permanent resident are the following:

label: (a)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to inform the Canada Border Services Agency in writing of their address and, in advance, of any change in that address;

label: (b)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to inform the Canada Border Services Agency in writing of their employer’s name and the address of their place of employment and, in advance, of any change in that information;

label: (c)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: unless they are otherwise required to report to the Canada Border Services Agency because of a condition imposed under subsection 44(3), 56(1), 58(3) or 58.1(3) or paragraph 82(5)(b) of the Act, to report once each month to the Agency;

label: (d)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to present themselves at the time and place that an officer, the Immigration Division, the Minister or the Federal Court requires them to appear to comply with any obligation imposed on them under the Act;

label: (e)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to produce to the Canada Border Services Agency without delay the original of any passport and travel and identity documents that they hold, or that they obtain, in order to permit the Agency to make copies of those documents;

label: (f)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if a removal order made against them comes into force, to surrender to the Canada Border Services Agency without delay any passport and travel document that they hold;

label: (g)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if a removal order made against them comes into force and they do not hold a document that is required to remove them from Canada, to take without delay any action that is necessary to ensure that the document is provided to the Canada Border Services Agency, such as by producing an application or producing evidence verifying their identity;

label: (h)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to not commit an offence under an Act of Parliament or an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament;

label: (i)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if they are charged with an offence under an Act of Parliament or an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, to inform the Canada Border Services Agency of that charge in writing and without delay;

label: (j)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if they are convicted of an offence under an Act of Parliament or an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, to inform the Canada Border Services Agency of that conviction in writing and without delay; and

label: (k)
marginal_note: Inadmissibility on grounds of security — conditions
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if they intend to leave Canada, to inform the Canada Border Services Agency in writing of the date on which they intend to leave Canada.

heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 68(2) of the Act, the conditions that must be imposed on a foreign national or permanent resident by the Immigration Appeal Division are the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to inform the Canada Border Services Agency and the Immigration Appeal Division in writing, in advance, of any change in their address;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to provide to the Canada Border Services Agency a copy of any passport and travel document that they hold and, if they do not hold any such documents, to complete an application for a passport or travel document and provide that application to the Agency;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to apply for an extension of the validity period of any passport and travel document that they hold before it expires and to provide a copy of the extended document to the Canada Border Services Agency;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: to not commit an offence under an Act of Parliament or an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if they are charged with an offence under an Act of Parliament or an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, to inform the Canada Border Services Agency of that charge in writing and without delay; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 15 Prescribed Conditions
own_text: if they are convicted of an offence under an Act of Parliament or an offence that, if committed in Canada, would constitute an offence under an Act of Parliament, to inform the Canada Border Services Agency and the Immigration Appeal Division of that conviction in writing and without delay.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: A thing seized under subsection 140(1) of the Act shall be placed without delay in the custody of the Department or the Canada Border Services Agency.

marginal_note: Notice of seizure — person from whom seized
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure

marginal_note: Notice of seizure — person from whom seized
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: An officer who seizes a thing under subsection 140(1) of the Act shall provide written notice to the person from whom it was seized, including the grounds for the seizure.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the person from whom the thing was seized is not the lawful owner, the officer shall make reasonable efforts to identify the lawful owner and to give the lawful owner written notice of, and the grounds for, the seizure. If the notice is provided by mail, notification is deemed to have been provided on the seventh day after the day on which the notice was mailed.

marginal_note: Application for return — person from whom seized
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure

marginal_note: Application for return — person from whom seized
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If a thing was seized on the ground that it was fraudulently or improperly obtained or used, or that the seizure was necessary to prevent its fraudulent or improper use, the person from whom it was seized may apply for its return in writing within 60 days after the day on which the notification referred to in subsection 253(1) was provided.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the application is in respect of a thing seized on the ground that it was fraudulently or improperly obtained, in order to have the thing returned, the applicant shall demonstrate that they were entitled to have that thing in their possession at the time of the seizure and that they are still entitled to it.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the application is in respect of a thing seized on the ground that it was fraudulently or improperly used, in order to have it returned, the applicant shall demonstrate that they did not participate in the fraudulent or improper use of the thing, that at the time of the seizure they were entitled to have that thing in their possession and that they are still entitled to it.

marginal_note: Return — prevention of improper or fraudulent use
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the application is in respect of a thing seized on the ground that the seizure was necessary to prevent the thing’s fraudulent or improper use, the thing shall be returned to the applicant if they make written submissions explaining why it is no longer necessary to hold the thing in order to prevent its fraudulent or improper use, why at the time of the seizure they were entitled to have that thing in their possession and why they are still entitled to it.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If a thing was seized on the ground that it was fraudulently or improperly obtained or used, or that the seizure was necessary to prevent its fraudulent or improper use, the lawful owner may apply for its return in writing within 60 days after the day on which the notification referred to in subsection 253(2) was provided.

marginal_note: Return to lawful owner — improperly or fraudulently obtained
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the application is in respect of a thing seized on the ground that it was fraudulently or improperly obtained, in order to have the thing returned, the applicant shall demonstrate that at the time of the seizure they were the lawful owner and that they are still the lawful owner.

marginal_note: Return to lawful owner — improperly or fraudulently used
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the application is in respect of a thing seized on the ground that it was fraudulently or improperly used, in order to have it returned, the applicant shall demonstrate that

label: (a)
marginal_note: Return to lawful owner — improperly or fraudulently used
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: they did not participate in the fraudulent or improper use of the thing, that at the time of the seizure they were the lawful owner and that they are still the lawful owner; and

label: (b)
marginal_note: Return to lawful owner — improperly or fraudulently used
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: they exercised reasonable care to satisfy themselves that the person to whom they gave possession of the thing was not likely to fraudulently or improperly use it.

marginal_note: Return to lawful owner — prevention of improper or fraudulent use
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the application is in respect of a thing seized on the ground that the seizure was necessary to prevent the thing’s fraudulent or improper use, the thing shall be returned to the applicant if they make written submissions explaining why it is no longer necessary to hold the thing in order to prevent its fraudulent or improper use, why at the time of the seizure they were its lawful owner and why they are still its lawful owner.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the person from whom a thing was seized makes an application under section 254 for the return of the thing and the lawful owner makes an application under section 255 for the same thing, the application of the lawful owner will be processed first. If the application of the lawful owner is granted, the application of the person from whom the thing was seized shall not be processed.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
PART 16 Seizure
own_text: The decision on the application made under section 254 or 255 and the reasons for it must be given in writing and provided to the applicant as soon as feasible.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If a decision is made to return the thing, it must be returned without delay.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: A decision provided by mail is deemed to have been provided on the seventh day after the day on which it was mailed.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the seizure of a thing was necessary to carry out the purposes of the Act, the thing shall be returned to its lawful owner without delay if the seizure is no longer necessary for those purposes.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If the seizure of a thing was made in error, the thing shall be returned without delay to the person from whom the thing was seized or, if that is not possible, to its lawful owner.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: A thing seized shall be returned only if its return would not be contrary to the purposes of the Act.

marginal_note: Sale or destruction of seized thing
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure

marginal_note: Sale or destruction of seized thing
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If a thing seized, other than a document, is not returned to its lawful owner or the person from whom it was seized, the thing shall be sold unless the costs of the sale would exceed the monetary value of the thing, in which case the thing shall be destroyed.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: A thing seized shall not be sold or destroyed

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: within the 15 days after the day on which the notification of a decision not to return it was provided; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: before a final decision is made in any judicial proceeding in Canada affecting the seizure or the return of the thing seized.

heading_path: PART 16 Seizure
own_text: If a document is not returned to its lawful owner or the person from whom it was seized, the document shall be held for as long as is necessary for the administration of the laws of Canada, after which it shall either be returned to the authority that issued it or disposed of in accordance with the laws of Canada.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 148(1)(a) of the Act, the following persons are prescribed:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: any foreign national who is the subject of a declaration made under subsection 22.1(1) of the Act, unless they hold a temporary resident permit issued under section 24 of the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: any foreign national who is not authorized under subsection 52(1) of the Act to return to Canada; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: any foreign national who is prohibited from entering Canada by an order or regulation made by the Governor in Council under the Emergencies Act or the Quarantine Act .

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 148(1) of the Act, the following documents that a person requires under the Act to enter Canada are prescribed:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a travel document referred to in subsection 31(3) of the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: refugee travel papers issued by the Minister;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a document referred to in subsection 50(1) or 52(1);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a temporary travel document referred to in section 151;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a visa referred to in section 6 or subsection 7(1);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a permanent resident card; and

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: an electronic travel authorization referred to in section 7.01 or 7.1 .

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If a commercial transporter has reasonable grounds to believe that the prescribed documents of a person whom it carries to Canada may not be available for examination at a port of entry, the commercial transporter must give the person a receipt for the documents and hold the documents until examination.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter that holds the documents of a person must, when presenting the person for examination under paragraph 148(1)(b) of the Act, present the documents and a copy of the receipt.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 148(1)(b) of the Act, a transporter has complied with the obligation to hold a person until the examination is completed when

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: an officer informs the transporter that the examination of the person is completed;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the person is authorized to enter Canada under section 23 of the Act; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the person is detained under any Canadian law.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A transporter must notify an officer without delay if a person whose examination has not been completed leaves or attempts to leave the transporter’s vehicle for any other purpose than examination.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: On the arrival of a vessel at its first port of call in Canada, the transporter must notify an officer at the nearest port of entry of the presence of any stowaway and, on request of the officer, must without delay provide a written report concerning the stowaway.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter must arrange for the medical examination of a foreign national who is required to submit to one under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act and for any medical examination, surveillance or treatment that is imposed under section 32.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the foreign national holds a temporary or permanent resident visa at the time of their examination and the foreign national’s health condition is not a result of the commercial transporter’s negligence; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the foreign national has been authorized to enter and remain in Canada and is not a member of the crew.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph 148(1)(g) of the Act, any medical costs incurred with respect to the foreign national are prescribed costs and are to be calculated on the basis of the applicable provincial health insurance system.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A transporter must provide without delay any of the following documents that are requested by an officer within 72 hours after the presentation for examination of a person carried by the transporter to Canada:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a copy of any ticket issued to the person;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a document specifying the person’s itinerary, including the place of embarkation and dates of travel; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a document identifying the document number and type of passport, travel document or identity document carried by the person, the country of issue and the name of the person to whom it was issued.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: On arrival at the first port of call in Canada of a vessel registered in a foreign country, the transporter must provide an officer at the nearest port of entry with a list of all members of the crew.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The transporter must maintain on board a current list of all members of the crew while the vessel is in Canada.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Before the vessel’s departure from its final port of call in Canada, the transporter must provide an officer with a copy of the list referred to in subsection (1) that includes any changes made while the vessel was in Canada.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: On the request of an officer, a transporter must assemble without delay aboard the vessel all members of the crew.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: On the arrival of a vessel registered in Canada at its first port of call in Canada, the transporter must notify an officer at the nearest port of entry of all members of the crew who are not Canadian citizens or permanent residents and, on request, provide the officer with a list of all crew members.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A transporter must, without delay, notify an officer at the nearest port of entry of any foreign national who ceases to be a member of the crew for a reason listed in paragraph 3(1)(b). The transporter must record that information and provide it in writing on the request of the officer.

marginal_note: Failure to join means of transportation
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A transporter must, without delay, notify an officer at the nearest port of entry when a foreign national who entered Canada to become a member of the crew of the transporter’s vessel fails to join the means of transportation within the period provided in paragraph 184(2)(b).

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: On the request of an official of the Canada Border Services Agency, a commercial transporter that carries or expects to carry persons to Canada on board its commercial vehicle must provide the Canada Border Services Agency with the following information about each person whom it expects to carry:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: their surname, first name and any middle names, their date of birth, their citizenship or nationality and their gender;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the type and number of each passport or other travel document that identifies them and the name of the country or entity that issued it;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: their reservation record locator number, if any;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: their status as a passenger or crew member and confirmation whether they are in transit to a place outside Canada;

label: (c.2)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: if they are in transit to a place outside Canada, their first destination outside Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the unique passenger reference assigned to them by the commercial transporter, if any;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: any information about the person that is in a reservation system of the commercial transporter or its agent; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the following information about their carriage on board the commercial vehicle:

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: if the person is carried or is expected to be carried on board the commercial vehicle by air, the date and time of take-off from the last point of embarkation of persons before the commercial vehicle arrives in Canada or, if the person is carried or is expected to be carried on board the vehicle by water or land, the date and time of departure from the last point of embarkation of persons before the commercial vehicle arrives in Canada,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the last point of embarkation of persons before the commercial vehicle arrives in Canada,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the date and time of arrival of the commercial vehicle at the first point of disembarkation of persons in Canada,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the first point of disembarkation of persons in Canada, and

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: in the case of a commercial vehicle that carries persons or goods by air, the flight code identifying the commercial transporter and the flight number.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The information referred to in subsection (1) must be provided by electronic means in accordance with the technical requirements, specifications and procedures for electronic data interchange set out in the document entitled CBSA Carrier Messaging Requirements issued by the Canada Border Services Agency, as amended from time to time.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The information referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) to (d) must be provided

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: not later than one hour before the time of departure, if the information relates to a member of the crew; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: not later than the time of check-in, if the information relates to any other person who is expected to be on board the commercial vehicle.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The information referred to in paragraph (1)(e) must be provided not later than at the time of departure.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The information referred to in paragraph (1)(d) must also be provided, for each passenger who is on board the commercial vehicle at the time of departure, not later than 30 minutes after the time of departure.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter that becomes aware before or at the time of departure that information they have provided under paragraph 148(1)(d) of the Act is incomplete or inaccurate must, in the manner described in subsection (2) and without delay, provide the Canada Border Services Agency with the missing or accurate information.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Subsection (6) does not apply in respect of information referred to in paragraph (1)(e).

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The information referred to in paragraph (1)(f) must be provided at the same time that any information referred to in subsections (3) to (6) is provided.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The Canada Border Services Agency may retain information referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) to (d) about a person for up to three years and six months after the day of departure of the commercial vehicle that carried or was to carry the person to Canada.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: After the period referred to in subsection (9), the Canada Border Services Agency may retain the information referred to in that subsection about a person for as long as it is required as part of an investigation, but in no case longer than six years after the day of departure of the commercial vehicle that carried or was to carry the person to Canada.

marginal_note: Notice by Canada Border Services Agency
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation

marginal_note: Notice by Canada Border Services Agency
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The Canada Border Services Agency may notify a commercial transporter that a person whom it expects to carry to Canada may be a person who is prescribed under section 258.1 or may be a person who does not hold the necessary documents prescribed under section 259.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: For greater certainty, subsection (1) does not relieve a commercial transporter of its obligation to comply with any requirement imposed by the Act or these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter, and a transporter who operates an airport or an international bridge or tunnel, must provide and maintain, free of charge, facilities, including areas, offices and laboratories, that are adequate for the holding and examination of persons being carried to Canada.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The facilities referred to in subsection (1) are adequate if they satisfy the applicable requirements of Part II of the Canada Labour Code , are secure and, if necessary, sterile, and include equipment and furnishings that permit officers to discharge their duties under the Act.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter carrying persons to Canada aboard its vessel must provide facilities aboard the vessel that permit an officer to conduct examinations.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter that has carried a foreign national referred to in this subsection to Canada or caused such a foreign national to be carried to Canada must, without delay, carry the foreign national from Canada

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: to any other country, in the case of a foreign national directed to leave under subsection 40(1);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: to the United States, in the case of a foreign national directed back to that country under section 41;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: to any other country, in the case of a foreign national allowed to withdraw their application under section 42; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: to the country to which the foreign national is removed under section 241, in the case of a foreign national who is subject to an enforceable removal order.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The transporter must transport a foreign national who is subject to an enforceable removal order from wherever the foreign national is situated in Canada to the vehicle in which they will be carried to another country.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If a transporter carries, or causes to be carried, a foreign national to Canada as a member of its crew or to become a member of its crew, and the foreign national is subject to an enforceable removal order, the transporter must carry that foreign national from Canada to the applicable country as determined under Division 4 of Part 13.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The transporter must transport the foreign national referred to in subsection (1) from wherever the foreign national is situated in Canada to the vehicle in which they will be carried to another country.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A transporter must notify an officer without delay if a foreign national referred to in section 273 or 274 whom they are carrying from Canada leaves or attempts to leave a vehicle before they are carried from Canada.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: When a foreign national who seeks to enter Canada is made subject to a removal order and a commercial transporter is or may be required under the Act to carry that foreign national from Canada, an officer must

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: notify the commercial transporter that it is or may be required to carry the foreign national from Canada; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: when the removal order is enforceable, notify the commercial transporter of its obligation to carry the foreign national from Canada and, if an escort is necessary, request the commercial transporter to provide an escort or to make arrangements for the carriage of an escort assigned by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: After being notified under paragraph (1)(b), the commercial transporter must, without delay,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: make arrangements to carry the foreign national from Canada and notify an officer of those arrangements; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: notify an officer that it is unable to make such arrangements.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The commercial transporter must carry the foreign national from Canada within 48 hours after giving the notice required by paragraph (2)(a).

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If a commercial transporter does not comply with paragraph 2(a) or subsection (3) or notifies an officer that it is unable to comply with those provisions, or if an officer notifies the commercial transporter in writing that the proposed arrangements are not acceptable, an officer must cause the foreign national to be carried from Canada and the commercial transporter must pay the costs referred to in section 278.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: To be acceptable, the arrangements referred to in subsection (2) must meet the following requirements:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the itinerary must begin where the foreign national is situated in Canada and end in the country and city to which the foreign national is to be removed, following the most direct routing possible;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the itinerary must not include a country through which transit has not been approved; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the period of time between any connections must not exceed 12 hours.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter that has been notified under paragraph 1(b) must comply with any request by an officer to provide an escort or to arrange for the carriage of the escort assigned by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Despite sections 273 and 276, a commercial transporter is relieved of its obligation to carry a foreign national from Canada, except for a member of its crew or a foreign national who entered Canada to become a member of its crew, if the foreign national at the time of their examination

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: was authorized to enter and remain in Canada on a temporary basis;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: held a temporary or permanent resident visa; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: was a person prescribed under section 258.1 and the commercial transporter was not, before the person was carried to Canada, notified under section 270 that the person may have been a prescribed person.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A transporter that is required under the Act to carry a foreign national from Canada must pay the following costs of removal and, if applicable, attempted removal:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: expenses incurred within or outside Canada with respect to the foreign national’s accommodation and transport, including penalties for changes of date or routing;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: accommodation and travel expenses incurred by any escorts provided to accompany the foreign national;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: fees paid in obtaining passports, travel documents and visas for the foreign national and any escorts;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the cost of meals, incidentals and other expenses as calculated in accordance with the rates set out in the Travel Directive published by the Treasury Board Secretariat, as amended from time to time;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: any wages paid to escorts and other personnel; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the costs or expenses incurred with respect to interpreters and medical and other personnel engaged for the removal.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), an administration fee must be assessed against a commercial transporter in respect of any of the following foreign nationals it carried or caused to be carried to Canada:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who is inadmissible under section 41 of the Act for failing to meet the requirements of section 6 , subsection 7 (1), section 7.01 or 7.1 or subsection 50 (1) or 52 (1);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who is prescribed under section 258.1 or whom the commercial transporter has been directed under paragraph 148(1)(a) of the Act not to carry to Canada;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who is exempt, under subsection 52(2), from the requirement to hold a passport or travel document but who fails to produce sufficient evidence of their identity;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who failed to appear for an examination on entry into Canada;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who entered Canada as a member of a crew or to become a member of a crew and is inadmissible; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who is subject to a removal order, or is allowed under section 42 to withdraw their application to enter Canada, and who fails to leave Canada immediately.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: An administration fee shall not be assessed against a commercial transporter in respect of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a person referred to in section 39;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who is prescribed under section 258.1 and in respect of whom notice under section 270 was not given before the foreign national was carried to Canada but who holds the necessary documents prescribed under section 259;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national who does not hold an electronic travel authorization when one is required under section 7.01 or 7.1 and in respect of whom the Canada Border Services Agency did not give notice under section 270 to the commercial transporter before the foreign national was carried to Canada, but who holds one of the required prescribed documents set out in paragraphs 259 (a) to (f); or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: a foreign national, other than a foreign national referred to in paragraph 190 (3)(c), who seeks to enter Canada to obtain permanent residence and is inadmissible under paragraph 41(a) of the Act for failing to obtain a permanent resident visa as required under section 6 , but who is exempted under Division 1 of Part 2 from the requirement to obtain an electronic travel authorization required under section 7.01 or 7.1 or exempted under Division 5 of Part 9 from the requirement to obtain a temporary resident visa.

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2016-37, s. 11]

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), the administration fee assessed under section 279 is $3,200.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If a memorandum of understanding in accordance with subsection (3) is in effect between the commercial transporter and the Minister, the administration fee assessed is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: $3,200, if the commercial transporter does not demonstrate that it complies with the memorandum of understanding, if the commercial transporter carried to Canada a foreign national who is prescribed under section 258.1 or whom the commercial transporter has been directed under paragraph 148(1)(a) of the Act not to carry to Canada, or if the administration fee is assessed in respect of a member of the crew of the transporter;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: $2,400, if the commercial transporter demonstrates that it complies with the memorandum of understanding;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: $1,600, if the commercial transporter demonstrates that it complies with the memorandum of understanding and has a number of administration fee assessments that is equal to or less than the number specified in the memorandum, for the period specified in the memorandum, for reducing the administration fee by 50%;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: $800, if the commercial transporter demonstrates that it complies with the memorandum of understanding and has a number of administration fee assessments that is equal to or less than the number specified in the memorandum, for the period specified in the memorandum, for reducing the administration fee by 75%; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: $0, if the commercial transporter demonstrates that it complies with the memorandum of understanding and has a number of administration fee assessments that is equal to or less than the number specified in the memorandum, for the period specified in the memorandum, for reducing the administration fee by 100%.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A memorandum of understanding referred to in subsection (2) shall include provisions respecting

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: document screening;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the training of personnel in document screening;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the use of technological aids;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: fraud prevention;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: gate checks;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: information exchange;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: performance standards and administration fee assessments;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: compliance monitoring of the provisions of the memorandum of understanding;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: holding documents under section 260;

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: providing information referred to in subsections 269(1) and (2);

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: stowaways; and

label: (l)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: security screening of members of a crew.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The assessment of an administration fee shall be served personally, by registered mail, by facsimile with acknowledgement of receipt or by electronic transmission on a representative of the commercial transporter.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Service of the assessment by registered mail is deemed to have been effected on the seventh day after the day on which the assessment was mailed.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The commercial transporter may submit written submissions to the Minister within 30 days after being served with an assessment of an administration fee.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If submissions are made, the Minister must consider the submissions, confirm, vary or cancel the assessment and give written notice of the final decision to the commercial transporter.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: In considering the submissions, the Minister must take into account whether the commercial transporter was, before the foreign national was carried to Canada, notified under section 270 that the foreign national may have been a person prescribed under section 258.1 or a person who did not hold an electronic travel authorization when one was required under section 7.01 or 7.1 .

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If no submissions are made within the 30-day period, the assessment is final and the commercial transporter is liable for the assessment at the end of that period.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If the Minister confirms an assessment under subsection (2), the commercial transporter is liable for the assessment on the date the notice is sent.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: The Minister may, on the basis of the following factors, require a commercial transporter to provide security for compliance with its obligations under paragraphs 148(1)(a) to (g) of the Act:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the frequency and regularity of arrival, or anticipated arrival, of the transporter’s vehicles carrying persons to Canada;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the number of persons carried, or anticipated to be carried, to Canada aboard the transporter’s vehicles;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: whether the transporter has carried an inadmissible foreign national to Canada; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the anticipated risk of inadmissible foreign nationals being carried to Canada by the transporter.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If the Minister requires security to be provided, the Minister shall determine the amount of security on the basis of the following factors:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the commercial transporter’s record of compliance with the Act; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the anticipated risk of inadmissible foreign nationals being carried to Canada by the transporter and the estimated removal costs.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A commercial transporter who is required to provide security must provide it in the form of a cash deposit unless

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the transporter has entered into a memorandum of understanding referred to in subsection 280(2) that provides for another form of security; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the transporter demonstrates that there is no significant risk of a debt not being paid if they were to provide another form of security.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If the Minister determines on the basis of the factors set out in subsection (1) that security is no longer required, the Minister shall return the security to the commercial transporter.

marginal_note: Application of s. 148(2) of the Act
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: For the purposes of subsection 148(2) of the Act, a prescribed good is a good that is not land, a building or a transportation facility.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If an object is detained or seized under subsection 148(2) of the Act, that object shall remain detained or seized until

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the transporter complies with its obligations under section 148 of the Act; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the transporter’s obligations are discharged by another person.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Following a seizure under subsection 148(2) of the Act, an officer shall make reasonable efforts to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: identify the lawful owner of the object seized; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: give notice of the seizure to that person.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: A thing seized under subsection 148(2) of the Act shall be disposed of by

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: returning the object to the transporter on receipt of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: an amount equal to the value of the object at the time of seizure and any expenses incurred in the seizure and, if applicable, detention,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: the security required under the Act or any costs and fees for which the transporter is liable, as well as an amount equal to any expenses incurred in the seizure and, if applicable, detention, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: evidence that the transporter is in compliance with its obligations under subsection 148(1) of the Act and has reimbursed Her Majesty in right of Canada for any expenses incurred in the seizure and, if applicable, detention; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: disposing of the object under section 287.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
PART 17 Transportation
own_text: If a transporter does not comply with paragraph 286(2)(a) within a reasonable time, an officer shall give notice to the transporter that the object will be sold. The object shall then be sold for the benefit of Her Majesty in right of Canada and the proceeds of the sale shall be applied to the transporter’s outstanding debt to Her Majesty under the Act. Any surplus shall be returned to the transporter.

heading_path: PART 17 Transportation
own_text: Any expenses incurred by Her Majesty in right of Canada in selling the object, and any expenses incurred in the seizure or, if applicable, detention of the object, shall be deducted from the proceeds of the sale.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: In this Part, beneficiary , in respect of a person, means

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: the person’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: a dependent child of the person or of the person’s spouse, common-law partner or conjugal partner; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: any other person who, at the time of their application for a permanent resident visa or their application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, is in a relationship of dependency with the person by virtue of being cared for by or receiving emotional and financial support from the person.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: The Minister may make loans to the following persons for the following purposes:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: to a foreign national referred to in Part 1 of the Act for the purpose of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the cost to the foreign national and their beneficiaries of transportation from their point of departure outside Canada to their point of destination in Canada, and related administrative charges,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: assisting the foreign national and their beneficiaries to become established in Canada, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the fee, referred to in subsection 303(1), payable for the acquisition by the foreign national and their beneficiaries of permanent resident status;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: to a foreign national referred to in Part 2 of the Act for the purpose of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the cost to the foreign national and their beneficiaries of transportation from their point of departure outside Canada to their point of destination in Canada, and related administrative charges,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
