own_text: defraying the cost to the foreign national and their beneficiaries of transportation to attend any interview relating to their application, and related administrative charges,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the cost to the foreign national and their beneficiaries of a medical examination under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act, and related costs and administrative charges, or

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: assisting the foreign national and their beneficiaries to become established in Canada; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: to a permanent resident or a Canadian citizen for the purpose of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the cost to their beneficiaries of transportation from their point of departure outside Canada to their point of destination in Canada, and related administrative charges,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the cost to their beneficiaries of a medical examination under paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Act, and related costs and administrative charges, if the beneficiaries are protected persons within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act, or

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: defraying the fee, referred to in subsection 303(1), payable for the acquisition by their beneficiaries of permanent resident status.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
PART 18 Loans
own_text: The maximum amount of advances that may be made under subsection 88(1) of the Act is $400 million.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: The total amount of all loans made under this Part plus accrued interest on those loans shall not at any time exceed the maximum amount of advances prescribed by subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
PART 18 Loans
own_text: Subject to section 292, a loan made under section 289 becomes payable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: in the case of a loan for the purpose of defraying transportation costs, one year after the day on which the person for whose benefit the loan was made enters Canada; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: in the case of a loan for any other purpose, one year after the day on which the loan was made.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: Subject to section 292, a loan made under section 289, together with all accrued interest, if applicable, must be repaid in full, in consecutive monthly instalments, within

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: 36 months after the day on which the loan becomes payable, if the amount of the loan is not more than $1,200;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: 48 months after the day on which the loan becomes payable, if the amount of the loan is more than $1,200 but not more than $2,400;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: 60 months after the day on which the loan becomes payable, if the amount of the loan is more than $2,400 but not more than $3,600;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: 72 months after the day on which the loan becomes payable, if the amount of the loan is more than $3,600 but not more than $4,800; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: 96 months after the day on which the loan becomes payable, if the amount of the loan is more than $4,800.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
PART 18 Loans
own_text: If repaying a loan, in accordance with the requirements of section 291, that was made to a person under section 289 would, by reason of the person’s income, assets and liabilities, cause the person financial hardship, an officer may, to the extent necessary to relieve that hardship but subject to subsection (2), defer the commencement of the repayment of the loan, defer payments on the loan, vary the amount of the payments or extend the repayment period.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: A repayment period shall not be extended beyond

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: an additional 24 months, in the case of a loan referred to in paragraph 289(b); and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: an additional six months, in the case of any other loan.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
PART 18 Loans
own_text: A loan made under this Part bears no interest as of the day on which this section comes into force.

heading_path: PART 18 Loans
own_text: The interest on any loan that has not been repaid before that day continues to accrue until the day preceding that day.

own_text: A person who is a member of the protected temporary residents class and the family members included in their application are not required to pay the fees referred to in subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 3 Fees for Applications to Remain in Canada as a Permanent Resident
own_text: The fee payable under subsection (1) in respect of a person who makes an application as a member of the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class or their family members

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 3 Fees for Applications to Remain in Canada as a Permanent Resident
own_text: is payable, together with the fee payable under subsection 304(1), at the time the sponsor files the sponsorship application; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 3 Fees for Applications to Remain in Canada as a Permanent Resident
own_text: shall be repaid in accordance with regulations referred to in subsection 20(2) of the Financial Administration Act if, before the processing of the application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident has begun, the sponsorship application is withdrawn by the sponsor.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 3 Fees for Applications to Remain in Canada as a Permanent Resident
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (1)(a), the age of the person in respect of whom the application is made shall be determined as of the day the sponsorship application is filed.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 3 Fees for Applications to Remain in Canada as a Permanent Resident
own_text: A fee of $325 is payable for processing an application by a person as a member of the permit holder class to remain in Canada as a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: A fee of $500 is payable by a person for the acquisition of permanent resident status.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: The fee set out in subsection (1) shall be indexed at 09:00:00 a.m. Eastern daylight time on April 30, 2022, and every two years after that on April 30 at that same time, in accordance with the cumulative percentage increase to the Consumer Price Index for Canada, published by Statistics Canada, for the two previous years, rounded to the nearest five dollars.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: The following persons are not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a person who is a family member of a principal applicant and is a dependent child referred to in paragraph (b) or (c) of the definition family member in subsection 1(3);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a principal applicant who is a foreign national referred to in paragraph 117(1)(b), (f) or (g);

label: (b.1)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a principal applicant in Canada who has made an application in accordance with section 66 and is a dependent child of a permanent resident or of a Canadian citizen;

label: (b.2)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a member of the permit holder class who is a dependent child of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a member of the permit holder class who has made an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a permanent resident or a Canadian citizen;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a protected person within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act who has applied to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, and their family members;

label: (c.1)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a person who is a member of the protected temporary residents class and is described in paragraph 151.1(2)(b) and the family members included in their application;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a person who is a member of the Convention refugees abroad class, and the family members included in their application; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: a person who is a member of a humanitarian-protected persons abroad class, and the family members included in their application.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1) is payable

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: in the case of an application by or on behalf of a person for a permanent resident visa, before the visa is issued; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: in the case of an application by or on behalf of a foreign national to remain in Canada as a permanent resident, before the foreign national becomes a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1) is remitted if the person does not acquire permanent resident status, in which case the fee shall be repaid by the Minister to the person who paid it.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: For the purpose of subsection (4), if the fee was paid before the day on which this subsection comes into force, the amount to be remitted and repaid — except to the extent otherwise remitted — is $975.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: Despite subsections (4) and (5), in the case where the fee of $975 was paid in accordance with paragraph (3)(a), a portion of that fee in the amount of $485 is remitted and shall be repaid — except to the extent otherwise remitted — by the Minister to the person who paid the fee if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: the person in respect of whom the fee was paid has, on or before the day on which this subsection comes into force, not yet acquired permanent resident status and they are a person referred to in any of paragraphs 117(1)(a), (c), (d) or (h); or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4 Right of Permanent Residence
own_text: the person in respect of whom the fee was paid acquires permanent resident status on or after the day on which this subsection comes into force and they are not a person referred to in any of paragraphs 117(1)(a), (c), (d) or (h).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: A fee of $230 is payable by an employer who has made an offer of employment to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: a foreign national in respect of work described in section 204 or 205;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: a foreign national described in section 207; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: a foreign national referred to in paragraph (a) or (b) who makes an application for renewal of a work permit.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1) is payable before the foreign national to whom the offer of employment is made makes an application for a work permit or an application for renewal of the work permit.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2019-174, s. 15]

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2019-174, s. 15]

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: An employer who is exempt from the application of sections 209.11 and 209.2 under section 209.91 is not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: An employer is not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1) if the offer of employment is made to a foreign national — other than a person referred to in paragraph 299(2)(i) — who under subsection 299(2) is not required to pay a fee for processing an application for a work permit.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1) is remitted, and must be repaid by the Minister to the person who paid it, if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: the work permit is refused; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: the employer withdraws the offer of employment and requests a remission before the work permit is issued.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Compliance Regime — Employer Fee
own_text: The total amount of fees payable under subsection (1) by an employer who has made offers of employment to a group of three or more foreign nationals, consisting of performing artists and their staff, is $690, if those offers are made at the same time.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: A fee of $100 is payable by a person for the rights and privileges conferred by means of a work permit if that person is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: a foreign national who intends to perform work described in section 204 or 205 but does not have an offer of employment to perform that work;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: a foreign national described in paragraph 207(b) who does not have an offer of employment; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: a family member of a foreign national referred to in paragraph (b).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: The following persons are not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: a person — other than a person referred to in paragraph 299(2)(i) — who under subsection 299(2) is not required to pay a fee for processing an application for a work permit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: a person referred to in paragraph 299(2)(i) who intends to perform work under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries, if the agreement

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: prohibits the payment of a fee other than a participation fee, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: is in force at the time that the person makes an application for a work permit or for renewal of the work permit; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2017-78, s. 11]

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1) is remitted, and must be repaid by the Minister to the person who paid it, if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: the work permit is refused; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 4.1 Other Fees in Respect of Work Permits > Rights and Privileges
own_text: the foreign national withdraws their application and requests a remission before the work permit is issued.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Sponsorship Application for Family Classes
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Sponsorship Application for Family Classes
own_text: A fee of $75 is payable for processing a sponsorship application under Part 7.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Sponsorship Application for Family Classes
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1) is payable at the time the application is filed.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: A fee of $100 is payable for processing an application under subsection 181(1).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: The following persons are not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person who makes an application for a work permit or a study permit at the same time as they make the application referred to in subsection (1);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person who has made a claim for refugee protection that has not yet been determined by the Refugee Protection Division;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person on whom refugee protection has been conferred;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person who is a member of the Convention refugees abroad class or a humanitarian-protected persons abroad class;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a properly accredited diplomat, consular officer, representative or official of a country other than Canada, of the United Nations or any of its agencies or of any intergovernmental organization of which Canada is a member, the members of the suite of such a person and the family members of such a person;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a member of the armed forces of a country that is a designated state for the purposes of the Visiting Forces Act , including a person who has been designated as a civilian component of that visiting force under paragraph 4(c) of that Act, and their family members;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person who is a member of the clergy, a member of a religious order or a lay person who is to assist a congregation or a group in the achievement of its spiritual goals, if the duties to be performed by the person are to consist mainly of preaching doctrine, presiding at liturgical functions or spiritual counselling, and their family members;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: an officer of a foreign government sent, under an exchange agreement between Canada and one or more countries, to take up duties with a federal or provincial agency; and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a family member of any of the following persons, namely,

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person who holds a study permit and is temporarily destitute, as described in paragraph 208(a),

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person whose work is designated under subparagraph 205(c)(i),

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person whose work in Canada is for a Canadian religious or charitable organization, without remuneration,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person whose presence in Canada is as a participant in a program sponsored by the Canadian International Development Agency, or

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Extension of Authorization to Remain in Canada as a Temporary Resident
own_text: a person whose presence in Canada is as a recipient of a Government of Canada scholarship or fellowship.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Restoration of Temporary Resident Status
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Restoration of Temporary Resident Status
own_text: A fee of $200 is payable for processing an application under section 182.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Restoration of Temporary Resident Status
own_text: A person who holds an unexpired temporary resident permit is not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Fees for a Request under Section 25 of the Act or an Examination of Circumstances under Section 25.2 of the Act
own_text: The following fees are payable for processing an application made in accordance with section 66 or for examining the circumstances under subsection 25.2(1) of the Act of a foreign national who applies for permanent resident status or for a permanent resident visa, if no fees are payable in respect of the same applicant for processing an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident or an application for a permanent resident visa:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Fees for a Request under Section 25 of the Act or an Examination of Circumstances under Section 25.2 of the Act
own_text: in the case of a principal applicant, $550;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Fees for a Request under Section 25 of the Act or an Examination of Circumstances under Section 25.2 of the Act
own_text: in the case of a family member of the principal applicant who is a spouse or common-law partner, $550; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Fees for a Request under Section 25 of the Act or an Examination of Circumstances under Section 25.2 of the Act
own_text: in the case of a family member of the principal applicant who is a dependent child, $150.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Permanent Resident Cards
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Permanent Resident Cards
own_text: A fee of $50 is payable for processing an application made under paragraph 53(1)(b) for a permanent resident card.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Permanent Resident Cards
own_text: A fee of $50 is payable for processing an application for the renewal of a permanent resident card or for the replacement of a lost, stolen or destroyed permanent resident card.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Permanent Resident Cards
own_text: No fee is payable for the replacement of a permanent resident card containing an error that is not attributable to the permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Determination of Rehabilitation
own_text: The following fees are payable for processing an application for a determination of rehabilitation under paragraph 36(3)(c) of the Act:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Determination of Rehabilitation
own_text: in the case of a foreign national inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality under paragraph 36(1)(b) or (c) of the Act, $1,000; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Determination of Rehabilitation
own_text: in the case of a foreign national inadmissible on grounds of criminality under paragraph 36(2)(b) or (c) of the Act, $200.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Authorization to Return to Canada
own_text: A fee of $400 is payable for processing an application for authorization to return to Canada under subsection 52(1) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
own_text: A fee of $30 is payable for processing an application for the certification of an immigration document, other than a permanent resident card, confirming the date on which a person became a permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
own_text: A fee of $30 is payable for processing an application to replace any immigration document, other than a permanent resident card, that is issued by the Department.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
own_text: The following persons are not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
own_text: a federal, provincial or municipal government agency;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
own_text: a person in receipt of provincial social assistance payments; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Certification and Replacement of Immigration Document
own_text: a person in receipt of assistance under the Resettlement Assistance Program.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
own_text: The following fees are payable for an examination for the purpose of entering Canada that is made outside the applicable service hours of the port of entry where the officer who conducts the examination is based:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
own_text: a fee of $100 for the first four hours of examination; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
own_text: a fee of $30 for each additional hour or part of an hour of examination.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
own_text: The fees are payable at the time of the examination

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
own_text: if the transporter’s vehicle carrying the person to be examined arrives unscheduled at a port of entry outside service hours, by the transporter; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > After-hours Examination
own_text: in any other case, by the person who requests that the examination take place outside service hours.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Alternative Means of Examination
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: A fee of $30 is payable for processing an application to enroll in a program for an alternative means of examination that is administered solely by the Minister.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Alternative Means of Examination
own_text: The fee is payable in respect of each person to be examined by an alternative means referred to in subsection (1).

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: The following fees are payable for processing an application for immigration statistical data that have not been published by the Department:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: $100 for the first 10 minutes or less of access to the Department’s database in order to respond to such an application; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: $30 for each additional minute or less of such access.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: The following persons are not required to pay the fees referred to in subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: an employee of the Department; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: an employee of the Data Development Division of the Department of Employment and Social Development.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: The fee referred to in subsection (1)(b) is payable at the time the service is rendered.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Immigration Statistical Data
own_text: A fee of $50 is payable for processing an application for a travel document issued under subsection 31(3) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: A fee of $85 is payable for the provision of services in relation to the collection of biometric information under section 10.01 of the Act.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: The following persons are not required to pay the fee referred to in subsection (1):

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: with respect to an application referred to in paragraph 12.1(a), a person who applied for refugee protection outside Canada and their family members;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: with respect to a request referred to in paragraph 12.1(f),

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: a person referred to in paragraph 12.2(1)(h), if the 48-hour period has elapsed and the person ceases to be exempt under that paragraph, and

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who, while they are in transit to Canada, ceases to be exempt under paragraph 190(1)(a) from the requirement for a temporary resident visa, if, during the first 48 hours after they cease to be exempt from that requirement, they seek to enter and remain in Canada and are inadmissible to Canada for the sole reason that they do not have a temporary resident visa;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: with respect to an application referred to in paragraph 12.1(j), protected persons, within the meaning of subsection 95(2) of the Act, who are in Canada;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: with respect to an application or request referred to in paragraphs 12.1(d) to (i),

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: a properly accredited diplomat, consular officer, representative or official of a country other than Canada, of the United Nations or any of its agencies or of any intergovernmental organization of which Canada is a member,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information
own_text: a person who is a family member of a person referred to in subparagraph (i),

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to Collection of Biometric Information

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: A fee of $1,000 is payable for the provision of services in relation to an assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development that is requested by an employer or group of employers under subsection 203(2) for each offer of employment in respect of which the request is made.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: The fee must be paid at the time the request is made.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: No fee is payable if the request is made in respect of an offer of employment that relates to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: work to be performed under an international agreement between Canada and one or more countries concerning seasonal agricultural workers; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: any other work in the primary agriculture sector.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: For the purposes of paragraph (3)(b), work in the primary agriculture sector means, subject to subsection (5), work that is performed within the boundaries of a farm, nursery or greenhouse and involves

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the operation of agricultural machinery;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the boarding, care, breeding, sanitation or other handling of animals, other than fish, for the purpose of obtaining animal products for market, or activities relating to the collection, handling and assessment of those products; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the planting, care, harvesting or preparation of crops, trees, sod or other plants for market.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: Work in the primary agriculture sector does not include work involving

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the activities of agronomists or agricultural economists;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: landscape architecture;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: [Repealed, SOR/2014-169, s. 1]

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the preparation of vegetable fibres for textile use;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: activities related to commercial hunting and trapping; or

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: veterinary activities.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: No fee is payable if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the request is made in respect of an offer of employment that relates to work performed in a private household providing care to a person who is incapable of caring for themselves without assistance due to a physical or mental condition and who has a medical certificate from a medical practitioner entitled to practice medicine under the laws of a province, attesting to their incapacity; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the employer is the person receiving care or is

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: that person’s spouse or common-law partner,

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: that person’s relative,

label: (iii)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the child or grandchild of that person’s spouse or common-law partner,

label: (iv)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: any person legally authorized to act on behalf of that person such as a guardian, a tutor, a curator or a person acting under a power of attorney or protective mandate, or

label: (v)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: any person living with that person.

heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: No fee is payable if the request is made in respect of an offer of employment that relates to work performed in a private household providing care to children under 13 years of age, by an employer who meets the following conditions:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the employer lives with the child; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19 Fees > DIVISION 5 Fees for Other Applications and Services > Services in Relation to an Assessment from the Department of Employment and Social Development
own_text: the total annual gross income of the employer and, if applicable, of their spouse or common-law partner, living in the same private household does not exceed $150,000 for the taxation year ending before the date of the request.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: The definitions in this section apply in this Division. Agreement means the Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information, signed on December 13, 2012, as amended by the Agreement to Amend the Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information, signed on July 19, 2024. ( Accord ) national of a third country means a person who is neither a Canadian citizen nor a citizen or national of the United States. ( ressortissant d’un pays tiers ) parties means the parties to the Agreement, namely the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States. ( parties ) query means a request that triggers an electronic search process requiring minimal human intervention. ( requête )

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: The purpose of this Division is to implement the Agreement, the objectives of which, as elaborated more specifically through its provisions, are to specify the terms, relationships, responsibilities and conditions for the parties to share information by means of a query to assist in the administration and enforcement of the parties’ respective immigration laws.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information

PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: The Minister may disclose information to the Government of the United States in making a query to that Government, or in response to a query made by that Government, only for the following purposes:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: to support an examination following an application made by a national of a third country to obtain a permanent or temporary resident visa, an electronic travel authorization, a work permit, a study permit, protected person status or another immigration benefit under federal immigration legislation;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: to support an examination or determination as to whether a national of a third country is authorized or not authorized to travel to, enter or remain in Canada or the United States, as the case may be;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: to ensure the accuracy and reliability of biographic data or other immigration-related data.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: In the case of a response to a query made by the Government of the United States, the Minister may disclose information only in respect of any of the following nationals of a third country:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: those who were previously determined to be inadmissible under the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: those who did not meet the requirements under the Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: those in respect of whom a fingerprint match is established; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: those who have been issued or denied a document required to enter Canada as a temporary or permanent resident.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: Only information that is necessary, relevant and proportionate to achieving the purposes of this Division may be disclosed.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information

PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: Only information belonging to the following information categories in respect of a national of a third country may be disclosed:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: biographic data to be used for the purposes of identity verification, such as name, alias, date of birth, country of birth, gender, citizenship and travel document number;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: biometric data consisting of a photograph, fingerprints or both to be used for the purposes of identity verification; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: in the case of a response to a query made by the Government of the United States, other immigration-related data, including the immigration status of the national of a third country, a previous determination that the national of a third country failed to meet the requirements of Canada’s immigration laws, a previous admissibility decision or determination and data relevant to the admissibility of the national of a third country if

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: a match is established in respect of the biographic data referred to in paragraph (a); or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: a match is established in respect of the biometric data referred to in paragraph (b).

marginal_note: Refugee claim — limitation on disclosure of data
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: In the case of a response to a query made by the Government of the United States in respect of a national of a third country making a refugee claim in the United States, only information related to an application for a permanent or temporary resident visa, a work or study permit or another immigration benefit under federal immigration legislation may be disclosed.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: The disclosure must be made in a manner that ensures the accuracy and reliability of the information in question.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: If the Minister determines that disclosing information in response to a query would be inconsistent with domestic law or detrimental to national sovereignty, national security, public policy, or other important national interests, the Minister may refuse to provide all or part of the available information or offer to provide all or part of the information subject to any terms and conditions that he or she may specify.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: Any information collected by the Minister that is determined not to be relevant to a query and that was not used for an administrative purpose, as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act , must be destroyed as soon as feasible.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information

PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: If the Minister is made aware that previously disclosed information is inaccurate, the Minister must notify the Government of the United States and provide correcting information.

marginal_note: Notification of correction and destruction of inaccurate information
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: If the Minister receives correcting information from the Government of the United States, the Minister must notify that Government once the necessary corrections have been made and, unless the information was used for an administrative purpose, as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act , any inaccurate information and any information derived from that inaccurate information must be destroyed as soon as feasible.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 1 Agreement between the Government of Canada and the Government of the United States of America for the Sharing of Visa and Immigration Information
own_text: If inaccurate information has been used for an administrative purpose, as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act , a note must be placed in the file to that effect.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: The definitions in this section apply in this Division. Asylum Annex means the Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing , signed on behalf of Canada on August 22, 2003, as amended from time to time. ( Annexe sur l’asile ) participants means the participants to the Asylum Annex, taking into account their successors, namely the Department of Citizenship and Immigration Canada, the Canada Border Services Agency and the Department of Homeland Security of the United States. ( participants ) refugee status claimant means a person who has made a claim for refugee protection in Canada or at a port of entry. ( demandeur du statut de réfugié )

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: The purpose of this Division is to implement the Asylum Annex, the objectives of which, as elaborated more specifically through its provisions, are to

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: preserve and protect the participants’ refugee status determination systems;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: enhance the participants’ abilities to assist those who qualify for protection from persecution or from torture;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: support efforts to share responsibility between the participants in providing protection to qualified refugee status claimants;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: identify and prevent abuse of the participants’ refugee status determination systems and citizenship and immigration laws; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: identify those who are excluded from protection or denied protection according to the Refugee Convention, as implemented in the participants’ domestic legislation or whose refugee protection may be subject to termination, cancellation or revocation.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: The Minister may only disclose information to the Department of Homeland Security of the United States in respect of a refugee status claimant other than a refugee status claimant who is alleging persecution in the United States.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: Only information that is necessary, relevant and proportionate to achieving the purposes of this Division may be disclosed.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing

PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: The disclosure of information must be made in accordance with article 6 of the Asylum Annex.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: The disclosure must be made in a manner that ensures the accuracy and reliability of the information in question.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: Only information belonging to the following information categories may be disclosed:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: information relating to the identity of a refugee status claimant;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: information relating to the processing of a refugee status claimant’s claim;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: information relevant to a decision to deny a refugee status claimant access to or to exclude such a claimant from the protection of the refugee status determination system or to cease, vacate or nullify a refugee status claimant’s refugee protection; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: information regarding the substance or history of a previous claim made by a refugee status claimant that will assist in determining a subsequent claim.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: Any information collected by the Minister that is determined not to be relevant to the purposes of this Division and that was not used for an administrative purpose, as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act , must be destroyed as soon as feasible.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing

PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: If the Minister is made aware that previously disclosed information is inaccurate, the Minister must notify the Department of Homeland Security of the United States and provide correcting information.

marginal_note: Notification of correction and destruction of inaccurate information
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: If the Minister receives correcting information from the Department of Homeland Security of the United States, the Minister must notify that Department once the necessary corrections have been made and, unless the information was used for an administrative purpose, as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act , any inaccurate information and any information derived from that inaccurate information must be destroyed as soon as feasible.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 2 Annex Regarding the Sharing of Information on Asylum and Refugee Status Claims to the Statement of Mutual Understanding on Information Sharing
own_text: If inaccurate information has been used for an administrative purpose, as defined in section 3 of the Privacy Act , a note must be placed in the file to that effect.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The following definitions apply in this Division. national of a third country means a foreign national other than a national or citizen of the country of the party making or receiving a query. ( ressortissant d’un pays tiers ) party means (a) the Minister; or (b) any of the following government departments or their successors that have entered into an arrangement with the Department and the Canada Border Services Agency for the purpose of facilitating information sharing to assist in the administration and enforcement of their respective countries’ immigration and citizenship laws: (i) Australia’s Department of Immigration and Border Protection, (ii) New Zealand’s Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, (iii) the United Kingdom’s Home Office. ( partie ) query means an automated request for information made by one party to another for the purposes of this Division. ( requête )

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The purpose of this Division is to define the parameters for the sharing of information, by means of a query, between parties in support of the administration and enforcement of Canada’s laws in respect of immigration and other parties’ laws in respect of citizenship and immigration.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: A query in respect of a person must be made by submitting to another party either the person’s fingerprints accompanied by a unique transaction number or the unique transaction number assigned to a previous query received in respect of the person.

marginal_note: Disclosure of information — query or response
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: Disclosure in relation to the making of or a response to a query is limited to information that is necessary, relevant and proportionate to achieving the purposes of this Division and must be made in a manner that ensures the accuracy and reliability of the information.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The Minister may make a query to another party only for the following purposes:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: to support an examination or determination following an application or claim made by a national of a third country for a permanent or temporary resident visa, a work or study permit, protection, refugee protection or any other immigration benefit under Canada’s immigration laws; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: to support an examination or determination as to whether a national of a third country is authorized to travel to, enter or remain in Canada.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The Minister must not make a query to another party in respect of a person who has made a claim for refugee protection or an application for protection if the person has alleged persecution in that party’s country.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The Minister may disclose information in response to a query made by another party only for the following purposes:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: to support an examination or determination by that party following an application or claim made by a national of a third country for a visa or immigration-related permit, status or benefit;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: to support an examination or determination by that party as to whether a national of a third country is authorized to travel to, enter or remain in that party’s territory;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: to support an examination or determination by that party following an application made by a national of a third country for citizenship; or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: to support an examination or determination by that party following an application or claim made by a permanent resident of Canada for refugee status.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The Minister may disclose to the requesting party the following information in relation to the national of a third country or the permanent resident of Canada:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: their biographic data, such as last name, first name, date of birth, gender and country of birth;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: their photograph; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: information in relation to the administration and enforcement of Canada’s immigration laws, including the issuing country of the person’s passport, their immigration status, information relevant to — and any previous decision or determination relating to — their admissibility, and any decision or determination relating to a claim for refugee protection or an application for protection.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: If the Minister determines that the disclosure of information to another party in response to a query would be inconsistent with domestic law or would be detrimental to national sovereignty, national security, public policy or other important national interests, the Minister must refuse to provide all or part of the available information.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: If the Minister becomes aware that information that he or she disclosed in response to a query is inaccurate, the Minister must, as soon as feasible, notify the party to which he or she disclosed the information of the error and provide correcting information.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: If the Minister receives information from another party correcting information previously disclosed by that party in response to a query, the Minister must, as soon as feasible, make the necessary correction and notify the other party once it has been made.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The Minister must retain or dispose of any information obtained in response to a query in accordance with the laws of Canada.

heading_path: PART 19.1 Information Sharing Between Countries > DIVISION 3 Information Sharing Between the Government of Canada and the Governments of Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom
own_text: The Minister must, immediately after completion of the information search triggered by the receipt of a query, destroy any fingerprints submitted as part of the query, regardless of whether a match is identified.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Interpretation
own_text: In this Part, reviewer means a person appointed by order under subsection 91.1(3) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Purpose
own_text: The purpose of the administrative penalties and consequences provided for in this Part is to encourage compliance with the provisions of the Act and these Regulations and not to punish.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Violations
own_text: The contravention, including a contravention committed outside Canada, of any of the following provisions is designated as a violation:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Violations
own_text: section 315.47;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Violations
own_text: paragraph 315.48(a);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Violations
own_text: paragraph 315.48(b);

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Violations
own_text: paragraph 315.48(c);

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Violations
own_text: subsection 315.49(3).

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Prohibitions
own_text: A person must not knowingly, directly or indirectly, represent or advise a person for consideration — or offer to do so — in connection with the submission of an expression of interest under subsection 10.1(3) of the Act or a proceeding or application under the Act unless they are a person or entity referred to in any of subsections 91(2) to (4) of the Act.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Prohibitions
own_text: A person who, directly or indirectly, represents or advises a person for consideration — or offers to do so — in connection with the submission of an expression of interest under subsection 10.1(3) of the Act or a proceeding or application under the Act must not knowingly

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Prohibitions
own_text: counsel, induce, aid or abet or attempt to counsel, induce, aid or abet that person to directly or indirectly misrepresent or withhold material facts relating to a relevant matter that induces or could induce an error in the administration of the Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Prohibitions
own_text: directly or indirectly misrepresent or withhold material facts relating to a relevant matter that induces or could induce an error in the administration of the Act; or

label: (c)
