heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Prohibitions
own_text: communicate, directly or indirectly, by any means, false or misleading information or declarations with intent to induce or deter immigration to Canada.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
own_text: If an officer has reasonable grounds to suspect that a person has committed a violation, the officer may conduct any inspection that they consider to be necessary to verify that the person is in compliance with sections 315.47 and 315.48, including the inspection of any entity for which that person conducts business relating to the provision of immigration and citizenship representation and advice.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
own_text: When conducting an inspection under subsection (1), an officer may, in writing, require the person or entity to provide any relevant document.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
own_text: Subject to subsections (4) and (5), the person or entity that is required by an officer to provide documents must provide them within the period and in the manner specified by the officer.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
own_text: A person referred to in paragraph 91(2)(a) or subsection 91(3) of the Act is not required to provide the documents if that person, within the period specified by the officer, submits an affidavit attesting that the documents contain information that is subject to litigation privilege, solicitor-client privilege or the professional secrecy of advocates and notaries.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
own_text: An entity is not required to provide documents in respect of a person referred to in paragraph 91(2)(a) or subsection 91(3) of the Act if that entity, within the period specified by the officer, submits an affidavit attesting that the documents contain information that is subject to litigation privilege, solicitor-client privilege or the professional secrecy of advocates and notaries.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Inspection
own_text: A failure to comply with subsection (3) is justified if the person or entity made all reasonable efforts to comply or if the failure results from anything done or omitted to be done by the person or entity in good faith.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: An officer who, on the basis of information obtained by any officer in the exercise of the powers set out in section 315.49 and of any other relevant information, believes on reasonable grounds that a person has committed a violation may provide that person with written notice to that effect.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: The preliminary notice must list all violations identified in the course of the inspection conducted under subsection 315.49(1) and must indicate

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: the name of the person who is believed to have committed the violations;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: in respect of each violation, the alleged facts and the provision at issue;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: the administrative monetary penalty for each violation;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: the total of the penalties referred to in paragraph (c);

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: if applicable, the fact that the total referred to in paragraph (d) will be reduced in accordance with section 315.56;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: whether the person has a history of prior violations and the effect on the administrative monetary penalties of the multiplier for prior violations, as determined under subsection 315.54(5);

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: the right of the person to, within 30 days after the date of receipt of the preliminary notice, make written submissions with respect to the information referred to in paragraphs (b) to (d) or, if applicable, submit an affidavit under paragraph 315.51(1)(b), as well as the address to which the submissions or affidavit must be sent; and

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: the fact that, if the person is deemed to have committed a violation or is determined by a reviewer to have committed a violation, the information referred to in subsection 315.6(1) will be made public.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: A person to whom a preliminary notice is sent under subsection 315.5(1) may, within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: make written submissions with respect to the information referred to in paragraphs 315.5(2)(b) to (d);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: if they are a person referred to in paragraph 91(2)(a) or subsection 91(3) of the Act, submit an affidavit attesting that they cannot contest the alleged facts without disclosing information that is subject to litigation privilege, solicitor-client privilege or the professional secrecy of advocates and notaries; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: request an extension of the 30-day period.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: Despite subsection 9.3(2), a preliminary notice is deemed to have been received 30 days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Preliminary Notice
own_text: An officer may extend the 30-day period set out in subsection (1) if there is a reasonable justification for the extension.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), an officer who, on the basis of information obtained by any officer in the exercise of the powers set out in section 315.49 and of any other relevant information, determines on a balance of probabilities that a person has committed a violation may issue a notice of violation to them.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: An officer must not issue a notice of violation unless a preliminary notice was sent to the person under subsection 315.5(1) and the 30-day period set out in subsection 315.51(1) or the period extended under subsection 315.51(3), as the case may be, has expired.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: An officer must not issue a notice of violation to a person who submits an affidavit under paragraph 315.51(1)(b), unless the person has withdrawn their attestation in writing.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: The notice of violation must list all violations for which a determination has been made under subsection (1) and must indicate

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the name of the person who is believed to have committed the violations;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: in respect of each violation, the relevant facts and the provision at issue;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the determination and the reasons for the determination;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the administrative monetary penalty for each violation;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the total of the penalties referred to in paragraph (d);

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: if applicable, the fact that the total referred to in paragraph (e) is reduced in accordance with section 315.56;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: whether the person has a history of prior violations and the effect on the administrative monetary penalties of the multiplier for prior violations, as determined under subsection 315.54(5);

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the right of the person to request, within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice of violation, a review of the notice of violation or of the administrative monetary penalties, or of both;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the fact that the person must pay the administrative monetary penalties within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice of violation unless they request a review or enter into an agreement with the Minister with respect to payment within those 30 days;

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the method of payment for the administrative monetary penalties; and

label: (k)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: the fact that, if the person is deemed to have committed a violation or is determined by a reviewer to have committed a violation, the information referred to in subsection 315.6(1) will be made public.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: Despite subsection 9.3(2), a notice of violation is deemed to have been received 30 days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: Once a notice of violation is issued to a person, no further administrative monetary penalties may be imposed on that person under this Part with respect to any acts or omissions that occurred before the date of issuance of that notice of violation.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Notice of Violation
own_text: If a notice of violation is issued to a person under subsection 41(1) of the Citizenship Regulations , no administrative monetary penalties may be imposed on that person under this Part with respect to any acts or omissions that occurred before the date of issuance of that notice of violation, unless they are set out in a notice of violation that is issued under subsection 315.52(1) on that same date.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: The administrative monetary penalty for a violation in respect of any of section 315.47 and paragraphs 315.48(a) to (c) is determined by the formula (A + B + C) × D where A is the applicable baseline penalty set out in subsection (2); B is the amount, if any, related to the impact of the violation as set out in subsection (3); C is the financial advantage amount, if any, determined under subsection (4); and D is the multiplier for prior violations, as determined under subsection (5).

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: The baseline penalty is the following:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: for a violation in respect of section 315.47, $5,000;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: for a violation in respect of paragraph 315.48(a), $15,000;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: for a violation in respect of paragraph 315.48(b), $15,000; and

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: for a violation in respect of paragraph 315.48(c), $15,000.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: If an error in the administration of the Act results from a violation in respect of any of paragraphs 315.48(a) to (c), the amount related to the impact of the violation is $15,000.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: If the person who is believed to have committed the violation derives a financial advantage from the violation, the financial advantage amount is equal to the total of any amounts that they received in connection with the violation.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: The multiplier for prior violations is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: 0.5, if the person has not previously been deemed to have committed, or determined by a reviewer to have committed, a violation referred to in section 315.46 or a violation referred to in section 35 of the Citizenship Regulations ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: 1, if the person has previously been deemed to have committed, or determined by a reviewer to have committed, violations referred to in paragraph (a) and all of the person’s prior violations were listed in a single notice of violation or in two notices of violation that were issued on the same date; and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: 1.5, in any other case.

marginal_note: Calculation of administrative monetary penalty — inspection
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty

marginal_note: Calculation of administrative monetary penalty — inspection
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: The administrative monetary penalty for a violation in respect of subsection 315.49(3) is $10,000 multiplied by the multiplier for prior violations, as determined under subsection 315.54(5).

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: A failure to comply with subsection 315.49(3) on more than one occasion in the course of an inspection conducted under subsection 315.49(1) results in one administrative monetary penalty only.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: If a notice of violation lists more than one violation and the total of the administrative monetary penalties exceeds $1.5 million, the total must be reduced by the excess amount.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Administrative Monetary Penalty
own_text: If a notice of violation is issued on the same date as a notice of violation issued under subsection 41(1) of the Citizenship Regulations , the administrative monetary penalties set out in the two notices are cumulative, but the total must not exceed $1.5 million.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Payment
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Payment
own_text: Subject to section 315.58, the administrative monetary penalties that are assessed under this Part must be paid within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice of violation unless the person to whom the notice is issued enters into an agreement with the Minister with respect to payment within those 30 days.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Payment
own_text: If the person pays the administrative monetary penalties or enters into an agreement with the Minister in accordance with subsection (1), the person is deemed to have committed the violations.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: A person to whom a notice of violation is issued may, instead of paying the administrative monetary penalties, request in writing, within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice, a review of the notice of violation or of the penalties, or of both.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: The request must include the grounds on which it is based but must not include new evidence.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: If the person does not make a request in the time and manner set out in subsection (1), the person is deemed to have committed the violations.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: In respect of each violation under review, a reviewer must determine, on a balance of probabilities, whether the person who requests the review committed the violation and, if so, whether the administrative monetary penalty has been determined in accordance with this Part.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: If the reviewer determines that the person did not commit the violation, the reviewer must cancel the administrative monetary penalty.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: If the reviewer determines that the person committed the violation, the reviewer must verify that the administrative monetary penalty was determined in accordance with this Part and

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: if they consider that the penalty was so determined, confirm the amount of the penalty; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: if they consider that the penalty was not so determined, correct the amount.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: On completion of the review, the reviewer must confirm, amend or cancel the notice of violation by issuing to the person a notice of decision.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: The notice of decision must list all violations for which a determination under this section has been made and must indicate

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: the name of the person who requested the review;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: in respect of each violation, the relevant facts and the provision at issue;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: the decision and the reasons for the decision;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: the administrative monetary penalty for each violation, if applicable;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: the total of the penalties referred to in paragraph (d), if applicable;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: if applicable, the fact that the total referred to in paragraph (e) is reduced in accordance with section 315.56;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: the right of the person to apply for leave to commence an application for judicial review of the decision;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: if applicable, the fact that the person must pay the administrative monetary penalties within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice of decision unless they enter into an agreement with the Minister with respect to payment within those 30 days;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: the method of payment for the administrative monetary penalties, if applicable; and

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: if the person is determined by the reviewer to have committed a violation, the fact that the information referred to in subsection 315.6(1) will be made public.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: Despite subsection 9.3(2), the notice of decision is deemed to have been received 30 days after the day on which it is sent.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Review
own_text: The person must pay the administrative monetary penalties that are set out in the notice of decision within 30 days after the date of receipt of the notice unless they enter into an agreement with the Minister with respect to payment within those 30 days.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), the Minister must publish the following information on the Department’s website with respect to each person who has been deemed, or determined by a reviewer, to have committed a violation referred to in section 315.46:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: their name;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: the name and address of their business or place of employment, if any;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: the date on which the notice of violation or the notice of decision, if any, was issued to the person;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: the violation and provision at issue;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: the administrative monetary penalty; and

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: an indication as to whether the person has paid the administrative monetary penalty.

heading_path: PART 19.2 System of Administrative Penalties and Consequences — Representation and Advice > Consequences
own_text: The Minister must not publish the information before the end of the period set out in subsection 315.58(1).

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: The definitions in this subsection apply in this Part. former Regulations means the Immigration Regulations, 1978 , as enacted by Order in Council P.C. 1978-486 dated February 23, 1978 and registered as SOR/78-172. ( ancien règlement ) Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations means the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations , as enacted by Order in Council P.C. 1997-477 dated April 8, 1997 and registered as SOR/97-183. ( Règlement sur les catégories d’immigrants précisées pour des motifs d’ordre humanitaire ) Immigration Act Fees Regulations means the Immigration Act Fees Regulations , as enacted by Order in Council P.C. 1996-2003 dated December 19, 1996 and registered as SOR/97-22. ( Règlement sur les prix à payer — Loi sur l’immigration ) Refugee Claimants Designated Class Regulations means the Refugee Claimants Designated Class Regulations , as enacted by Order in Council P.C. 1989-2517 dated December 21, 1989 and registered as SOR/90-40. ( Règlement sur la catégorie admissible de demandeurs du statut de réfugié )

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: For greater certainty, in this Part former Act has the same meaning as in section 187 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Interpretation — Immigration and Refugee Protection Act
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 1 Interpretation
own_text: A reference in this Part to the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act includes the regulations and rules made under it.

marginal_note: Decisions and orders made under former Act
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 2 General Provisions

marginal_note: Decisions and orders made under former Act
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 2 General Provisions
own_text: A decision or order made under the former Act that is in effect immediately before the coming into force of this section continues in effect after that coming into force.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 2 General Provisions
own_text: A document, including a visa, that is issued under the former Act and is valid immediately before the coming into force of this section continues to be valid after that coming into force.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Terms and conditions imposed under the former Act become conditions imposed under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), a removal order made under the former Act that was unexecuted on the coming into force of this section continues in force and is subject to the provisions of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: The execution of a removal order that had been stayed on the coming into force of this section under paragraphs 49(1)(c) to (f) of the former Act continues to be stayed until the earliest of the events described in paragraphs 231(1)(a) to (e).

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Subsection (2) does not apply if

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: the subject of the removal order was determined by the Convention Refugee Determination Division not to have a credible basis for their claim; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: the subject of the removal order

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: is subject to a removal order because they are inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: resides or sojourns in the United States or St. Pierre and Miquelon and is the subject of a report prepared under subsection 44(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on their entry into Canada.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A conditional removal order made under the former Act continues in force and is subject to subsection 49(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Section 52 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act applies to a person who immediately before the coming into force of this section was outside Canada after a removal order was executed against them.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on security grounds if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of an inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(e), (f), (g) or (k) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of violating human or international rights if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of an inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(j) or (l) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: For greater certainty, an opinion of the Minister under paragraph 19(1)(l) of the former Act continues as an opinion of the Minister under paragraph 35(1)(b) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of serious criminality if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of an inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(c) or (c.1) of the former Act or had been determined to be inadmissible on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(a.1) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of criminality if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of an inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(2)(a), (a.1) or (b) of the former Act, or had been determined to be inadmissible on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(a.2) or (a.3) or (2)(d) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person who on the coming into force of this section had been determined to be inadmissible on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(d) of the former Act is

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of serious criminality if the person was convicted of an offence and a term of imprisonment of more than six months has been imposed or a term of imprisonment of 10 years or more could have been imposed; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of criminality if the offence was punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of five years or more but less than 10 years.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of organized criminality if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of an inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(c.2) or subparagraph 19(1)(d)(ii) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person — other than an applicant described in section 7 of the former Regulations or section 4 of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations who made an application for admission under the former Act — is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on health grounds if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of the inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(a) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act for financial reasons if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of the inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(b) of the former Act or had been determined to be inadmissible on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(f) or (2)(l) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act for misrepresentation if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be inadmissible on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(e) or (2)(g) or (i) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person is inadmissible under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act for failing to comply with that Act if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of an inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(h) or (i) or (2)(c) or (d) of the former Act, or had been determined to be inadmissible on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(b) or (2)(b), (e), (f), (h), (i) or (k) of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A report made under section 20 or 27 of the former Act is a report under subsection 44(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: For the purpose of subsection (1)

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(1)(e), (f), (g) or (k) of the former Act is inadmissibility on security grounds under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act ;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(1)(j) or (l) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of violating human or international rights;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(1)(c) or (c.1) of the former Act or inadmissibility on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(a.1) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of serious criminality;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(2)(a), (a.1) or (b) of the former Act or inadmissibility on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(a.2) or (a.3) or (2)(d) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of criminality;

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(d) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: serious criminality, if the person was convicted of an offence and a term of imprisonment of more than six months has been imposed or a term of imprisonment of 10 years or more could have been imposed, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: criminality if the offence was punishable by a maximum term of imprisonment of five years or more but less than 10 years;

label: (f)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(1)(c.2) or subparagraph 19(1)(d)(ii) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on grounds of organized criminality;

label: (g)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of the inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(a) of the former Act — other than an applicant described in section 7 of the former Regulations or section 4 of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations who made an application for admission under the former Act — is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on health grounds if, on the coming into force of this section, the person had been determined to be a member of the inadmissible class described in paragraph 19(1)(a) of the former Act;

label: (h)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(1)(b) of the former Act or inadmissibility on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(f) or (2)(l) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act for financial reasons;

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(e) or (2)(g) or (i) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act for misrepresentation; and

label: (j)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: inadmissibility as a member of a class described in paragraph 19(1)(h) or (i) or (2)(c) or (d) of the former Act or inadmissibility on the basis of paragraph 27(1)(b) or (2)(b), (e), (f), (h), (i) or (k) of the former Act is inadmissibility under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act for failing to comply with the Act.

marginal_note: Reports forwarded to a senior immigration officer
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A report that was forwarded to a senior immigration officer under the former Act and in respect of which a decision has not been made on the coming into force of this section is a report transmitted to the Minister.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: The causing by a senior immigration officer of an inquiry to be held under the former Act is the referring by the Minister of a report to the Immigration Division under subsection 44(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act unless that subsection allows the Minister to make a removal order.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: If no substantive evidence was adduced before the Adjudication Division, the causing by a senior immigration officer of an inquiry to be held under the former Act is, if subsection 44(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act allows the Minister to make a removal order, a report on the basis of which the Minister may make a removal order.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: The first review of reasons, after the coming into force of this section, for the continued detention of a person detained under the former Act shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: If the review referred to in subsection (1) was the first review in respect of a person’s detention, the period of detention at the end of which that review was made shall be considered the period referred to in subsection 57(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: If a review of reasons for continued detention follows the review referred to in subsection (1), that review shall be made under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: An order issued by a Deputy Minister under subsection 105(1) of the former Act continues in force and the review of reasons for continued detention shall be made under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A release from detention under the former Act is the ordering of release from detention under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act and any terms and conditions imposed under the former Act become conditions imposed under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A warrant for arrest and detention made under the former Act is a warrant for arrest and detention made under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: An order for the detention of a person made under the former Act is an order to detain made under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A claim to be a Convention refugee made by a person described in subparagraph 19(1)(c.1)(i) of the former Act in respect of whom the Minister was of the opinion under subparagraph 46.01(1)(e)(i) of the former Act that the person constitutes a danger to the public in Canada is deemed, if no determination was made by a senior immigration officer under section 45 of the former Act, to be a claim for refugee protection made by a person described in paragraph 101(2)(b) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act who is inadmissible and in respect of whom the Minister is of the opinion that the person is a danger to the public.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person in respect of whom subsection 70(5) or paragraph 77(3.01)(b) of the former Act applied on the coming into force of this section is a person in respect of whom subsection 64(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act applies.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person whose removal on the coming into force of this section was allowed by the application of paragraphs 53(1)(a) to (d) of the former Act is a person referred to in subsection 115(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A certificate determined to be reasonable under paragraph 40.1(4)(d) of the former Act is deemed to be a certificate determined to be reasonable under subsection 80(1) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A person who was a permanent resident immediately before the coming into force of this section is a permanent resident under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Any period spent outside Canada within the five years preceding the coming into force of this section by a permanent resident holding a returning resident permit is considered to be a period spent in Canada for the purpose of satisfying the residency obligation under section 28 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act if that period is included in the five-year period referred to in that section.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Any period spent outside Canada within the two years immediately following the coming into force of this section by a permanent resident holding a returning resident permit is considered to be a period spent in Canada for the purpose of satisfying the residency obligation under section 28 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act if that period is included in the five-year period referred to in that section.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Any of the following persons who were in Canada immediately before the coming into force of this section are temporary residents under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act and are subject to its provisions:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a visitor under the former Act; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a person issued a permit under section 37 of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A permit issued by the Minister under section 37 of the former Act is deemed to be a temporary resident permit referred to in section 24 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Any of the following persons who were in Canada immediately before the coming into force of this section are deemed to have been authorized under section 23 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act to enter Canada:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a person in respect of whom an examination remains incomplete and whose examination was adjourned and referred to another immigration officer for completion under subsection 12(3) of the former Act;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a person in respect of whom an examination remains incomplete and whose examination was deferred under paragraph 13(1)(a) of the former Act;

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a person in respect of whom an examination remains incomplete and who was authorized to come into Canada for further examination under paragraph 14(2)(b) of the former Act;

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a person in respect of whom an examination remains incomplete and who was authorized to come into Canada for further examination under paragraph 23(1)(b) of the former Act; and

label: (e)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: a person who has made a claim to be a Convention refugee in respect of which a determination of eligibility was not made before the coming into force of this section.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A performance bond posted or security deposited under the former Act that remains posted or deposited immediately before the coming into force of this section continues as a deposit or a guarantee under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act and is governed by its provisions.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: A thing seized under the former Act continues to be seized on the coming into force of this section, and the seizure is governed by the provisions of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 3 Enforcement
own_text: Any debt under subsection 118(3) of the former Act continues as a debt on the coming into force of this section and is governed by the provisions of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
own_text: With the exception of subsection 140.3(1) of these Regulations, the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act applies to an applicant described in section 7 of the former Regulations or section 4 of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations , who made an application for admission under the former Act if the application is pending on the day on which this section comes into force and no visa has been issued to the applicant.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
own_text: An applicant described in section 7 of the former Regulations or section 4 of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations who made an application for admission under the former Act that has not been refused may add to their application at any time prior to their departure for Canada a person included in the definition family member in subsection 1(3).

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
own_text: A sponsorship agreement with the Minister made under the former Act and former Regulations does not cease to have effect for the sole reason of section 152 coming into force.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), a sponsor who made an undertaking within the meaning of paragraph (b) of the definition undertaking in subsection 2(1) of the former Regulations, or of the definition undertaking in subsection 1(1) of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations , and in respect of whom an immigration officer was satisfied that the requirements of paragraph 7.1(2)(d) or 5(2)(d) of those Regulations, respectively, were met is deemed to be a sponsor whose application has been approved by an officer under section 154.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a sponsor who requests that a person be added to their undertaking.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 4 Refugee and Humanitarian Resettlement Program
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply to a sponsor who is ineligible to be a party to a sponsorship under section 156.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: Refugee protection is conferred under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act on a person who

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: has been determined in Canada before the coming into force of this section to be a Convention refugee and

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: no determination was made to vacate that determination, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: no determination was made that the person ceased to be a Convention refugee;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: as an applicant or an accompanying dependant was granted landing before the coming into force of this section after being issued a visa under

label: (i)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: section 7 of the former Regulations, or

label: (ii)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: section 4 of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations ; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: was determined to be a member of the post-determination refugee claimants in Canada class before the coming into force of this section and was granted landing under section 11.4 of the former Regulations or who becomes a permanent resident under subsection 21(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Rejection of a claim for refugee protection
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A determination made in Canada before the coming into force of this section that a person is not a Convention refugee is deemed to be a claim for refugee protection rejected by the Board.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A determination made before the coming into force of this section that a person is not eligible to have their Convention refugee claim determined by the Convention Refugee Determination Division is deemed to be a determination that the claim is ineligible to be referred to the Refugee Protection Division.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A claim to be a Convention refugee that was withdrawn or declared to be abandoned before the coming into force of this section is deemed to be a claim determined to be withdrawn or abandoned under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A claim made in Canada to be a Convention refugee in respect of which a determination of eligibility was not made before the coming into force of this section is deemed to be a claim for refugee protection made in Canada that is received on the day on which this section comes into force.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: Subject to section 191 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act , a claim of a person who was determined eligible before the coming into force of this section to have a claim to be a Convention refugee determined by the Convention Refugee Determination Division, and in respect of which no determination was made by that Division, is a claim that

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: is referred under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act to the Refugee Protection Division unless an officer gives notice under subsection 104(1) of that Act; and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: is subject to the provisions of that Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A determination made in Canada before the coming into force of this section that a person has ceased to be a Convention refugee is deemed to be a determination by the Board that refugee protection has ceased.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A decision made in Canada before the coming into force of this section to approve an application to reconsider and vacate a determination that a person is a Convention refugee is deemed to be a determination by the Board to vacate a decision to allow a claim for refugee protection.

marginal_note: Post-determination refugee claimants in Canada class
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection

marginal_note: Post-determination refugee claimants in Canada class
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: An application for landing as a member of the post-determination refugee claimants in Canada class in respect of which no determination of whether the applicant is a member of that class was made before the coming into force of this section is an application for protection under sections 112 to 114 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act and those sections apply to the application.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: Before a decision is made on the application, the applicant shall be notified that they may make additional submissions in support of their application.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: A decision on the application shall not be made until 30 days after notification is given to the applicant.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: Notification is given

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: when it is given by hand to the applicant; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: if it is sent by mail, seven days after the day on which it was sent to the applicant at the last address provided by them to the Department.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: For greater certainty, the execution of a removal order made under the former Act against an applicant referred to in subsection (1) is stayed, and the stay is effective until the earliest of the applicable events described in section 232 occurs.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: If landing was not granted before the coming into force of this section, an application for landing submitted under section 46.04 of the former Act is an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident under subsection 21(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Application for landing — undocumented Convention refugee in Canada class
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: If landing was not granted before June 28, 2002, an application for landing as a member of the undocumented Convention refugee in Canada class is an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident under subsection 21(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Application for landing — post-determination refugee claimants in Canada class
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 5 Refugee Protection
own_text: If landing was not granted before the coming into force of this section, an application for landing submitted by a person pursuant to a determination that the person is a member of the post-determination refugee claimants in Canada class is an application to remain in Canada as a permanent resident under subsection 21(2) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: On the coming into force of this section, any application for leave to commence an application for judicial review and any application for judicial review or appeal from an application that was brought under the former Act that is pending before the Federal Court or the Supreme Court of Canada is deemed to have been commenced under Division 8 of Part 1 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act and is governed by the provisions of that Division and section 87.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: On the coming into force of this section, any application under subsection 82.1(10) of the former Act that is pending before the Federal Court is deemed to be an application under section 87 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: Despite subsection (1), an application for judicial review that was not subject to the requirement of an application for leave under the former Act and was pending on the coming into force of this section does not require such an application under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Judicial review after coming into force
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: Any judicial review proceeding brought in respect of any decision or order made or any matter arising under the former Act after the coming into force of this section is governed by Division 8 of Part 1 and section 87 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: A person in respect of whom the 30-day period provided by section 18.1 of the Federal Courts Act for making an application for judicial review from a decision or matter referred to in subsection 82.1(2) of the former Act has not elapsed on the coming into force of this section and who has not made such an application has 60 days from the coming into force of this section to file an application for leave under section 72 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act.

marginal_note: Validity or lawfulness of a decision or act
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: The validity or lawfulness of a decision or act made under the former Act that is the subject of a judicial review procedure or appeal referred to in subsection (1) is determined in accordance with the provisions of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: On the coming into force of this section, an appeal made under section 102.17 of the former Act or an application for an order made under section 102.2 of the former Act that is pending remains governed by the provisions of the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: Subject to subsections (2) and (3), if a decision or an act of the Minister or an immigration officer under the former Act is referred back by the Federal Court or Supreme Court of Canada for determination and the determination is not made before this section comes into force, the determination shall be made in accordance with the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Decisions or acts not provided for by Immigration and Refugee Protection Act
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: If the decision or act referred to in subsection (1) was made under paragraph 46.01(1)(e), subsection 70(5) or paragraph 77(3.01)(b) of the former Act and the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act makes no provision for the decision or act, no determination shall be made.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: If a decision or an act of the Minister or an immigration officer under the former Act in respect of a person described in subparagraph 9(1)(b)(i) or paragraph 10(1)(b) of the former Regulations is referred back by the Federal Court or Supreme Court of Canada for determination and the determination is not made before December 1, 2003, the determination shall be made in accordance with subsections 361(4) and (5.2) of these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: If a decision or an act of the Minister or an immigration officer under the former Act in respect of a person described in subparagraph 9(1)(b)(ii) or (iii) of the former Regulations is referred back by the Federal Court or Supreme Court of Canada for determination and the determination is not made before December 1, 2003, the determination shall be made in accordance with subsections 361(5), (5.1) and (6) of these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: If a decision of the Immigration Appeal Division made under the former Act is referred back by the Federal Court or Supreme Court of Canada for determination and the determination is not made before the date of the coming into force of this section, the Immigration Appeal Division shall dispose of the matter in accordance with the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 6 Court Proceedings
own_text: If a decision of the Adjudication Division made under the former Act is referred back by the Federal Court or Supreme Court of Canada for determination and the determination is not made before the date of the coming into force of this section, the Immigration Division shall dispose of the matter in accordance with the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

marginal_note: Application of the Act to existing undertakings
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 7 Undertakings

marginal_note: Application of the Act to existing undertakings
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 7 Undertakings
own_text: Subject to subsection (2), an undertaking referred to in section 118 of the former Act that was given before the day on which this section comes into force is governed by the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 7 Undertakings
own_text: Payments that are made to or for the benefit of a person as social assistance or as financial assistance in the form of funds from a government resettlement assistance program referred to in subparagraph 139(1)(f)(ii) as a result of the breach of an undertaking, within the meaning of subparagraph (a)(ii) or paragraph (b) of the definition “undertaking” in subsection 2(1) of the former Regulations or of the definition “undertaking” in subsection 1(1) of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations , that was given before the day on which this section comes into force, may be recovered from the person or organization that gave the undertaking as a debt due to Her Majesty in right of Canada or in right of a province.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 7 Undertakings
own_text: For greater certainty, the duration of an undertaking referred to in section 118 of the former Act that was given to the Minister before the day on which this section comes into force is not affected by these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 7 Undertakings
own_text: For greater certainty, if an immigrant visa was issued to a person described in section 7 of the former Regulations or section 4 of the Humanitarian Designated Classes Regulations before the day on which this section comes into force, the duration and terms of an undertaking, referred to in section 118 of the former Act, relating to that person are not affected by these Regulations.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: A person is not required to include in an application a non-accompanying common-law partner or a non-accompanying child who is not a dependent son or a dependent daughter within the meaning of subsection 2(1) of the former Regulations and is a dependent child as defined in section 2 of these Regulations if the application was made under the former Act before the day on which this section comes into force.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: If a person has made an application under the former Act before the day on which this section comes into force, the following provisions do not apply to the person in respect of any of their non-accompanying dependent children, referred to in section 352, or their non-accompanying common-law partner:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: paragraph 70(1)(e);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: subparagraph 72(1)(e)(i); and

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: paragraph 108(1)(a).

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: If a person makes an application under the former Act before June 28, 2002, their non-accompanying dependent children, referred to in section 352, and their non-accompanying common-law partner shall not, for the purposes of that application, be considered inadmissible non-accompanying family members, referred to in paragraph 42(1)(a) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act , and are not subject to the requirements of paragraph 16(2)(b) of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act or 51(b) of these Regulations.

marginal_note: Family members not excluded from family class
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 8 Non-Accompanying Family Members
own_text: If a person who made an application under the former Act before June 28, 2002 sponsors a non-accompanying dependent child, referred to in section 352, who makes an application as a member of the family class or the spouse or common-law partner in Canada class, or sponsors a non-accompanying common-law partner who makes such an application, paragraph 117(9)(d) does not apply in respect of that dependent child or common-law partner.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 9 Fiancés
own_text: If a person referred to in paragraph (f) of the definition member of the family class in subsection 2(1) of the former Regulations made an application under those Regulations for a permanent resident visa, or their sponsor submitted a sponsorship application under those Regulations, before June 28, 2002, the person’s application or the sponsorship application, as the case may be, is governed by the former Act.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: The fee set out in column III of item 19 of the schedule to the Immigration Act Fees Regulations is remitted and shall be repaid by the Minister to the person who paid it if the fee is paid in respect of a person before they become a permanent resident under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act and the person, at the time they made an application for landing under the former Regulations, was

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: a member of the family class and 19 years of age or older and, on the day on which this section comes into force, is a foreign national referred to in paragraph 117(1)(b) or (e) of these Regulations; or

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: an accompanying dependant of an immigrant, within the meaning of subsection 2(1) of the former Regulations, 19 years of age or older and not a spouse of the principal applicant.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: A fee paid for processing an application in respect of which no decision has been made before the day on which this section comes into force or an application that has been refused but the refusal has not been communicated to the applicant before that day shall be applied to the cost of completing the processing of the application under the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act .

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of an application for a returning resident permit.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: The fee for a returning resident permit set out in column III of item 3 of the schedule to the Immigration Act Fees Regulations is remitted if, before the day on which this section comes into force, no decision has been made on the application for the permit or the application has been refused and the refusal has not been communicated to the applicant. If the fee is remitted, it shall be repaid by the Minister to the person who paid it.

marginal_note: Remission — fee for review of family business employment offer
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 10 Fees
own_text: The fee set out in column III of item 16 of the schedule to the Immigration Act Fees Regulations for the review of an offer of employment made to an applicant in respect of a family business is remitted if, before the day on which this section comes into force, no determination has been made on the family business application or the application has been refused and the refusal has not been communicated to the applicant. If the fee is remitted, it shall be repaid by the Minister to the person who paid it.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: If, before the day on which this section comes into force, a foreign national referred to in subsection (2) has been assessed by a visa officer and awarded the number of units of assessment required by the former Regulations, that assessment is, for the purpose of these Regulations, an award of points equal or superior to the minimum number of points required of

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: a skilled worker, in the case of a foreign national described in paragraph (2)(a);

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: an investor, in the case of a foreign national described in paragraph (2)(b);

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: an entrepreneur, in the case of a foreign national described in paragraph (2)(c); or

label: (d)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: a self-employed person, in the case of a foreign national described in paragraph (2)(d).

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: Subsection (1) applies in respect of a foreign national who submitted an application under the former Regulations, as one of the following, for an immigrant visa that is pending immediately before the day on which this section comes into force:

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: a person described in subparagraph 9(1)(b)(i) or paragraph 10(1)(b) of the former Regulations;

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: an investor; or

label: (c)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: an entrepreneur.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: During the period beginning on the day on which this section comes into force and ending on March 31, 2003, units of assessment shall be awarded to a foreign national, in accordance with the former Regulations, if the foreign national is an immigrant who,

label: (a)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: is referred to in subsection 8(1) of those Regulations, other than a provincial nominee, and

label: (b)
heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
own_text: before January 1, 2002, made an application for an immigrant visa under those Regulations that is still pending on the day on which this section comes into force and has not, before that day, been awarded units of assessment under those Regulations.

heading_path: PART 20 Transitional Provisions > DIVISION 11 Economic Classes
